row.name: Melody's Melon Mania
row.detailed_description: Melody's Melon Mania, a charming game where physics meets strategy. Your mission? Merge adorable little 'heads' to create bigger ones, all while skillfully managing space in the container. Navigate each move thoughtfully to rack up points without spilling over. Pair up two identical heads to level up to a bigger, more adorable head! The higher the tier, the bigger they grow! Play with gravity, strategize, and have a blast earning points! Show off your cleverness in this fast-paced and brain-teasing challenge! Endless replayability for FREE! Simple to pick up, tricky to excel at. You'll keep coming back to beat your own high score!
row.short_description: Embark on a delightful free-to-play puzzle-solving journey with Projekt Melody in Melody's Melon Mania!

row.name: Run Run My Bride!
row.detailed_description: Game Description: This is a parkour game where players need to control the bride and groom by the keyboard in a race, dodging vehicles and obstacles along the way, while collecting plenty of hearts. Run, run and break your best score! this Is A Love Letter Ro My Beloved. I met Jasmine in September 2010, on the first day of high school. We fell in love on December 26, 2010. It rarely snows in my city, but that night, it did. Fourteen years have passed, and we’re still together. From naive students to professionals in our respective fields, we’ve never been apart. Jasmine is my best friend, teacher, wife, and family—past, present, and future. On July 20, 2024, we’ll finally walk down the aisle, surrounded by well-wishes, embarking on a new chapter of our lives. As a game developer, I want to dedicate my first independently launched game, ‘Run Run My Bride,’ to my beloved Jasmine. It’s a testament to our fourteen-year love story. I’ve worked on many games—indie projects and well-known AAA titles—and I’ll continue to contribute to more. But ‘Run Run My Bride’ holds a special place in my heart. Despite its imperfections and time constraints, I’ll polish it with all my might. These fourteen years have flown by like a fleeting white steed. This game carries my love for her, our aspirations for the future, and my unwavering commitment to game development. To all, let’s stay true to our initial intentions. Cheers!
row.short_description: This is a parkour game where players need to control the bride and groom in a race, dodging vehicles and obstacles along the way, while collecting plenty of hearts.

row.name: Turte
row.detailed_description: Turte is a simple yet engaging game where players click on a turtle to increase their score. With straightforward mechanics and an easy-to-understand interface, Turte offers an enjoyable experience for players of all ages. As you progress in the game, you will earn points that can be used to purchase a cosmetic variant of the Turtles adding an extra layer of excitement to the gameplay. The game is designed to be casual and fun, making it perfect for short bursts of play or extended sessions. Key Features Simple and Addictive Gameplay: Click on the turtle to increase your score and watch your progress grow. Variety of Turtles: Unlock different types of turtles, including rare and animated ones, each with unique designs. Regular Drops: Receive new turtles at regular intervals, ensuring a steady stream of rewards and excitement. Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy the serene, mystical pond setting with detailed and charming visuals.
row.short_description: Turte is a simple yet engaging game where players click on a turtle to increase their score. With straightforward mechanics and an easy-to-understand interface, Turte offers an enjoyable experience for players of all ages.

row.name: Infinite Library
row.detailed_description: Infinite Library is a fast paced 2.5D Puzzle-Platformer. Play as Alex, a guardian of the Infinite Library. Your mission is to protect the library from imminent danger. Navigate through treacherous puzzles using ancient books that allow you to manipulate the laws of physics. Will you save the Library before it's too late? Seven unique Levels : Navigate through seven unique floors where both your platforming skills and puzzle solving skills will be tested! Speed and Movement:  Infinite Library allows the player to express themselves through many different movement options and abilities! Navigate the world by wavedashing, wall-jumping and so much more! Challenge Mode and Normal Mode : Play the game at your own pace with the choice between Challenge Mode and Normal Mode. Switch between the modes at any time to adapt the level to your liking! Speedrun Friendly : Race against the clock with our standardized speedrun timer in challenge mode! Will you be the worlds speediest reader? Hand Drawn Art : Enjoy the hand drawn art that can be found in cutscenes! Original Sound Track : Each level is accompanied by a song from our catchy original sound track!
row.short_description: In this award winning puzzle-platformer you are tasked with saving the Infinite Library from impending doom! Use unique movement and abilities to navigate dangerous puzzles and dispel the darkness before it's too late!

row.name: Autogiro
row.detailed_description: Autogiro: An Exciting Adventure in Helicopter Shooting In Autogiro, a fast-paced, side-scrolling shooter, you take control of a sophisticated helicopter and set off on a mission where your survival depends on your accuracy, quick thinking, and strategy! You will enter a high-security system as a proficient helicopter pilot, evading lethal obstacles, fighting waves of opponents, and taking on formidable bosses in four difficult zones. Key Features: Exciting Side-Scrolling Action: Make your way through dangerous areas teeming with hostile troops, lethal traps, and narrow passageways. Each level offers a fresh difficulty that must be solved with lightning-fast reflexes and quick thought. Epic Boss Battles: There is an epic battle with a terrifying boss at the end of each of the four zones. To go on to the next level and eventually engage the base boss in a memorable final battle, defeat them. Management of Fuel: Pay attention to your fuel levels! Restock your supplies by dropping bombs on gasoline tanks, but don't get side-tracked—you'll need every drop to make it to the last zone. Smooth, Dynamic Controls: Whether you're using a keyboard or a controller, learn how to accelerate and decelerate using simple controls. In the heat of combat, maintain your agility and adjust to confined areas and fast-paced pursuits. Are You Able to Finish the Mission? Autogiro is not a game for the weak of heart, with only three lives and unrelenting foes at every step. Are you capable of surviving perilous terrain, taking down imposing bosses, and reaching the decisive battle? The sky is your battlefield, pilot, so get ready.
row.short_description: In Autogiro, a fast-paced, side-scrolling shooter, you take control of a sophisticated helicopter and set off on a mission where your survival depends on your accuracy, quick thinking, and strategy!

row.name: GuiGui
row.detailed_description: ■ About the Game GuiGui is a clicker game where you click on a cute character named GuiGui! Get a random character item from the GuiGui universe every 3 hours and grow your collection, featuring exclusive art pieces by GuiGui himself! ■ Features: - GuiGui, of course - Items to grow your collection - Achievements - A community that's as cute as GuiGui - Exclusive designs by GuiGui: All items received every 3 hours are original creations by the artist GuiGui ■ About the artist GuiGui (귀귀) GuiGui(귀귀) is a celebrated Korean webtoon artist and oil painter, known for his unique artistic style and engaging storytelling. Fans who recognize his talent often describe GuiGui as either a genius or a madman. GuiGui gained popularity through major Korean webtoon platforms such as Naver Webtoon, where he serialized famous works like 'Passionate Man' and 'Hot-Blooded Elementary School.' His artistic endeavors have expanded to include canvas oil paintings. Since his first exhibition in 2022, GuiGui has held several creative exhibitions combining webtoon elements with symbolic oil paintings. His oil paintings and illustrated prints are particularly known for being traded at high prices. Through this game, we aim to introduce GuiGui's artistic world to a global audience, allowing players to enjoy and appreciate his original creations. For more information about GuiGui, visit his Wikipedia page.
row.short_description: GuiGui is a clicker game where you click on a cute character named GuiGui! Every 3 hours, you get a random character item from the GuiGui universe. Each item is an original creation by the renowned Korean webtoon artist and oil painter, GuiGui(귀귀). Join us and be part of something fantastic!

row.name: Saihate Station
row.detailed_description: 'After falling asleep on the last train, I woke up in a bizarre place called Saihate Station...' An exploration/horror/adventure game about the codependent, love-hate relationship between two men. The main characters Haru Akinashi and Shion Tatsunami are both 26 years old and work in the same company. Since Haru joined the company two months earlier, Shion calls him 'Senpai.' They are complete opposites: Shion is cheerful and adept at everything, while Haru is a slow worker who lacks confidence. Feeling inferior, and even a little envious, Haru starts to distance himself from Shion. But a twist of fate brings both of them to Saihate Station, where they make a promise to work together and return home. Their interactions are awkward at first, given the estrangement, but with each problem they overcome together, Haru recalls their former friendship, and their bond grows stronger than before. Then, the whole truth of Saihate Station is revealed. What will become of their feelings? And what are their destinations? Character introduction ● Haru Akinashi A self-effacing office worker who lacks confidence and social skills. He processes things slowly and is often reprimanded by his manager. Because he joined the company two months earlier, he's told to behave like a senior to Shion. The two get along well, being the same age, but Haru starts to distance himself from Shion due to feelings of inferiority and even envy. ● Shion Tatsunami An office worker at the same company as Haru, whom he calls 'Senpai.' He appears to be talented, cheerful and kind, but the truth is... Game features Multiple endings Your actions will affect Haru's dependency level, which determines how the story unfolds. Low difficulty The game features only simple puzzles and chase scenes, with no surprise elements. Even if you encounter a game over, you can continue right away without needing to load a save.   Focus on dialogue You can enjoy the interactions of two completely different characters. Warning This work contains depictions of physical and verbal abuse, blood, unsettling sound effects, vomiting, murder, justification of criminal acts, and ambiguous ethics. It may be unsuitable for players who have difficulties distinguishing fiction and reality, who are dealing with mental health issues, or who are susceptible to over-stimulation. Other Added new languages. Can be switched in-game. (Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Thai, and Vietnamese translated by volunteers) Added illustrations. Fixed various bugs, improved presentation and usability. 'hint_spoiler' (strategy hints) and 'readme' can be viewed by viewing local files.
row.short_description: An exploration/horror/adventure game about the codependent, love-hate relationship between two men.

row.name: ETO
row.detailed_description: Form your platoon and take control in this WW2 tabletop turn-base strategy game. Defeat the enemy using tactics and luck and clear the stages with various puzzles and objectives. In this game you will control a WW2 infantry platoon with its man in charge captain Williams. Some challenges will have a set pieces of units while others will have you composite your own platoon and figure out the best way to clear a stage. The game requires you to clear a stage and keep the captain alive while also adding a luck factor on top of a tabletop game by introducing dice roll tables. Gameplay: You control 5 types of units - Captain, Private, Sniper, Medic and Mortar support. Each unit has a specific set of abilities that you need to utilize in order to clear a map. All units have 2 ability points per turn and various move distance, ranges and special abilities. The traditional attrition system is replaced with dice rolls and various statuses that disables units prompting various tactic when managing the battlefield mixed with luck factor of a dice. Game is played on a grid like map where you manage your troops around obstacles and covers where you use said terrain to gain advantage on a roll table, cover your troops with smoke and call air strikes. Every game is a new experience when you balance strategy with luck! Game features various levels with increasing difficulty and challenge modes both with in game star collection witch makes this game perfect casual single player couch time sink.
row.short_description: Balance between tactics and luck as you lead your troops across various skirmishes! This tabletop turn-based strategy game will peak your interest as you try to clear all levels in this WW2 inspired setting.

row.name: Baby Blues Nightmares - Toddler Horror Game Prologue
row.detailed_description: IMPORTANT: THIS IS ONLY THE PROLOGUE (CHAPTER 1) - IF YOU WISH FOR THE FULL GAME, PLEASE CHECK THE LINK FOR BABY BLUES NIGHTMARES. Baby Blues Nightmare - Prologue is only a small taste of the horrors that awaits in the full game. This is only the Prologue for the survival horror game where you play as a toddler and have to do what it takes in order to survive your horror-ish nightmares of what's real and not. Fix, maintain and customize your Tricycle to roam around your little world with. Run, hide and survive but remember; try not to cry when you are scared.. or the monsters will hear you and get you. Explore your little world with your very own Tricycle which you can use as a vehicle, where you can store your favorite toys, customize your wheels, paint and find collectables to place on your Tricycle. This will be your means of transport. Embark on a spine-chilling journey into the unsettling realms of a child's nightmares as a brave toddler where you must navigate through the eerie corridors and dimly lit playrooms to recover your five beloved toys, all while trying to unravel the mysteries that shroud the facility. Immerse yourself in the innocence of childhood, where every shadow hides a potential nightmare. The world seen through the eyes of a toddler adds a unique layer of vulnerability, intensifying the fear factor. Utilize the unique abilities of a toddler - crawl through hidden passages, hide in tiny spaces, and use your imagination to outsmart the lurking horrors. Your small size becomes both an advantage and a disadvantage in this heart-pounding adventure. Features: Unique Perspective: Experience the game from the eyes of a toddler, navigating a perilous play area filled with oversized obstacles and toys. Immersive Graphics: Stunning and detailed graphics that bring the miniature world to life, with vibrant colors and realistic physics. Dynamic Play Area: The play area is constantly changing, keeping players on their toes as they adapt to new challenges and obstacles. Obstacle Variety: Encounter a wide range of hazards such as towering building blocks, rolling balls and more, each requiring different strategies to overcome. Stealth Gameplay: Evade enemies patrolling the play area, requiring a blend of stealth and agility to avoid detection. Hiding System: Hide under tables, in lockers and more to evade the enemies trying to hunt you down. Do NOT cry: Maintain your happiness by eating chocolates, food and more. The more scared you are, you more chance you have to cry, and that can give up your position easily. Upgradable Abilities: Collect toys or items that enhance your Tricycle's appearance, paint and fix up to roam around your little world with. Story-driven Adventure: Unravel the mystery of the nightmare by discovering clues and progressing through a compelling narrative that unfolds as you navigate the dangerous play areas and more. Interactive Environment: Interact with toys and elements in the environment – toss objects to distract enemies, hide behind furniture, or trigger traps to clear your path. Find candy, food and more to keep you happy and away from crying - which can reveal your position and enemies will known your location. Survival elements with inventory system, hiding system, objectives and toys to help you find your beloved dolls. Find drawing books and pens which you are able to draw on walls and get creative, both to mark locations or for creativity. Fix, maintain, paint and customize your Tricycle to go around it in the world. Enemy That Listens: The enemies can hear your footsteps, your breathing and whenever you step on squeaky toys. Saving Levels System: Save your progress by having a little nap in save zones. Gut Wrecking Moments: Walking on squeaky toys can make noises that the enemy may hear, same as moving crates or knocking over objects. All these things can give away your position. Try to evade them or use them as your advantages. Fix, maintain and customize your Tricycle which you can use to drive around your world. Solve puzzles that require creative thinking and problem-solving skills. or use your time to play around a little with your favorite toys. You can also store your favorite toys in your vehicle's cart for later use. Find crayons which you can use to let out your creativity, on walls. but not everything is sunshine and rainbows .. something deadly awaits. Sometimes you have to navigate through very difficult and tense situations. Something is lurking in the shadows and it wants to stop you from getting your dolls back. Please note this is only Chapter 1: the Prologue of the game. The full game will be coming out soon which will include all chapters.
row.short_description: Baby Blues Nightmare - Prologue is a small taste of the horrors that awaits in this survival horror game where you play as a toddler going into a little adventure with your tricycle which you can fix, maintain and customize. Paddle, hide and survive but remember; try not to cry when you are scared..

row.name: Carl und Cari: Trubel in Tierstadt
row.detailed_description: Overview With Carl and Cari: Trubel in Tierstadt, we are trying to build a bridge. On the one hand, we want to provide children with information in a playful way, free from the pressure of tests and at their own pace. On the other hand, we want to record important information about the child's achievements and interests. Our solution to this problem? The 'Profile' system. The child doesn't have to do anything but play the game and doesn't even know that anything is being learned. While jobs that the child has enjoyed are saved as a 'profile' file on the PC at the end so that they can be sent to the parents/teachers. These 'profiles' are summaries of all relevant information about each job, which the parents/teachers can then use for evaluation. In the game itself, the player slips into the role of Carl or Cari and has to help Tierstadt prepare for a festival. You do this by helping the inhabitants of Tierstadt with their jobs. While helping them out, children learn about the various jobs in a playful way and then receive a letter of information for teachers or parents about all the jobs that the child found interesting. The aim of this is to counteract the lack of training and to educate children at an early age about possible future areas of interest. Game mechanics 2,5D Level: We try to arouse children's interest in the game primarily through its visuals. Inspired by titles such as Paper Mario, we have opted for our own 2.5D visuals, in which the player will spend most of their time. Minigames: We use mini-games to illustrate the usual everyday life of the jobs. We always represent several jobs in one category with a job that is more tangible for the children. Example: Ornamental plant cultivation, landscape gardener, cemetery gardener, orchard gardener... are all represented by the 'gardener' in our game. The mini-games are usually played in a first-person 2D view. Dialog: Dialogs are used to tell the story of the game. This is there to bind the player to something so that they try out even more jobs. Furthermore, dialogs are mainly used to explain game mechanics and to provide background knowledge about all the jobs. All dialogs are set to music to make it easier for children to read. There is also a picture and a name for each character. Map with progress: The map features a hub where players can move between levels. This is also our main narrative location for the game's story. Players can freely choose which level/job they want to play next on the map. As a reward for completing a job, the map is then embellished piece by piece and thus 'prepared' for the town festival, which is what everything revolves around. Help-Button System: Throughout the game, the player has a help button at the bottom left of the screen that gives him a tip in every situation when he clicks on it. This then tells him where or what he needs to do next. If you are playing Cari, the help button is represented by Carl and Vice Versa. Profile-Export-System: After each game, the child receives a 'profile' for the respective job. These profiles can be called up from the map and are always a sheet on which everything you need to know about the respective training occupation is summarized. If the child now clicks on 'Download', the respective profile is then saved on the desktop. These profiles are specifically addressed to the tutors/parents, so the child is simply informed that they should please show these profiles to their teachers/parents. They can now initiate educational measures and, for example, encourage interest in the areas in which the child has attracted positive attention. Didactic framework Who is the target group? The game is designed for kids aged 9 to 11. This corresponds to fourth and fifth grade students and is exactly the age at which children become aware of the job search. They know that they will have a job later on. However, they still have no idea what jobs are out there. What are the learning objectives? Das Kennenlernen von neuen Berufen, mit einem Einblick in den Berufsalltag und mögliche Berufsfelder für die Zukunft herauszufinden stehen bei uns im Vordergrund. Dabei vernachlässigen wir jedoch nicht den Lerneffekt für die Eltern/Lehrer*innen, welche natürlich mehr über die Interessen ihrer Kinder erfahren. What is the learning content? Getting to know new professions, gaining an insight into everyday working life and finding out possible career fields for the future are our main focus. However, we do not neglect the learning effect for the parents/teachers, who naturally learn more about their children's interests. Didactic conditions The game is used in a school context and is designed for use during one or more teaching units. Each child uses their personal school account, as the game statuses can be saved and continued in later lessons. In this way, children get to know all the training occupations and their training opportunities step by step.
row.short_description: Jump into Carl and Cari: Trubel in Tierstadt, an interactive educational game in which you have to help Tierstadt and its animal inhabitants with their jobs in order to save the big town festival. Get to know different training jobs and their training opportunities in a playful way.

row.name: Taking The Cross
row.detailed_description: Taking the Cross is an immersive historical action-adventure game that places you in the heart of the medieval world. You will embark on a perilous journey through the Holy Land, experiencing the challenges, battles, and pivotal moments of this tumultuous era. Engage in epic sieges, strategic warfare, and large battles as as you strive to reclaim sacred territories and achieve glory for your cause. With historically accurate settings, dynamic combat, and a rich narrative, Taking the Cross offers a thrilling blend of strategy, action, and storytelling, allowing players to rewrite history and shape the fate of the Crusades.
row.short_description: Taking the Cross allows you to control Christian Armies fighting for the holy land, inflict crushing defeats on your enemies and win glory for the faith!

row.name: Microtopia: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Microtopia: Prologue is a free version of Microtopia. In this automation game, you'll manage a colony of robot ants, design a network of transport trails, explore unique environments and expand your settlement. Your goal? To reproduce! Create young queens that will fly out during the nuptial flight to spread out to distant lands. Starting the cycle anew. PROLOGUE CONTENT 5 types of trails, including 2 logic trails 11 different buildings to build 5 kinds of ant castes to produce and interact with 2 islands to explore featuring 2 different biomes

row.name: Day of the Shell: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Day of the Shell: Prologue is the free version of Day of the Shell. It is a fast-paced tactical roguelite, where each turn is played in a single click. The gods have brought down their wrath on humanity, and only a few remote islands remain. A lonely monster huntress has risen to challenge and appease the gods, traveling through what's left of the world. PROLOGUE FEATURES 1 world, 13 islands to explore 2 weapons: revolver and crossbow 9 blessings and 12 relics to combine 7 runes to permanently improve the Huntress’s passive skills 5 unique enemies
row.short_description: Day of the Shell: Prologue is a “one-click, one-turn” tactical rogue-lite. In a shattered and flooded world, travel from island to island with only hope and a revolver, challenging and appeasing the gods.

row.name: Downstairs 2 Nightfall
row.detailed_description: Are you ready to step into a world of darkness and fear? “Downstairs 2 Nightfall,” will take you to the peak of suspense, horror and action. This unforgettable adventure begins in the relative calm of a safe house (safehouse) and then continues in an abandoned village where mysterious and frightening events take place behind the fog. Our main character must embark on this dangerous journey to find his missing lover Mary. At every step he will face his fears, uncover the secrets of the dark past and try to survive in the midst of unimaginable events. What begins in a safe house turns into a terrifying and complex labyrinth as the hope of saving Mary pulls him deeper into fear and despair. The game includes a weapon and a flashlight attached to the weapon, dangerous enemies on the map, notes you can read in some places, and bullets you can use for your weapon. In this unique experience: Moments of Suspense : Dangers lurk around dark corners and sudden surprises will keep you on your toes. You'll have to tread carefully and anticipate what awaits around every corner. Action-Packed Encounters : You will have to defend yourself and survive using a variety of weapons and tools. Each encounter will require adrenaline-fueled moments and strategic thinking. Mysterious Story : Discover the mysterious secrets behind Mary's disappearance and uncover the dark events of the past. The story will keep you in constant suspense and each new discovery will make the previous question more complex. Immersive Graphics and Sound Effects : The atmosphere of the game will completely immerse you. With detailed graphics and realistic sound effects, you will feel the moments of fear in your bones. From dark forests to abandoned houses, each location is meticulously designed and will draw you in. Do you dare to face your fears and uncover the darkest secrets? Get ready to descend into the deepest darkness with “Downstairs 2 Nightfall” and embark on a dark and terrifying adventure to save Mary. From the sheltered walls of the safe house to the deserted streets of the village, you must be on your guard at all times to survive. Mary's fate is in your hands.
row.short_description: Can you unlock the secrets of darkness and find out what happened to your girlfriend in Downstair 2 Nightfall, developed by the dreamers who harbor the mysterious secrets of history? I don't think so...

row.name: Skeleton Hell
row.detailed_description: Skeleton Hell is a cooperative horror game that takes place in the depths of a underground sanctum where the player's skeletons have been imprisoned. Players must work together and use their bones in order to find their human organs and reclaim their mortality. In their skeleton state, players are able to employ unique abilities to throw their bones or thow one another in order to solve puzzles and progress through the sanctum! Throw your bones! 🦴 As a skeleton, bones are your currency. Use bones to interact with the envrionment, distract enemies and give other players a helping hand. However you must be careful. Bones are also your livelihood - the more you lose, the closer you will be to death! 🦴 Avoid deadly enemies! 🦑 The skeleton hell is filled with deadly enemies, each with their own behaviours and patterns. Avoid these monterous creatures as you journey through hell - otherwise you might just end up back in the cell you started in! 💀 Find your heart and reclaim your humanity! ♥ In this game, each player must find their heart hidden somewhere in the procedurally generated sanctum. You will have to search every corner of the small dungeon to find a heart - your ticket to the overworld. If you are feeling generous, you can even communicate with your friends and help them find their own hearts (if you are so fortunate to have found your own). You may also sabotage them and lead them into dangeous traps while luring them with the promise of a heart 😈 Once everyone has a heart and is ready to escape, you must quickly ascend to the top of the dungeon before time runs out. Do you have what it takes to survive? Other Gameplay Features Proximity Chat 🗣 Steam Achievements and Leaderboard 🏆 Good Vibez 😎 No limit on player count!💀 (But we only tested the game with 4 players 😅, Your mileage may vary!) Join our community discord! The Triple Calavera team is eager to learn more about how we could improve Skeleton Hell with your ideas! Join our community discord and chat with us about your experience - both the good and the bad!
row.short_description: Skeleton Hell is a cooperative horror game where you and your friends must work together to find your missing organs and reclaim your humanity. Using your skeletal form, you can solve puzzles and collaborate with each other to escape, while avoiding the dangers that lurk within!

row.name: Too Angry To Die
row.detailed_description: Ever heard of someone being 'too angry to die'? Meet Gideon Rageblade , the world-renowned warrior whose unbridled rage was legendary. So legendary, in fact, that people believed his fury made him immortal. Turns out, they were wrong. Gideon just died. Oops. But death is just a minor inconvenience for someone like Gideon. Now, in the afterlife, he has a new gig. He's been hired as a lieutenant for Varkul, the Lord of Torment. His mission? Clear out the plague of rebellion from The Dead Lands. Gideon might have died, but his rage lives on. And he's still too angry to die—again. Furious Clicker Action Unleash Gideon's legendary rage with every click as you obliterate endless waves of enemies. Infinite Enemies Battle through countless foes in The Dead Lands, with each wave becoming more challenging and absurd. Epic Boss Battles Take on powerful bosses that appear after you make your presence felt, with the kill requirement doubling each time. Who knew the afterlife had level scaling? Unlock Powerful Perks Give Gideon some extra oomph with temporary perks. They’re like coffee for his rage—short-lived but absolutely game-changing. Loot Drops Galore Earn drops just for playing OR for slaying bosses. From common to rare, these items can be sold on the Steam Marketplace —because even in the afterlife, loot matters.
row.short_description: Take control of Gideon Rageblade in this action-filled clicker game. Click to destroy endless waves of enemies, face epic bosses, and earn unique drops. Embrace the rage and irony in a quest that proves dying once was just a fluke—he's too angry to die again.

row.name: Crypto Rush
row.detailed_description: This game is a parody created under the influence of the hype of crypto airdrops in clickers. In this game you also need to poke on the screen in anticipation of a reward. Click on a coin to mine coins, sell coins for other coins, buy video cards to automate mining. Buy chests for mined coins to try to get new types of coins or look for them in the community on the trading platform or by exchanging with friends. No blockchain was used in this game. How to play Click on big image of coin to fill hashrate field. As soon as you fill it up you'll get a coin. Exchange this coin In 'Exchange' tab for StableCoin of MainCoin. Buy video card for StableCoins in the 'Farm' tab to automize mining process. Buy chests in the 'Shop' tab to get new Coins to mine. Set coin to mine from your coin collection in the 'Collection' tab. Once you have mined a certain number of coins, a “halving” will occur, so the required hashrate to mine the coin will double. After several 'Halvings' requred hashrate may become too hight, so try to use other coin from your coin collection(each coin has it's own 'Halvings'). You can get coins from the chests in the 'Shop' tab or exchange it with friends/find on market.

row.detailed_description: このゲームは、大正時代を舞台に、「怪異」と呼ばれる謎の存在が起こす怪奇事件解決に奔走する主人公の「とある一夜」を再現した3D探索ゲームです。 とある事件の調査の帰りに、見えない何かによって街に閉じ込められてしまった主人公たち。 主人公をサポートする、妖刀に宿る神「八島童子」と共に、街から脱出を図る主人公たちですが……。 果たして貴方は街から脱出できるのか。そしてこの怪事件の真相に辿り着けるか……！ ゲームの進め方 街を探索しながら、謎解きやアイテムをゲットしていく アイテムをゲットすると、通れなかった道が通れるようになったりする 制限時間内に元の世界に通ずる出口のある場所「サクヤ神社」にたどり着けるか……？ 操作方法 PS4コントローラー ===インゲーム=== 攻撃：R1ボタン 移動：左スティック カメラ移動：右スティック アイテム取得：□ボタン UIを開：オプションボタン ===UI=== 十字キー or 左スティック：UI移動 決定：○ボタン 戻る：xボタン UIを閉じる：オプションボタン PC ===インゲーム=== 攻撃：左クリック 移動：WASDキー カメラ移動：マウス移動 アイテム取得： Fキー UIを開く：Tキー ===UI=== 十字キー or 左スティック：WASDキー 決定：左クリック 戻る： 左クリック UIを閉じる：Tキー

ABOUT THE DEVELOPER I’m a solo developer starting to learn how to create games and releasing them on steam. With time I hope to create better games. But for now perhaps just one other person can have some fun with my games while I continue my journey. The game is completely free!

row.name: One's Own Exile
row.detailed_description: A Short Narrative Experience One's Own Exile was initially developed for a Game Jam competition. It is a short narrative experience that tells the tale of Sybil , an outcast in the region where she lives, which when pursued by the local guards needs to find a way to escape a tragic fate by concealing her identity. The game reflects upon what builds one’s identity, values and memories. How painful it is to sacrifice everything you hold dear, if the purpose is survival? Which one is better: the pain of unceasing struggle or the death that follows failure? Persecution and sacrifice Is it better to die or to live in pain? Sybil was discovered; living hidden isn’t an option anymore. The narrative follows the story of a protagonist who, to escape persecution and the threat of death, needs to take all possible measures to trespass the country’s border. Look for items that can help you in some way; Observe the local customs in order to pass as one of them; Find ways to conceal your identity, whatever the cost may be; Lie, deceive and run away. Do what you must to survive. Face Difficult Decisions Sybil holds items and customs that are precious to her and her culture, and it's up to you to decide how much you want to abandon in pursuit of survival. Depending on how much you observe, and sacrifice, the outcome changes... But is every outcome desirable? Is a price too steep to pay? One's Own Exile features multiple endings, that change according to your decisions and to how much information you obtain during the game. With 8 different endings , see if you can reach the desired conclusion to Sybil's fate.
row.short_description: Follow Sybil in her pursuit for survival, having to sacrifice everything - her culture, her identity, her values - to achieve a single objective: escape from a place that is constantly trying to kill her. A short game about persecution and identity.
row.notes: This product has content typically considered mature. This includes depictions of violence, scenes of death and self-harm.

row.name: KnightLight

Use the suit to protect you from the dangers of this world, and get out of it when you need to be nimble! Once you have explored the world to its fullest, activate the speedrun timer to test your knowledge of the world and see how fast you can make it through! Explore an abandoned world Channel your magic to unlock new abilities Find all of lost signifliers Race through the game to improve your speedrun time DIGIPEN BOILERPLATE - for each game This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

row.name: AstroCam
row.detailed_description: AstroCam is a camera application for daily observing and taking pictures of the night sky. Just by connecting your PlayerOne™︎ astro camera to your computer with USB cable, you can watch live preview images without much hustle. Once connected, you can adjust various parameters provided by camera on the fly for better images. It is not just for live previewing but also capturing raw images from camera. Most of operations can be done not only by mouse but also keyboard/gamepad. Supported cameras - PlayerOne™︎ Cooled/Planetary cameras (STARVIS/STARVIS2 recommended) Features - Real-time preview of debayered raw images from camera - Live histogram - Preview image adjustment (Low-threshold/Gamma) - Horizontal/Vertical flip in preview - Camera parameter adjustment including TEC cooling - Capture images in DNG format containing unmodified RAW8/RAW16 data from camera - Capture debayered JPG alongside with DNG for convenience - Keyboard/Gamepad control support (including SteamDeck) - Multiple camera selection from menu - Automatically save/restore camera configurations NOTE: DNG file can be opened with RawTherapee
row.short_description: AstroCam is a camera application for daily observing and taking pictures of the night sky, which works with PlayerOne™︎ astro cameras. It features real-time debayered preview and JPG+DNG capturing.

row.name: I SUPPOSE
row.detailed_description: A story of a simple walk home, with a sprinkling of intrusive thoughts. Make a few choices, decide what's best, and please, try not to overthink. This is a (fairly) abstract visual novel which explores themes of anxiety, worry, and spiralling. It's just something I wanted to make. Length: 15-20 minutes.
row.short_description: A story of a simple walk home, with a sprinkling of intrusive thoughts. Make a few choices, decide what's best, and please, try not to overthink.
row.notes: The game contains depictions of anxiety, depression and references to injury and death. Players with sensitivity to these topics may want to avoid playing.

In Bass Defense's rhythm-based and action-packed 'Soundwave' game mode, you must hit the correct buttons in time with the music to clear your NMYs and save your base with the help of your upgradable power-ups or your sense of rhythm. row.name: Plague of Athens VR
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in the gripping saga of Plague of Athens VR, a VR journey that transports you back to the darkest days of the first recorded pandemic in 429 BCE. Step into the sandals of Nikos of Athens, a young physician challenged with treating countless Athenians struck by the plague. As Athens descends into chaos, the VR narrative unfolds through the eyes of Nikos. The dilemmas that Nikos encounters shatter his world view, prompting him to question everything he holds dear. His faith in Apollo, the divine healer, is tested, as is the meaning of his Hippocratic Oath. Winner of the prestigious Reimagine Education Gold Medal, Plague of Athens VR is an immersive journey into a pivotal chapter in human history. Whether you're a history enthusiast, curious about ancient epidemics, or a lover of gripping stories, 'Plague of Athens VR' promises an unforgettable voyage into the past. Now available for Meta Quest, explore a world both ancient and hauntingly relevant to our own times.
row.short_description: Plague of Athens tells the story of Nikos of Athens, a physician during history’s first recorded pandemic, 429 BCE, who struggles to treat the multitude who fall ill during this world-upending ordeal.

row.name: The Museum of Hauntology
row.detailed_description: The Museum of Hauntology is a VR environment in PC VR format. It is a limited sandbox game intended to make the most of the experiential potential of VR. Built with Unity's High Definition Render Pipeline, the Museum attempts to push what's possible, while retaining playability. The Museum features several different 'exhibitions'; each can transport the player to a different location to see where items in the exhibition came from. There's no objective in this game. Just like a real museum; take your time and enjoy your visit. But if you do enjoy a challenge, try to unlock the Music Room by finding the hidden four-digit code.
row.short_description: The Museum of Hauntology stands as a monument to a future that never was. Featuring counterfactual digital artefacts drawn from an alternative 1970s that did not quite happen. The work is intended to prompt contemplation of the recent past and the type of future in which we now find ourselves.

row.short_description: '7th Domain' is a horizontal version action game derived from Roguelike Metroidvania combined with treasure grinding gameplay. You will play a child of destiny who repairs the world and finds the truth of the broken world. You will grow in battle and challenge the unknown and hidden forces.

row.name: IMPACT
row.detailed_description: IMPACT – Your Journey to the Moon Begins Here! Dive into IMPACT, an immersive sci-fi game that takes you to the Moon. Build and manage your own lunar base, generating valuable scientific data used by the European Space Agency (ESA) to train a real AI that will one day land on the Moon. Experience how your decisions directly influence the future of lunar exploration! Key Features: 🌑 Build Your Lunar Base: Construct a state-of-the-art lunar colony. From solar power plants and living quarters to research labs – plan and build the infrastructure necessary to survive and thrive on the Moon. 🚀 Explore New Technologies: Discover and develop groundbreaking technologies to help you overcome the Moon's harsh conditions. Use these technologies to enhance your base and unlock new opportunities for lunar exploration. 🌌 Overcome Extraterrestrial Challenges: Face the unique challenges of the Moon. Whether it's meteor storms, moonquakes, or other cosmic hazards – you must always stay one step ahead to protect your base and crew. 🔍 Generate Scientific Data: As you build and expand your base, you generate valuable data about the Moon. This data is used by ESA to train an AI that will improve the safety and efficiency of future lunar landings. 🌟 Shape the Future of Lunar Research: Your actions and decisions in IMPACT have direct consequences for real-world space research. Help pave the way for the next generation of space missions and the exploration and colonization of the Moon. 🎮 Unique Gameplay Experience: IMPACT combines challenging gameplay with a deep narrative. Experience the journey of your crew, their triumphs and setbacks, and feel like part of an epic mission. 🛰 Join a Global Community: Connect with players from around the world, share your achievements, and collaborate on the exploration of the Moon. Your contributions can make a real difference! Why Play IMPACT? IMPACT is not just a game – it’s a mission. By playing IMPACT, you actively contribute to the collection of data that will make future lunar missions safer and more efficient. Experience the excitement of space exploration, master complex challenges, and become part of a global project that will expand the boundaries of our knowledge about the Moon. Join IMPACT and start your journey to the Moon. Your adventures await – and the future of lunar research is in your hands!
row.short_description: IMPACT is an immersive sci-fi game set on the Moon. Build and manage a lunar base, generating valuable scientific data along the way. This data is used by the European Space Agency to train a real AI that will eventually land on the Moon.

row.name: VocabVan
row.detailed_description: Whether you're a beginner or looking to polish your language skills, VocabVan is your perfect companion on the road to fluency. Start your journey today and transform the way you learn languages! Extensive Vocabulary: Dive into a rich database of over 15,000 Spanish and French words, ensuring comprehensive language coverage. Multiple Game Modes: Choose from three exciting game modes, each crafted to enhance your learning experience and keep you engaged. Contextual Learning: Each word comes with clear definitions and example sentences, helping you understand and remember vocabulary in context. Interactive Quizzes: Test your knowledge with multiple choice questions that challenge your memory and reinforce your learning. User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy a smooth and intuitive gaming experience, designed to make learning enjoyable and accessible for all ages. row.name: Retail Company Simulator: Prologue

In this game, you'll have a limited amount of contracts.] This is a first-person simulation game where you run a retail company. Expand your humble store into a huge retail company. Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products, meet customer needs, and never let your customers leave the store empty-handed. Hire new workers, expand your store, and enjoy the growth of your retail company.

row.name: Malcatras' Maiden
row.detailed_description: On a particularly isolated estate lies a grand mansion that serves as a haven for poor lost girls taken in as daughters by the benevolent Lady Francesca Malcatras to serve as her esteemed maids in a life of privilege. Yet, as the high expectations and frequent disciplining weigh heavily on the loyalty of the girls, the long-held commandment of the manor is questioned; Are these walls surrounding the paradise truly there to keep her daughters safe from the world? Accept the tender beauty of despair, pain, and love. This is MALMAID . Features: Linear Visual Novel - See the world from the eyes of Liliana Malcatras , a painfully loyal maid, who pledged to serve her Lady to the ends of the earth. A Psychosexual Thriller with a queer and trans cast, consisting of 60,000 words, 4-5 hours of playtime. Doomed Toxic Yuri - Experience how the overlap of sexual tension and physical conflict risks driving the sisters apart. Superpowered Maids , ready to serve their master with their lives as they partake in fierce battles with mystical powers. Lively animated sprites so you can see the puppy girl Panic in real time. An original soundtrack that shifts from dark ambience to breakcore to elevate the atmosphere.
row.short_description: MALCATRAS' MAIDEN is a toxic yuri visual novel for adults about trauma, bonds, family, and sisterhood.

row.notes: Malcatras' Maiden is a game for adult audiences only. This work contains intense themes of toxic relationships, manipulation, child abuse, regular abuse, dubiously consensual sexual acts, incestuous themes and explicit bloody acts of heavy violence, including death and murder.

row.name: Bat Blitz

row.short_description: Bat Blitz is a fast paced, top down shooter, roguelike where you have to kill bats to stay alive as long as possible.

row.name: Fable Grove
row.detailed_description: Dive into a relaxing yet captivating pixel clicker game that brings the satisfaction of popping bubble wrap to the world of monster hunting. In this unique game, you’ll explore different weather conditions to capture a wide variety of monsters. Each type of monster appears in specific weather and zones, adding an element of strategy to your clicking frenzy. Keep your eyes open for Shiny Monsters, as catching one of these will grant you a Steam Marketplace Item to trade with your friends! Collect all of the shinies and achieve Grove Greatness. Capture up to 55 monsters and complete your Monster Log! Click until they are caught and get experience points for each click and catch! Level up over time to increase your chance of seeing elusive shiny monsters. Occasionally you'll spot shiny monsters in the wild! Catch one of these and be rewarded with a Steam Marketplace item. Trade with your friends until you complete your Shiny Monster Log. Not all monsters were created equal. Find Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary monsters - each appearing in different weather and zones. Some even only show up at night time... Five different weather conditions and three zones keeps you on your toes as you try to catch every monster! Each click of a monster increases your leaderboard score which resets every month. Stay in the top 5% of clickers to find 3 exclusive monsters!
row.short_description: Experience the addictive joy of a chilled, pixel clicker game where capturing different monsters in varied weather feels as fun as popping bubble wrap. Level up by clicking monsters or passively over time, increasing your chance to encounter rare Shinys that reward you with Steam Marketplace items.

This is the highly anticipated successor to the worst game on Playstation from 2019. COOP MODE Try the epic extraction challenge across the world that you probably won't survive. You and your friends have to safely transport a huge golden ball from Morocco to China, while the mafia is trying to steal it from you. TIME ATTACK MODE Become a time champion by getting the best speedster records in the time attack mode. This is where you will use your best precision skills to get the best records. PARTY MODE Ready for more fun? Fight against or with your friends in crazy party modes by using one keyboard! Stop the trucks, rooftop master, obstacles and many more to come! Are you ready for some more racing bros?
row.short_description: Welcome back to the RACING BROS World! Are you ready to get own4d by the Mafia in this physic based piece of chaos?

row.name: Unstable Star
row.detailed_description: Journey through the galaxy as the hero Jaughn, which is totally not a respelling of John, and fight your way against the dreaded Intragalactic Coalition! As a former Border Guard for the Intragalactic Coalition, Jaughn quickly becomes embroiled in an unexpected Rebellion to save the galaxy. Join a colorful cast of characters and embark on a lighthearted yet action-packed journey of redemption. Lead the Rebellion into victory! Unstable Star is a galactic arcade-style, third-person space-shooter packed with action, comedy, and galactic salvation. Explore the immersive story: Play as Jaughn and his new-found friends as they fight to stop the Intragalactic Coalition from destroying the galaxy and watch as the action unfolds through colorful cutscenes and in-game dialogue. Fight waves of enemies with upgradeable loadouts: Unlock new weapons and abilities such as phase shift or the laser gun to help defeat enemies and destroy environmental obstacles such as asteroids. Customize your loadout before each level to play to your style, and fight the waves of enemies as they approach your ship. Take down bosses in boss battles: Complete levels and objectives to progress the story to the two boss battles in-game. Uncover who is behind the nefarious plans of the Intragalactic Coalition, and take them down! Break out of jail, join a team, start a rebellion, and call upon the galaxy to prevent its total annihilation before it’s too late! About us: Developed by Heatwave Studio (formerly 25PercentGames), a student game development group based out of Arizona State University that aims to complete and publish one game each year. The game is a completely volunteer effort from an interdisciplinary team of students from across the academic and creative spectrum. We hope you enjoy what we made!
row.short_description: Journey through Proximus-3 as Jaughn (pronounced “John”), and embark on a lighthearted and action-packed journey of redemption, quickly becoming embroiled in an unexpected Rebellion to save the galaxy.
row.notes: Unstable Star follows the story of a resistance in a war against an intergalactic empire, featuring fights between spaceships and explosions. The story also explicitly states that the empire's actions would cause mass genocide of a solar system, although this is ultimately prevented and no graphic deaths are shown on screen.

row.name: Dungeon Tycoon: Prologue

row.name: Phat Phrog Clicker
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Phat Phrog Clicker, the adorable idle clicker game that will captivate your heart and keep you clicking for more! This free-to-play adventure invites you to immerse yourself in a world brimming with cute, collectible creatures that you can earn, trade, and collect. In Phat Phrog Clicker, every 30 or so minutes you’ll be rewarded with a new, charming Steam inventory creature. Each creature is uniquely designed with delightful features, ensuring your collection is as diverse as it is adorable. With over 25 collectible phrogs, your collection will always have something new and exciting. Legendary skins, which can be crafted, add an extra layer of allure and customization to your collection. Every skin you discover becomes a pet in your own private zoo, adding to the charm and uniqueness of your collection. The fun doesn’t stop there – these creatures aren’t just for show! Engage in a vibrant marketplace where you can trade, buy, and sell your prized possessions, strategically building a collection that stands out among your friends and competitors. Experience the joy of collecting as you unlock rare and exclusive creatures, each adding to the allure of your inventory. With simple, intuitive mechanics, Phat Phrog Clicker is perfect for players of all ages. Whether you’re a casual gamer looking to pass the time or a dedicated collector aiming for the top, this game offers endless fun and excitement. Join the community of Phat Phrog Clicker enthusiasts today and start your journey towards becoming the ultimate cute creature collector. The world of adorable critters awaits you – are you ready to click your way to the top?
row.short_description: Join the community of Phat Phrog Clicker enthusiasts today and become the ultimate cute creature collector! Earn 28 unique Steam inventory skins, dropping every 30 minutes of gameplay. These skins can be traded or sold on the Steam Marketplace. Can you collect them all?
