row.short_description: The evil demons from outside the domain are beginning to stir again, and the player embarks on a journey with the important task of eradicating the evil demons.

row.name: 刀剑神魔录
row.detailed_description: 刀剑神魔录游戏特色 样式独特！超酷飞宝展现个性 《刀剑神魔录》有着各种各样独特的飞行坐骑，虚空古龙、幻彩龙王、月神小猫等各种式样的飞行装备让你浑身发散着水晶般清透蓝色、妩媚光芒的瀚海明灯，带你自由自在遨游长空，俯视万木争荣的蔽日森林，拔地参天的独秀青峰，奔流不息的浩浩洪流。一路上景色各具风情如诗如画，美不胜收。 电影人物 全3D剧情代入 《刀剑神魔录》人物设定经过多次修改，风格自成一派。游戏采用细腻写实的画风，人物造型侠气与仙气兼具，没有不伦不类的元素杂糅，而是具有东方幻想气息，符合现代人对于国风的想象与审美。游戏的剧情片段将通过电影式的3D动画呈现，各色各样的NPC将带玩家领略一段全新的修仙故事。 婚恋互动 绚丽战斗特效 次世代技术的运用，让游戏战斗更真实。角色每个关节灵活运动，招式流畅、衔接合理；战斗特效经过细腻处理，绚丽而不会过分浮夸；动作创新，告别站桩作战。 同城玩家在游戏世界中擦肩而过会发生什么？有一场真实精致的婚礼会是什么体验？《刀剑神魔录》将从细节玩法入手，让玩家都有机会体验到怦然心动的邂逅，以及携手同“游”的情谊。
row.short_description: 新派超写实风格3D国创仙侠手游《刀剑神魔录》，全3D打造仙城蓬莱、4大悬浮仙岛，一山一木均精雕细琢，致力还原上古神话中两仪二圣、四凶四灵等数十种猛兽，皆可追寻猎杀夺取宝物，更有悟道、天命、道德等原汁原味的修行玩法，为你带来更有仙味的修仙体验。

row.name: Scarecrow Tactics
row.detailed_description: Game Introduction: 'Scarecrow Tactics' is a strategy card game where players use scarecrow cards to deceive each other about the number of their soldiers. With unique yet simple rules, strategic scarecrows, and quirky, hideous mercenaries, players must survive a dreadful battle where losing means being devoured by water deers! Game Features: This game targets players who enjoy mental battles that require a mix of luck and intense psychological warfare, this game challenges you to strategically place your soldier cards to win region battles while using scarecrow cards to deceive your opponents about your soldier numbers and gain additional points. Each scarecrow card has a different ability, and as you play, you can collect a variety of scarecrows and mercenaries, adding to the fun.
row.short_description: A strategy card game where players use scarecrow cards to deceive each other about the number of their soldiers. With unique yet simple rules, strategic scarecrows, and quirky, hideous mercenaries, players must survive a dreadful battle where losing means being devoured by Water Deers!

row.name: Shifter
row.detailed_description: In Shifter, you enter a mysterious world filled with ruins. Explore this strange world using portals to shift between the light and dark dimensions. Navigate the world, transforming it as you progress. Illuminate the void to reveal what has been abandoned in the shadows. And remember, don't linger in the darkness... Mind and world bending puzzles. Stylized and warped monochromatic graphics. Eerie, atmospheric soundtrack. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Explore this strange world using portals to shift between the light and dark dimensions. Navigate the world, transforming it as you progress. Illuminate the void to reveal what has been abandoned in the shadows. And remember, don't linger in the darkness...

row.name: THROUGH
row.detailed_description: Explore various dungeons, fight powerful enemies and recolect treasures in this exciting online multiplayer game! Will you be able to overcome the dungeons of Through with your friends? Or will you get lost along the way? COOPERATE! Play with your friends to reach the end of each of the proposed levels. The more players, the more fun and laughter! Remember that friendly fire is a reality. DISCOVER! Each level contains different paths and options so you can enjoy them with all the character archetypes available. This allows you and your friends to enjoy different experiences in each level depending on your character choices. BATTLE! Whether you prefer to fight alongside your friends or against them, it's always relaxing to take a few hits (and enjoy a moment of each impact). You just have to open one of the Arenas or try the Battle mode, similar to Adventure but against your companions. SCORE! There are shiny little things scattered throughout the levels for you and your buddies to search like good treasure diggers (dwarven folk approves) and get the best score possible. Remember that if you play in battle mode, your score will depend on how well you compete against your teammates! You will embody one of these adventurers in your next exploration in Through. Each character has their own advantages and disadvantages, so choose carefully! As a fierce dwarf, wield your ax to vanquish foes and fill your rage meter. When full, use one of two special abilities for enhanced resistance or damage. Be cautious, your attacks might hit teammates, but we won't stop you. An agile archer keeps a safe distance from enemies, as long as you have arrows. You can retrieve fired arrows or reload at ammo boxes. His keen senses detect nearby traps, allowing you to warn teammates or let chaos reign. Dressed in a grey robe and hat, the sage wields a fire-sparking staff, channeling years of wisdom to cast fireballs. However, using his magic might accidentally scorch his companions too. A tough dwarf with a shield and hammer leads the charge into battle. He can shield himself from damage and kick to push others away. His special ability creates a protective bubble to prevent damage to himself and allies. The ancient dwarven ruins are now overrun by beasts, who have made this place their home. They won't make it easy for you. You can engage these creatures in combat to defeat them, or try to avoid them, but be careful. They can band together and become a significant threat. In this world, a great danger lurks in the shadows. No one knows where they came from, but one thing is certain: they have been sent to prevent adventurers from succeeding. Play on a variety of team-based PvP maps, where the dark ones must stop the adventurers from completing their quest.
row.short_description: Through is a multiplayer arcade hack and slash with social cooperative mechanics in which players face challenges in different dungeons to reach the exit.

row.name: Ciggy World
row.detailed_description: Ciggy World is a clicker game where you click on a cigarette to earn rewards! In Ciggy World, every click brings you closer to a treasure trove of drops, or butts. Every 3, you'll receive a special ciggy drop, each one crafted by our Devs or by our chain smoking community on Discord. Join us and become part of the Ciggy World family, where every puff is a step towards something amazing! You know what we say at Ciggy World 'one small puff for man, one giant wheez for mankind'. Experience the thrill of Ciggy World, a delightful parody of the classic Ciggy World theme park, brought to you with a twist of nostalgia and a wink to the golden age of big tobacco. Come, hang out, and let's build a world where every click brings a little more smoke into the world.
row.short_description: Ciggy World is a clicker game where you click on a cigarette to earn rewards! In Ciggy World, every click brings you closer to a treasure trove of drops, or butts.

row.name: Bleeding Roots
row.detailed_description: Bleeding Roots is a short horror walking simulator taking place throughout the seasons. Water the plants in your garden, learn about them, and grow along them over time. Immerse yourself in a story about loss, grief and obsession. The controls are simple, moving the character through tank controls and reading up on the environment with an interact key. Having gone through some hard times recently, you find solace in tending to your garden. While searching for new books on botanics, you stumble upon one that you haven’t seen before. It is somehow enthralling, almost as if it’s calling you. As you begin reading, it quickly becomes clear that it speaks of alternative ways of taking care of plants. It fills you with a feeling of unease, but… maybe it’ll grow into a new friend.
row.short_description: Bleeding Roots is a free fifteen minute horror game about a man taking care of his plants throughout the seasons.
row.notes: Includes depiction of suicide and mild self harm.

row.name: There was something in that room
row.detailed_description: Move through the rooms of the lab in this short but replayable horror game. Debug the computers in each room, watch out for errors, and fix sabotages. Make sure you always know where you are... and where other things are. Hey, you can also play sounds in different rooms! Why would they add that feature? There is nothing in that room... STORY The MANF lab has just made a groundbreaking discovery in biology! You don't care, of course, you get paid the same as before. Not much. Your job is easy though, each night you come back to the lab and make sure all the computers work just fine. Easy, right? But things have changed these days. You start hearing sounds, and you start to worry. You heard some guys talking about a security breach... But hey! They added a cool feature where you can play sounds in rooms! So much fun! GAMEPLAY Move through rooms while fixing the computers and make sure you know exactly where everything is at all times. Watch out for sabotages that demand you to fix them immediately, and stay put to concentrate and hear where specific sounds come from. Your contract runs out in just a few days, you aren't going to leave now, are you? FEATURES Minimalist gameplay, with few movement options Computers that you need to check and debug to make sure everything is ok Ability to lure living things away by making sounds in different rooms Sabotages that you must go and deal with immediately Short game, but infinitely replayable
row.short_description: Move through the rooms of the lab in this short but replayable horror game. Debug the computers in each room, watch out for errors, and fix sabotages. Make sure you always know where you are... and where other things are.

row.name: Fantasmagorie
row.detailed_description: “It’s simple enough to make the puppets move–that’s not what makes them special. You see, when children watch our shows, they believe what they’re seeing is real. To them, the puppets are alive.” Journey through a distorted puppet theatre held together by the fragile mind of a grieving puppet master. Take the stage as Viviette—a music box ballerina who's mysteriously free from the puppet master's control. Danger looms around every corner, filling the workshop, backstage, and stage of this theatre with perilous threats. With only a needle and thread by your side, you must swing, climb, and manipulate objects to progress, all while evading twisted and terrifying puppets along the way. Follow the guidance of a mysterious spirit to uncover fragmented memories from the past, revealing more about the one pulling the strings. Shatter the delusion and uncover the truth behind it all. Fantasmagorie is a free 30 minute narrative game created by a team of students. Uncover the story by exploring 3 levels and encountering 3 bosses along the way. Your download will include the full game experience, with a save system and settings for sound/graphics. STEAMDECK USERS: Please enable Proton Experimental before playing for the game to operate correctly! NOTICE: If your game runs slowly (or slow movement of character) please go to Settings in the Main Menu and turn down the video settings!
row.short_description: Journey through a distorted theatre held together by the fragile mind of a grieving puppet master. With only a needle and thread, traverse through this world and evade twisted and terrifying creations. Shatter the delusion and unravel the truth behind it all.

row.name: Skull Stompers
row.detailed_description: The most offensive game ever, take your feelings and SHOVE THEM UP YOUR ASS! Play as Trump and the other 14 playable Skull Stomper characters! Which some are unlocked by beating levels. Each playable character has unique stats!! 40+ lines of dialogue a piece! 7 unique worlds! 2 BOSSES! A SpeedRunners dream! Race against Eagle to beat your previous best times! Approximately 3 hours of gameplay! Man this game must be a million dollars?! WAIT -- WHAT DO YOU MEAN IT'S FREE?!
row.short_description: Have you noticed how everyone acts like whoever is most offended, wins? Society bends over backward for fragile feelings—but not here. Introducing the most offensive game ever—where nobody cares about your feelings. Shove ‘em up your ASS!
row.notes: Lots of gore and carnage

row.name: Plumber Survivors: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Add full game to wish list IRON WORLD About the Game Prologue includes Heroes Plumber and Fireman Perks Arena cemetery Quick sessions (up to 30 min) Characters attack and cast spells automatically Choose between the Plumber, the Fireman, the Builder and others Dozens of active skills Collect crystals to upgrade your heroes Unlock new difficulty and game modes
row.short_description: Plumber Survivors is arena action game with roguelike elements. Parody game of popular vampire genre. You play as powerful guys led by Plumber. Grab you plunger tight and plunge into the fight.

row.name: Reverse: 1999
row.detailed_description: On the last day of 1999, the 'Storm' fell upon the world. You witnessed an era reversed beneath the rising raindrops. Defying all reasons, what unfolds in front of you is the world of an era long past. As the Timekeeper, observer of eras, you are free to travel through these eras after each 'Storm.' With the aid of Sonetto, a powerful Arcanist and ally from the Foundation, your mission is to travel through eras to where the 'Storm' is most active, find other Arcanists who can sense the coming 'Storm,' and save them from being 'sifted out' of the timeline. ▶▶Stunning Visuals Blending Retro and Modern Aesthetics◀◀ Step into the mysterious alt-history animated by unique visual elements that blend Pop Art, classical oil painting, and more art styles in history. ▶▶A Cinematic Adventure across the 20th Century◀◀ From the Roaring '20s to the turn of the millennium, you will embark on a journey across time and space, and uncover the truth about the 'Storm' and the mystery of the year 1999. ▶▶Full English Voice Acting with Authentic Accents◀◀ Immerse yourself in ages past. Enjoy a story performed by diverse cast of voice actors with British, Italian, French, and other accents. ▶▶Fantastic Arcanists from Different Times and Regions◀◀ People once called them 'mages,' 'wizards,' and 'freaks.' Now they live in uneasy coexistence with regular humans … But who are the Arcanists, really? ▶▶Weave Arcane Incantations to Attain Glorious Victories◀◀ Build your team, cast spells, and use gorgeous arcane skills to defeat your enemies. Begin your exciting adventure through time in this all-new RPG.
row.short_description: Reverse: 1999 is a 20th Century Time-Travel Strategic RPG developed by Bluepoch. As the Timekeeper, the observer of eras, you will embark on a journey across time and space, from the Roaring '20s to the turn of the millennium, uncovering the truth about the 'Storm' and the mystery of the year 1999.

row.name: Haunting Memories
row.detailed_description: Haunting Memories is a psychological horror, walking simulator and platforming game. You play as a middle-aged man struggling with mental health. He is an artist, specializing in oil portraits, but has not gotten any jobs in the last year. He has recently divorced his wife and she has taken their young daughter and moved out of the house, since he can’t take care of himself. His mental health is worsening since he became alone in the big mansion. To deal with his inner “demons”, he tried to seek help in the mansion's library, where the previous owner left a large collection of occult and spiritual books. This put him on a path toward ritualistic sacrifices, contaminating and blurring his memories, and releasing various creatures into his home and mind.
row.short_description: Haunting Memories is a psychological horror, walking simulator, platforming and puzzle game. You play as a middle aged man that has made a deal with the devil and must now face the consequences. The game takes place in an old mansion with occult themes and a rich story ready to be uncovered.
row.notes: The game contains blood on the walls, indicating some form of previous violence, along with bottles of alcohol in the mansion.

row.name: NIGHTMARE BREAK
row.detailed_description: 'NIGHTMARE BREAK' is a single-player 3D action adventure game that pursues the 'fun of swordplay action.' Although it consists of only one bleak stage, there are enemies to defeat and fragmented stories to discover. You control a knight wielding a great sword and aim to escape from the nightmare world by clearing the stage. There are no growth elements such as equipment or builds, but you can become stronger by picking up items scattered along the way. Although strong enemies await, there are also checkpoints, so you can enjoy the game with peace of mind. The Nightmare Lore No one knows the lore. The Challenger got two choices. Kill the Nightmare Lord and will be the Lord myself. Or must break this nightmare.
row.short_description: 'NIGHTMARE BREAK' is a single-player 3D action adventure game that pursues the 'fun of sword fighting action'. Conquer stages filled with powerful enemies and fragmented stories, and aim to escape from the nightmare world.

row.name: Do the Cat
row.detailed_description: Have you ever read to Do Not the Cat? Well... You can forget about clicking on fruit because Do the Cat is here! You'll interact with a variety of adorable and quirky cat images. Every second or interaction with the picture brings you closer to new cat images, each with its own special charm and rarity. Some cats are easier to find, while others are elusive, waiting to be discovered by the most dedicated of players. So stay a while and listen, chill out to calm ambient music, soft cat purring while collecting cute, awesome, and epic images for your collection!
row.short_description: Stay a while and listen, chill out to calm ambient music, soft cat purring while collecting cute, awesome, and epic images for your collection!

row.name: Project ZipZap
row.detailed_description: Freed by the shockwaves of a dangerous threat, you, Project ZZ , have to traverse a cyberpunk world, battle your way through waves of Projects , and face Project E-Dog head on! Features Project ZipZap is a fast-paced, speedrunner friendly, hack and dash game that incentivises skill expression and rewards mastery of game mechanics. Featuring: Fast-paced movement-based combat: Dash to evade, and dash back to destroy. Five hand-crafted levels including an explosive boss battle. Three different dashes, each with special abilities, ultimates and interactions. Achieve mastery by speedrunning levels and getting a high rank during combat. Compete against players and friends on the leaderboards, and stay competitive by racing their ghosts. Project ZipZap was developed as a final year university project over the course of seven months by eleven developers.
row.short_description: Hack and Dash through waves of enemies in Project ZipZap, an isometric, fast-paced, movement game. Chain together dash abilities to blitz through levels and race your way up the global leaderboards. Hone your skills and achieve mastery.

row.name: Replikant Chat
row.detailed_description: Embark on a journey into the future of AI-powered conversations with our innovative 3D chatbot experience. Important: We offer a demo version of Replikant Chat. Each month, we provide credits for a brief experience, allowing you to explore the app before deciding on a subscription. A subscription is necessary, as Replikant relies on external AI services like ChatGPT and ElevenLabs. This cost primarily covers those services rather than being a charge from us. AI service prices are decreasing, so this will evolve over time. Steam labels our app’s download button as 'Free to Play,' though we prefer 'Demo' to better reflect the experience. The official category for Replikant Chat is 'Simulation,' not 'Free to Play.' Thank you for your understanding! Unleash the possibilities: User-Friendly Interface: our extraordinary 3D characters, navigating them with ease through an interface as familiar as your favorite streaming service. Connect in real-time with one or more characters, each uniquely crafted with rich personalities, expressive voices, and captivating animations that bring them to life. Diverse Content: a vast array of topics, from education and entertainment to quizzes, relationships, comedy, and storytelling—each conversation a new adventure. Immersive Environments: yourself in highly realistic 3D environments, where cinematic camera angles make every interaction feel like a scene from your favorite movie. Witness the magic as real and AI-generated images seamlessly blend within these dynamic 3D stages, enhancing every narrative and communication. Real-Time Interaction: like never before—our characters see you through your webcam and respond to your world in real-time, creating a deeply personal and interactive experience. Multimedia Integration: your world with them—whether it’s documents or images, our characters are ready to access, display, and discuss anything you bring to the table. Stay inspired with regular updates and new characters, ensuring that your journey with us is always fresh, exciting, and full of surprises. Our platform doesn't just offer conversations; it creates immersive, interactive experiences that push the boundaries of AI technology. Whether you're seeking knowledge, entertainment, or a unique way to explore ideas, our 3D chatbot experience opens up a world of possibilities. Embark on this journey where technology meets imagination, and every interaction is an opportunity to learn, be entertained, and explore the vast potential of AI-driven communication.
row.short_description: Engage with unique AI characters, each with distinct personalities, in immersive 3D environments. Currently in Early Access, a subscription is required for the full experience. Discover a growing roster of educational, entertaining, gaming, narrative, and creative interactions.

row.name: Spectralia
row.detailed_description: Daily apple collection drop and chances for it: F-tier: 60.94% E-tier: 31.25% D-tier: 6.25% C-tier: 1.25% B-tier: 0.25% A-tier: 0.05% S-tier: 0.01% Daily container or star or gem drop and chances for it: Star: 1% (F-tier: 60.94%, E-tier: 31.25%, D-tier: 6.25%, C-tier: 1.25%, B-tier: 0.25%, A-tier: 0.05%, S-tier: 0.01%) Container: 6.25% Gem: 92.75% Hourly drop and chances for it: F-tier: 60.94% E-tier: 31.25% D-tier: 6.25% C-tier: 1.25% B-tier: 0.25% A-tier: 0.05% S-tier: 0.01% Playtime drop: F-tier: 2 hours E-tier: 5 hours D-tier: 10 hours C-tier: 25 hours B-tier: 50 hours A-tier: 100 hours S-tier: 175 hours
row.short_description: Spectralia is a free to play clicker game with collectible items. Get one every hour or by daily entering the game. Items can be deleted, traded or exchanged. Some items can be obtained through opening of a container.

row.name: Gavin Tyler's Game Collection
row.detailed_description: Gavin Tyler's Game Collection is a collection of old games released by Gavin Tyler. It goes from his earliest work to his newest. Some games are bad, while some games are good. There are 7 games in total! GAMES LIST: - Rage Game: The Game The first game released by Gavin Tyler! Can you finish all levels without dying? - Rage Game: The Game Cancelled Demo A 'polished' version of the original Rage Game: The Game, with one large level! - Room Service A jam game for 'Secret Santa Jam'. You work as a janitor at a sketchy hotel! - Passageways 3D A roguelike horror game about endless passageways. How long can you survive until the comic monsters catch you? - Passageways 3D Dev Version A developer version of Passageways 3D. This is the first time it is being publicly released! - Bus Survivalist Originally made as a joke, Bus Survivalist is a game about trying to withstand a bus ride to school. The catch? It's the elementary bus! - Gavin's Wonderhouse Gavin's Wonderhouse is a parody of the typical mascot horror game. Grab all the birthday cake you can before getting caught by Gavin!
row.short_description: A collection of classic games made by Gavin Tyler, now for the first time on Steam!

row.name: Resurrection of Santiago
row.detailed_description: Captain Jase is a bounty hunter who keeps Dorai safe and gives planet Caloria hope as the GDI are fighting in a war protecting Caloria for what little they have left. Your mission is simple, apprehend the dangerous outlaw Santiago: Go from friendly citizens to corrupt individuals as you blast your way through the GDI officers and marauders that roam the desert or that are pitched up around the city. Traverse this compact open world by strafing, sliding, jetpack boosting. . . or maybe just jump in a hover car and drift around with ease, mowing down enemies as they pop up. Whether you’re packing the laser shotgun, hauling the weapon of MASS DESTRUCTION or just strapping your laser handgun. There is no doubt an enemy is equipped to rush you at any moment. Shooting down common enemies will become easier as you become stronger and more skillful. But gaining these skills will come in handy once you are ready to face Santiago. But after what you’ve done to him, he now only sees red. Storyline: Captain Jase and his other bounty-hunting allies are faced with an unrelenting outlaw named Santiago. Once Jase takes action and seems to have come up on top, Santiago returns seeking blood and revenge.
row.short_description: Hunt for the notorious and unrelenting outlaw Santiago known for his reign over the dystopian city of Dorai. Endure the dangerous desert pushing your way through GDI officers and marauders as you fight for Caloria’s survival.
row.notes: Violence and gore with emphasis on dark themes such as death in cutscenes. Depictions of cartoon-esque decapitation and amputation without detailed emphasis.

row.name: PEDRO!
row.detailed_description: This is a simple relaxing clicker. Play to get cool drops. (Each hour you get a skin)
row.short_description: A cool clicker.

row.name: Pan Beats
row.detailed_description: A simple rhythm game created by a Unity beginner! All you have to do is press the falling notes in time with the rhythm! The initial 43 songs include 'Shining star', 'Cat life', 'SUMMER TRIANGLE' and other free BGM often heard on Youtube, etc. The game has a large volume of songs! The fun of rhythm games is maintained, but the image of a hardcore sound game is given a cute atmosphere, making it easy for even those who have never played a sound game to play along with familiar tunes. Scores are saved for each song, so those who are used to playing sound games can compete with each other for ranking. In addition, since the randomization function of the notes is implemented, the same song can be permanently enjoyed with hundreds or thousands of different patterns of music! There are three difficulty levels for each song: 'Easy,' 'Normal,' and 'Hard,' so both beginners and experienced players can enjoy playing rhythm games at a level that suits their abilities. Whether you are a music game lover or have never played music games before, you should definitely try this game!
row.short_description: Cute simple rhythm game! All you have to do is press the falling notes in time with the rhythm! The game can be enjoyed by both sound game beginners and those who are familiar with sound games, with familiar songs and three different difficulty levels. Please try to play this game!

row.name: TobPaCharge
row.detailed_description: A rock-paper-scissor style turn-based fighting game. Practice with bot or challenge your friend to a duel! In each turn, both players present their option! There are 3 option available which are Charge a charge is requires to be able to do a fireball. Fireball If this hits a charging opponent you win! Block this can negate fireball however.... I lied! there are actually 4 options! Big fireball this requires 3 charges this beats anything except itself. Here is a rock-paper-scissor chart for reference Remember! always charge on first turn! since both players cannot do fireball so there is no need to block. Happy TobPaCharge!
row.short_description: An anime 2d turn-based fighting game. Fireball away!

row.name: GreenBulb
row.detailed_description: GreenBulb is a fun and colorful single-player jump-and-run game where you will be challenged in your skill and dexterity as you solve puzzles and tests of skill across 20 levels. GreenBulb has the ability to ‘convert’ a shape either by delivering a kick or by leaping onto it. Achieving multiple shape conversions without touching the ground will result in higher scores. GreenBulb must battle the Shape Machine, a terrible duplication device that unleashes an unending stream of repetitive forms, devoid of meaning or essence. Only GreenBulb can save the world from this grim fate by transforming these lifeless shapes into objects full of color and joy! Note: Levels 1-8 are free to play, providing a fun and challenging experience at no cost. To access levels beyond Level 8, players can make a one-time purchase of the “Unlock All Levels” item for $2.99 USD, allowing seamless progression through the final Boss Level.
row.short_description: GreenBulb is a vibrant, single-player jump-and-run game for all ages, where players use skill and dexterity to solve puzzles and tackle challenges across 20 exciting levels. GreenBulb offers a delightful and accessible experience for players of all skill levels.

row.name: LoveAndComplex
row.detailed_description: Synopsis You are a college student who just returned to school. Having no friends and not being independent, you regret your past life, but you want to be reborn as a new person through this group project. Will you be able to succeed? About This Game LoveAndComplex is a simulation game set in college. Like any other simulation game, you can watch all sorts of endings by your choice. This game can be divided into two parts. story part It depends on your choice as a story part or the outcome of your simulation. simulation part In the simulation part, you can raise various statistics in preparation for the group project. Requirements Windows 7/8/10 Game features full pixelart graphic 3-4 hour play time High quality CG
row.short_description: LoveAndComplex is a simulation game set in college. Like any other simulation game, you can watch all sorts of endings by your choice.
row.notes: There is a character's exposure and metaphorical sexual expression.

row.name: Final Rounds
row.detailed_description: Dodge the obstacles and manage to beat your highscores in this arcade-style game! You'll keep saying to yourself that this will be your final round, but it won't be. Your reward system inside your brain will be pushed to its limits, you won't be able to stop. Despite difficulty increasing with each passing second. The game offers: 3 difficulty levels! Arcade based gameplay! Fantastic art-style and graphics! Over a hundred of different, randomly chosen level skin schemes! Incredible soundtrack, which perfectly fits in the gameplay and blends with the rest of graphical design.
row.short_description: That's the final round, I swear this time, one last time for today... Final Rounds is a simple, yet highly addictive arcade game. Avoid the obstacles, enjoy the levels and beat your highscores!

row.name: Geometry Dabs - Save the World
row.detailed_description: Geometry Dabs, a dangerous drug, has brainwashed countless individuals into becoming mindless slaves for its creator, RopTob. The exact purpose of RopTob's control over these victims remains unclear, but it surely cannot be anything good. You play as Mohammed Ja'kalem Al-abdula, the ruler of his own kingdom, Mohammedland. Mohammed cannot stand by and allow people to be brainwashed while he does nothing. He has made it his mission to defeat RopTob and save everyone from the clutches of the Geometry Dabs drug. This story-driven, FPS-focused game features 12 unique levels that form the main campaign. It also includes a 6-level co-op mission where you and someone else play as Mohammed's friends, Todd and Emil. Also includes Arena mode where you battle Geometry Dabs enemies for a max of 20 waves for as long as possible in different maps.
row.short_description: Geometry Dabs, a dangerous drug, has brainwashed countless individuals into becoming mindless slaves for its creator, RopTob. The exact purpose of RopTob's control over these victims remains unclear, but it surely cannot be anything good. Your goal is to rescue these people from RopTob

row.name: Ninja Rift
row.detailed_description: Embark on an epic journey in Ninja Rift, an immersive RPG where you create and customize your own ninja. Level up your skills, master powerful techniques, and join forces with clans and crews to dominate the battlefield. Challenge other ninjas in intense battles, prove your prowess, and rise to become the ultimate ninja warrior. In Ninja Rift, the path to greatness is paved with strategy, skill, and unwavering determination. Will you conquer the rift and claim your place as the best ninja of all? Join now and begin your adventure!
row.short_description: Ninja Rift: Unleash Your Inner Warrior

row.name: ball
row.detailed_description: World's greatest collection game. Enter the world of ball: Get crate drops every three hours! Open crates and collect unique balls of five different rarity levels. (NEW)Arcade : Equip your favorite skin and play games! Bally Bird (Iconic remake of a very popular game you might recognize) Future plans: Ball is in its early stages. Here's what's on the way: Content updates : not only new balls and crates for you to collect and enjoy, but also some extra features we think you will like... Steam community integration and supporting the artists : we want to see what you can create. submit your work and have a chance to be featured in a 'community crate'! More arcade games and ways to utilize your balls : ball is not just another low quality collection game. items will be usable in titles we have planned for the future.
row.short_description: Earn a crate from a unique collection every 3 hours. When you open a crate, you'll receive one random ball out of 15 possible options. The balls are divided into 5 different rarity levels. Do you have what it takes to collect them all?

row.name: NETHER DUNGEONS
row.detailed_description: Nether Dungeons is an action-packed dungeon crawler that puts your skills to the test as you fight through procedurally generated dungeons with deadly monsters, powerful bosses, and hidden treasures. Play as Farfadox , or choose from a roster of quirky heroes, each with their own weaknesses and abilities. Your goal is to survive relentless enemies through multiple unique phases, from wimpy minions to high-powered bosses, and ultimately emerge victorious from the depths of the Nether Dungeons. Test your strategies, reflexes and adaptability with a vast array of distinctive weapons, from swords and magic, to guns and explosives, you've got numerous choices to eliminate your enemies! Procedurally Generated Dungeons : No two dungeons are the same. Face new layouts, traps, and enemy encounters with every run. Epic Boss Fights : Take on powerful and uniquely designed bosses that require strategy and skill to defeat. Character Customization : Use the in-game editor to create and customize your own hero, designing your hero exactly how you want! Mascots : Adopt cute pets that follow you through the dungeons, helping you fight enemies and offering unique support abilities. Spell Cards : Acquire unique buffs that grant special abilities or powers, giving you an edge in combat. Hardcore Mode : For those seeking a bigger challenge, Hardcore Mode offers much harder difficulty for the most skilled warriors. Replayability : Procedural generation, diverse heroes, and random loot make every playthrough a new experience. Are you ready to descend into the depths of the Nether Dungeons and face its dangers ahead? The challenge awaits!
row.short_description: Nether Dungeons is an action-packed dungeon crawler. Battle through procedurally generated dungeons, face relentless enemies, and defeat epic bosses. Customize your hero, wield diverse weapons, and survive intense challenges as you descend into ever-changing, dangerous depths.

row.name: Twilight Wars
row.detailed_description: A team based top-down shooter game. Pick up weapons and fight enemies with allies. # Features You pick from two sides, Royal knights or Skydow warriors to play as. Eliminate all enemies in the arena to win. Join The-Third-Force as a mercenary if both sides are not for you. When play as a mercenary, eliminate all players including other mercenaries to win. Various types of weapons help you make your own tactics. No repetitive weapon type in this game. Every weapon comes with different special abilities as well to make every battle unique. # Story Mode Addictive and challenging missions in the story mode open up the world of Twilight Wars. Play with AI or your friends to adventure in the post-apocalyptic earth, find out the truth of the catastrophe 700 hundreds years ago.
row.short_description: A team based top-down shooter game. Pick up weapons and fight enemies with allies. Mission-based storyline leads you into this fantasy world.

row.name: The Little UNI
row.detailed_description: *The game is a fangame for the Korean vocaloid 'Uni,' and the character and story shown in the game are not related to the official setting The little girl, Uni, who is the main character in The Little UNI, left the planet she was living in after a fight with the 'Rose' and left to find a new planet where she could live. It won’t be easy to leave the planet you have lived throughout your life to find a new planet, but the experience of listening to stories of people living on planets with their own personalities and spending time with them will certainly be wonderful. Listen to the various characters' stories with various hand-drawn illustrations. Between the various planets, people, and stories, please watch what will be Uni’s final decision. Will Uni return to the planet where ‘Rose’ is, or will she find a new planet to settle in?
row.short_description: The game is a point-and-click adventure game in the form of a story with hand-drawn illustrations. Go on an adventure to the planets with various characters and listen to their stories, and find a new planet for Uni to stay on.

row.name: Legacy of Defense - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Full Version About the Game Game Description: Become the hero of a fantasy world and defend against monster invasions! Legacy of Defense - Prologue is an innovative defense game that combines side-scrolling action and deck-building elements. In the prologue, you can play the introductory version of Legacy of Defense and earn prologue-exclusive achievements. Key Features: Side-Scrolling Action: Experience intense battles with stunning 2D graphics and intuitive controls. Feel the thrill of defending against waves of incoming monsters. Deck-Building Strategy: Collect various cards to build your own deck. Each card contains powerful skills that require strategic play. Fantasy Monsters: Face a variety of fantasy monsters that you can only imagine. Each monster has unique abilities that you must counter. Skill Upgrades: Gain experience through battles and upgrade your hero’s skills. Use powerful skills to more effectively sweep away the monsters. Gameplay: Defend against waves of incoming monsters. Choose cards to use skills and defeat your enemies. Strategic deck-building is the key to victory. Clear each stage and face increasingly powerful monsters to defeat the final boss! Legacy of Defense - Prologue: Test your strategy and skills. Are you ready to become the brave hero and save the fantasy world?
row.short_description: Become the hero of a fantasy world and defend against monsters! 'Legacy of Defense - Prologue' is the intro to the innovative game 'Legacy of Defense' combining side-scrolling action and deck-building. Collect cards, use skills, gain experience, upgrade, and defeat the final boss!

row.name: Canto I
row.detailed_description: Midway upon the journey of our life… In Canto I, you take control of Dante, the Sommo Poeta, in a small adventure that reimagines the first canto of the Divine Comedy as a videogame. Finding yourself in the Forest Dark, you’ll need to use all abilities at your disposal to traverse it! Features Spread your wings and overcome every obstacle, bounce on magical books, dash through spike traps and defeat helmet-equipped specters! Fun pixelart style that will get a laugh out of you even when you’ll fall into a pit (there are lots of them) Rebuild the Canto I — Spread around the four levels, scrolls containing the triplets of Canto I hide. Find them all and read the poem in the menu page! Different game modes — play Classic mode for an experience without modifiers, Story mode for a relaxed experience or Hell mode for a real challenge! How to play • Movement: Arrow keys or WASD. • Double jump: Up arrow key or W in the air. • Attack: C, P or Space. • Dash: X or O. • Looking down: Hold the down arrow key or S. Then he moved on, and I behind him followed. Canto I is a personal, small love letter to the platform genre and to the Divine Comedy. Thank you for reading all the way down here and I hope you’ll enjoy the game, if you wanna try it. Have a wonderful day! :D
row.short_description: Face the Dark Forest of the Divine Comedy in this action platformer inspired by the Sommo Poeta’s masterpiece! Help Dante avoid pitfalls, spikes & specters using double jumps, magical attacks and dashes. Find the scrolls containing the triplets of the Canto exploring this gloomy, pixelart forest!

row.name: Postponed
row.detailed_description: Postponed
row.short_description: Postponed

row.name: Ball Control
row.detailed_description: You are a ball, and you have to use your finger skills to reach the green zone, where you win and move on to the next level. The ball has gravity and you have to be careful that you might not be careful and break it. The enemies are red in color and will patrol depending on the level. The buttons, if you press them, will unlock new routes depending on their color.
row.short_description: You are a ball, and you have to use your finger skills to reach the green zone, where you win and move on to the next level. The ball has gravity and you have to be careful that you might not be careful and break it.

row.name: Warmage: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Warmage: Prologue is a free version of Warmage. Discover and explore the universe and core gameplay of this tactical roguelite and get a preview of the experience that awaits you in the full game. Warmage: Prologue is a roguelite grid-based turn-based tactical combat game where you play as a young warmage tasked with defending his city against an unknown evil. Features: Play as 3 different archetypes with unique gameplay Varied and refreshing tactical combat After each battle, power up your warmage and buy various attacks and items Choose your next mission on the city map carefully Differents objectives for each battle Over 45 spells and 38 items to combine to create the ultimate warmage Fight Use a wide variety of weapons and spells to defeat waves of ennemies in a turn by turn combat. Various ennemies will challenge you in different ways, think carefully about each movement and each attack as a single error can put you in perilous situations. Upgrade Use the gems collected during the fights to buy new spells, upgrade the ones you already have and buy new items. With each level gained, you can upgrade one of you primary caracteristic which will improve the power of your attacks. Burn them all Now that you have a deadly warmage with powerfull spells, defeat all whom will stand in your way ! Use your environment The surroundings aren't just for show, they can be your greatest ally in escaping deadly situations. Learn to harness them to your advantage ! Defend your city Your city is attacked by an unkown evil. You have to help the citizens, others warmages and important people to survive!
row.short_description: Your city is under attack Warmage ! In this grid-based turn-based roguelite, defend the many different districts of your city against waves of enemies with the help of one of your students, and in between, buy and upgrade spells to prepare for the worst.

row.name: Valis: The Fantasm Soldier Collection Launcher
row.detailed_description: *'Valis: The Fantasm Soldier Collection Launcher' is a free game launcher that lets you play the Valis series titles. Please note, you need to purchase the Valis games separately. The launcher does not include the games themselves; it is simply a program to run the purchased game ROMs. About Valis The legendary side scrolling action game Valis: The Fantasm Soldier series is making a triumphant appearance on Steam! The highly popular PC Engine versions of Valis: The Fantasm Soldier, Valis II, and Valis III have been fully ported for this collection. Side-Scrolling Action Traditional side-scrolling action. Players will adventure through various levels, battling enemies and bosses using a combination of close combat attacks and magical powers. Storytelling Valis is famous for its strong narrative elements. It combines anime-style cutscenes with the action gameplay to tell the story. Anime Sprite Style The game features vibrant, Japanese anime style sprite graphics and character designs. The visual presentation and animated cutscenes set it apart from many other action games of the 90's. Variety of Weapons and Power-Ups Players can find various weapons and power-ups throughout the stages, allowing them to power-up Yuko's abilities and combat skills. A Popular Game with a Devoted Fanbase Valis: The Fantasm Soldier is a side-scrolling action game originally released by Telenet Japan in 1986. Its unique setting, featuring a heroine in a sailor uniform and bikini armor battling monsters, combined with high-octane action and deep storytelling, won the hearts of many gamers. The Origin of the Bishojo Game Genre The original PC Engine versions were groundbreaking for their time, featuring animation sequences and voice acting. The game's blend of 'moe' appeal, solid action gameplay, and captivating narrative led to it being recognized as a pioneer in the bishojo game genre. Additional Features for Smooth Playthroughs While faithfully preserving the original PC Engine experience, this release adds modern conveniences such as key configuration options and a rewind feature for a smoother gameplay experience on Steam. *To play Valis: The Fantasm Soldier, Valis II, and Valis III, you must purchase the respective DLCs: Valis: The Fantasm Soldier, Valis II, and Valis III. *This title preserves the original content as it was at the time of release. Therefore, we do not take responsibility for any designs, company names, or other elements displayed in the games. *PC Engine and PC Engine logo are trademarks of Konami Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. and BIGLOBE Inc.
row.short_description: The legendary action game Valis: The Fantasm Soldier appears on Steam! Please note: This is only the game launcher and does not include the games themselves.

row.name: Not A Banana: Capybara
row.detailed_description: Welcome! Immerse yourself in the wonderful world of the capybara clicker! Here you have the chance to become the only true friend of the capybara. By clicking on the screen you can hit many different kinds of capybara! Don't forget to click to attract even more capybaras! Capybara is a newly released game that aims to never forget to press the mouse button! Click, click, click… The progress depends on your clicking skills! Each week there will be a chance to receive a different special kind of capybara. The game is still being fine-tuned, so stay tuned and don’t miss any opportunities! Make yourself comfortable and do not forget to click. Drop every 3 hours.
row.short_description: Hello! Welcome to the wonderful world of capybara clicker! Here you will become a true friend of the capybaras, clicking on the screen and calling the cutest and sometimes special capybaras! Don't forget to keep clicking to attract even more capybaras to you!

row.name: Mortal Valley
row.detailed_description: Set foot in the mortal Valley. This sandbox, semi survival fantasy game brings you into a world where you are the ruler. Build entire towns, protect your territory from monsters and level your character. When the night falls, be prepared to meet your foes, or if you're quick enough to build a house you can stay out of their sight. Command over armies and protect your home from goblins. Dig holes into the ground, or place entire plots for your buildings.
row.short_description: Will you survive in the Mortal Valley? A fantasy open world where you can find your way to vanguish the evil forces that have corrupted the Mortal Valley. Fight alone or alongside your friends. Create massive structures, or keep it simple with just a small house. Are you ready for the Mortal Valley?

row.name: NokNok
row.detailed_description: Just Updated Apologize ! After our game was launched, the server was attacked. Since our team consists of only two people and this is our first game, we lack experience in dealing with such attacks. We are currently working on an urgent fix, which is expected to take two days. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. About the Game NokNok: A Cross-Platform Idle Game Welcome to NokNok, a revolutionary cross-platform open world idle game that combines the excitement of autonomous world-building with the ease of idle gaming. As a player, you can earn coins and treasure chests by simply hanging out, and use these rewards to unlock various rare types of hammers. These hammers will help you accelerate your battle power, allowing you to take on and defeat the mighty bosses that stand in your path. Key Features: - Cross-platform gameplay: Play NokNok on any device and platform of your choice. - Open world exploration: Discover and roam in a vast, immersive world at your own pace. - Idle mechanics: Earn coins and treasure chests even while you're away or offline. - Rare hammers: Collect unique hammers from treasure chests to enhance your battle power. - Hammer upgrades: Use your hard-earned coins to level up your hammers and increase their strength. - Epic boss battles: Challenge and defeat powerful bosses to progress through the game. - Self-governance: As you progress, take on the responsibility of governing your own community within the game world. Join the world of NokNok today and start your idle adventure in an open world where your actions shape the society around you!
row.short_description: NokNok is a unique cross-platform open world idle game with elements of self-governance. As a player, you're tasked with earning coins and treasure chests through idle mechanics, which in turn allow you to unlock and upgrade a variety of rare hammers.

row.name: Monkey Mischief
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Monkey Mischief. The game that has little bits of everything. There are three game modes, with more to come in the future, that are playable in all three maps! Fly like a high speed racing car across the map with friends, climb mountains to get away from rising lava, or run from two spider-monkey twins with tentacles in a underground advanced cave system! You can even scale multiple trees at once, do backflips on trampolines, or explore the Mischievous Mall, where more then 30 cosmetics are for sale to wear on your physical VR character! Or, you can explore the Horror maps that has three upcoming levels, all scaling higher in atmosphere, and lowering your sanity. No matter what you do, it's ensured you will have fun!
row.short_description: Monkey Mischief is a online multiplayer VR game that is dependent on the locomotion of your hands. Run to the top of the mountains when lava is rising, fly like a racing car across the map with friends, or run from two twins with tentacles in a underground advanced cave system!

row.name: I Hate Orcs: In My Garden
row.detailed_description: Orc Wizards have broken your defenses and invaded your gardens! As a humble gardener, you do not have any tools to attack these Orcs. To remove them, you must find the areas that the Orcs have broken through and fix them. Avoid the Orcs' projectiles by jumping, dodging, and dashing in this third-person 3D game!
row.short_description: Jump, dodge, and speed your way around projectiles in this fast-paced game where your goal is to protect your garden by killing all the orcs!

row.name: Bat Bots
row.detailed_description: Bat Bots is a retro shooter that brings the feel of 80s arcades right to your screen. Stun the Bats Stun the latest prototypes of robotic bats that have escaped into the gloomy forest surrounding your secret lab. Customize Your Player Choose from a variety of crosshair designs and colors. Enter your initials to make your mark on the leaderboard. Stun with Friends and Family NOTE: Local Multiplayer Requires At Least One Controller. Multiplayer is NOT supported with ONLY a Mouse & Keyboard Play with your friends and family as you compete to get the highest score! Or work together to defend your top-secret lab before the Bat Bots escape! Power-Up with Modifiers Enhance your gameplay by shooting the Power Cores dropped by Mod Bats. Once stunned, these cores grant a limited-time modifier that can turn the tide of the game and offer unique advantages in any game mode.
row.short_description: Enjoy a modern take on timeless arcade action with Bat Bots, a nostalgic shooter inspired by the classics. Take down waves of robotic bats using precise aim and quick reflexes. Engage in solo play, challenge your friends and family, or work together to defend against the oncoming waves.

row.name: UniqKiller: Urban Shooter
row.detailed_description: Tired of the same old shooters? We hear you. In Uniqkiller, you create heroes with distinct appearances, skills, and styles for PvP battles in urban environments! The controls are so simple, that even your grandma could play. But don’t get us wrong – it’s fast, intense, and packed with endless possibilities. Play on PC or mobile, build your own path, and watch your 'Seekers' shine and reach the spotlights. Instead of settling for pre-made characters that need to be unlocked, you customize your operator by combining body type and parts, outfits, combat classes, skills and weapons to create a unique hero. Shape your gameplay and progression path. In Uniqkiller, your choices in creating and improving characters directly impact how you play and grow! With an auto-shooting system and simple, intuitive controls, Uniqkiller is easy to pick up and play. But the depth of customization for your operators, the variety of game modes, the top-down perspective, and tactical combat mechanics push the limits of strategic thinking — challenging players to truly stand out, whether you’re a rookie or a pro. Play with or against your friends. Form alliances or start wars. It’s all about standing out — solo or with your squad. Uniqkiller gives you all the tools to make your mark. To connect with other players and share your experience, join our Discord community. UniqKiller is a free to play cross platform and crossplay (PC and mobile), meaning that you can play whenever you are.
row.short_description: UniqKiller is an intense F2P topdown tactical shooter, PvP, with automatic shooting. Combine different types of bodies, classes, skills, weapons, skins, to create unique heroes, both in appearance and gameplay, for battles in urban environments.

row.name: Relic
row.detailed_description: Choose your spirit animal. Relic is a treasure adventure quest where you search and dig for treasure. Don't treasure hunt alone. Gain loot, obtain wearable outfits, complementary companions, motions such as dances, and emotions to show your feelings on treasure hunting to your friends in multiplayer mode, and find the Relics to traverse the different terrains of The Island! Customize your treasure hunter Customize your player character from their skin color, eye color, and hair color. Collect swag to customize your character even further. Equip different combinations at any time depending on the mood. Earn the ability to ride along in treasure hunts with your spirit animal. Show off that sweet swag. Play your way Level up to gain attribute points for your spirit animal. Invest in dig speed, dig power, or movement speed depending on your play style. Quick play Each match is one minute long. How many treasures can be obtained within the time limit? Reach the MAXIMUM BONUS! Single-player treasure hunting glory Are you a lone treasure hunter? Then this mode is for you! All treasures are obtainable in single-player mode. Cross-platform multiplayer treasure hunting Play with friends, even across platforms! The more friends in a treasure hunting party, the more rewards gained. Progress is saved online, so Relic can be played on-the-go! Vibrant environments Treasure hunt in different settings. Each terrain has a different set of treasures to find! Over 150 treasures to obtain Can you obtain them all?
row.short_description: Choose your spirit animal. Relic is a treasure adventure quest where you search and dig for treasure. Gain loot, obtain wearable outfits, complementary companions, motions such as dances, and emotions to show your feelings, and find the Relics to traverse the different terrains of The Island!

row.name: NugQuest
row.detailed_description: Smoke. Eat. Survive. Millennia of evolution have engineered the ultimate super predator. Enter the Stoned Age as a degenerate named Tyler, with the objectives of maintaining your high, keeping your life-threatening munchies at bay, and evading a variety of enemies who wish to mold you to society's constraints. This. Is. NugQuest. Run and hide to avoid enemies, search around the house for food and contraband. Survive as long as possible, and unlock all 4 levels. - What you can expect with the purchase: 4 survival maps to unlock and beat your high score in, a tutorial, original soundtrack and art. Once a map is unlocked by gaining enough points, it is infinitely re-playable.
row.short_description: Smoke. Eat. Survive. Play through 4 levels of action packed survival. Search for food and money to maintain your high, and hide yourself from the enemies trying to stop you. Can you beat your high score and unlock the next level?
row.notes: Marijuana use, cartoon violence, death, starvation, and blood.

row.name: Chicken
row.detailed_description: About the Game Chicken is a clicker game, in which you click a Chicken! Get a random chicken every 3 hour and grow your collection! Features - Chickens, obviously. - Items to grow your collection. A community that's Chickens. Design submission via discord! That's right! All our Chickens are made with community effort and inspiration, come join the fun!
row.short_description: Chicken is a clicker game, in which you click a Chicken! You click the Chicken to gain even more Chickens! Every 3 hour, random chicken drops. A community that's Chickens. All our Chickens are made with community effort and inspiration, come join the fun!

row.name: Hero Pack
row.detailed_description: Step into the world of Hero Pack, where strategy meets excitement in an epic quest for glory! Build your ultimate team from a diverse roster of heroes and embark on thrilling adventures, conquer challenging levels, and compete in intense tournaments against other players. Key Features: Assemble Your Squad: Choose from a variety of unique heroes to form a powerful three-member team. Each hero comes with distinct abilities and strengths, allowing for countless strategic combinations. Equip and Upgrade: Enhance your heroes by equipping them with various items such as weapons, armor, helmets, rings, and shields. Strategically boost their stats to prepare for the challenges ahead. Idle Gameplay: Enjoy the convenience of idle gameplay as your heroes continue to fight and progress even when you're offline. Collect valuable rewards and resources to further strengthen your squad. Conquer Levels: Test your team's might by advancing through increasingly difficult levels. Each level presents new enemies and obstacles that will challenge your tactical prowess. Compete in Tournaments: Enter tournaments to face off against other players' teams. Prove your skills and earn prestigious rewards by climbing the ranks and dominating the competition. Collect Heroes and Items: Unlock new heroes and items through gameplay. Every battle and tournament offers the chance to expand your collection and enhance your squad's capabilities. Time-Based Rewards: Earn free tournament ticket every hour of gameplay, adding an extra layer of excitement and reward as you play. Join the adventure in Hero Pack and experience the thrill of strategic battles, hero collection, and epic competition. Can you build the ultimate team and emerge victorious?
row.short_description: Hero Pack lets you build a powerful team from a diverse roster of heroes. Equip them with items, conquer levels, and compete in tournaments. Enjoy idle gameplay, collect new heroes and items, and earn free tournament tickets every hour. Prove your strategy and emerge victorious!

row.name: World Crafter TD: Prologue
row.detailed_description: A highly addictive survival crafting tower defense game! Gather, craft, build turrets, shoot guns, and expand the land to defend against waves of enemies! Gather resources and craft materials. Craft useful equipment, turrets, and structures. Beat waves of enemies using turrets and melee/ranged weapons. Expand the land to reveal new resources and crafting recipes. Tight and addicting gameplay loop. This is the prologue for the full game, it includes the first biome and the first 16 waves from the full game. Your save will persist to the full game.
row.short_description: A highly addictive survival crafting tower defense game! Gather, craft, build turrets, shoot guns, and expand the land to defend against waves of enemies! The prologue for the full game, World Crafter TD!

row.name: Beat Around The Bush
row.detailed_description: Ever wanted to beat around the bush…literally? Get ready for a satisfying game where your main goal is simple: smack around that bush and see what happens. Around the bush spawns red circles that you're supposed to hit, which gives you money. You buy things in a shop to help you progress throughout the game. But that’s just the start – as you progress, the game gives you some surprised that you may enjoy. Perfect for both active and casual play, “Beat Around the Bush” is your new go-to for relaxation, humor, and endless bushes to beat! You technically beat this game the moment you beat around the bush. No need to continue. This game is 1 of many games that are going to be 'Literal' games. This was also uploaded to YouTube as a YouTube shorts series where the top comment got the next addition to the game. Which is why there's so many weird things. Beat Around the Bush is a meme game. Beat Around the Bush is not meant to be taken seriously!
row.short_description: Beat Around the Bush is a series done over YouTube shorts where the top comment got the next addition to the game. Beat Around the Bush is a game where your primary goal is to Beat around the Bush. Once you do, you did it. You won. Therefore, there's no more reason to keep playing this game.

row.name: 海战前线-0.1版本
row.detailed_description: 作为无敌舰队的司令官，这场战争将由你来掌控！ 游戏特色 1、全新版本，良心游戏 全新0.1版本，不肝不氪，超多福利等你来拿！ 2、精锐海战决斗，王者巅峰对决 超多知名战舰助你纵横四海，称霸天下，碧波荡漾的海水、阴雨迷蒙的水面、巨炮轰鸣的战舰，予你顶级的海战体验！ 3、铁血舰长，听你调遣 巅峰对决，战无止境！全新舰长系统华丽上线，各路舰长任你调遣，为你上阵！ 4、超帅战舰，不可错过 每个细节都精雕细琢，用无比逼真的战舰模型还原二战舰队； 5、砥砺前行，不忘初心 我们将持续更新，开放更多更好玩的功能玩法，不断完善和丰富游戏。

row.name: 迷宫贩~魔王城的开店还债之旅~ Playtest
School Days
row.detailed_description: 关注我们 欢迎关注B站官方号“白雨工作室” 加入QQ交流群（698417918）向我们反馈bug和建议，并可关注正在开展的魔点众筹活动。 About the Game 《学生时代》是一款高自由的校园养成游戏。在游戏中，你将经历纯正中国千禧代的成长之路，见证南方小城的变迁。自选性别，多重体验，任意抉择，决定你的未来，影响朋友的人生。 自习、写作业、考试、家长会……什么？！有老师的八卦可以听？！ 挑灯夜战、在赛场挥洒汗水，将奖状贴满整个墙面，你就是鹅城一中三冠王！ 在学校里结识性格各异的同学：你的成长有他们的陪伴，他们的人生有你的参与。 了解同学的故事，和TA从朋友变成挚友，然后两情相悦，谈一场青春无悔的恋爱！ 此外，做一个小红娘也不错？助攻同学的爱情！ 大量取材于真实经历的事件，力求还原原汁原味的90后学生生活。那一天，你和肖清雅看着流星划落成雨；那一天，你和孟怀安张开双臂拥抱整个世界…… 每一个抉择都会影响你的人生。你的未来因你的抉择而定，友人的未来更是受你的影响。毕业后的你，会成为什么样的人、和谁相伴终生？ 彼此分离的婚恋结局、职业结局、朋友结局，数不胜数的结局，数量远超你的想象。 全球火爆的MBTI人格理论在同类游戏中的首次运用与深度挖掘。 各类人格搭配独有机制。你能完美捏出自己，有超高代入感，全程沉浸式体验。 20+精彩小游戏让你的养成决不重复枯燥。 序章包含 小学阶段完整内容 ，可选 男女双主角 游玩
row.short_description: 《学生时代》是一款高自由的校园养成游戏。夏日西瓜、午后吊扇和悸动的心拉你重回千禧年初。学习、锻炼、恋爱，你是要复刻曾经的成长之路，还是活出不一样的人生？12年后，你的未来如何，由你来决定！

row.name: Unplayable
row.detailed_description: UNPLAYABLE is a DIGITAL ART PROJECT presenting a funny compilation of absurd video games, each in a specific genre: INVISIBOY: A platform game with an invisible hero. As he plays the game, the player can slightly guess where his character is by the responsive scrolling of the background, the collecting of coins that give a hint of his location as well as the sounds that indicate his jumping actions. GHOST FIGHTER: A beat’em up hero who can’t fight because he’s a ghost…this is an unbrawlable brawler… BLOCK SHOCK: A Tetris-like puzzle game with impossible shapes. UNPLAYABLE explores the videogame medium as an artistic tool. Just like using a camera to make video art, we use video games and their specific language as an instrument for emotional and artistic expression. By having a series of (nearly) unplayable games, we want to contemplate the absurdity of our lives and mankind’s obsession with rules and our illusion of control. We also want to convey a sense of intrigue and most of all: a sense of fun. Here, we should be asking ourselves: why do such useless games exist? Are they really useless as there is meaning attached to it? Or am I taking this, as well as myself, too seriously? :-)) Main Features Three games in one! Cool pixel art graphics Short & fun game experiences Share the games with your friends Use them as a party game! How far can you get in these impossible games? Note: This game is unplayable. It is an art project and is meant to describe the feeling of not being in control, being lost, being stuck. Your purchase supports our studio in developing meaningful games and art projects. Our other games can actually be played so please check them out if you enjoyed Unplayable .
row.short_description: UNPLAYABLE is a funny/artsy compilation of absurd video games, each in a specific genre: beat'em up, puzzle game and platformer. An art project with meaning.

row.name: Zugnaex
row.detailed_description: The Game Zona Pugna Exitium, or Zugnaex for short, are Latin words meaning Zone Battle Doom. It's classic FPS gameplay with a unique multiplayer experience. The Story In ancient times, a powerful demon, known only by the forbidden name Zugnaex, was imprisoned by forgotten gods to prevent the destruction of reality itself. The prison, an interdimensional cage bound by immortal blood, is impenetrable, indestructible... and smells really bad. However, the gods did not realize there is one way the demon can escape. If any mortal speaks its name perfectly, every single little tiny syllable, the demon will tear through dimensions, bypass its eternal prison, and return to annihilate humankind. It’s game over and humanity is out of quarters. But Zugnaex has never faced a foe like you. Only you and your friends can defeat the demon Zugnaex and save humanity. The Battles The online service hosts many battle variations. Here are some that you can experience: A Demon a Day  - work together with your friends to defeat demons. Each kill counts for all active players but be careful as friendly fire is enabled. Help each other to get the highest score and become a demon slaying legend. That Guy  - complete different mission objectives with your friends but there's a twist. The demons are powerful and the marines may succumb to their will. Who is your ally and who is your enemy? Play to find out. Pennies from hell  - demons drop pennies and you collect them. It's a PvP party where the best players will wallow in the riches offered by the denizen of hell. Ready or Knot  - it's time to play hide & seek but old school FPS style. It's PvP where all players are against 'it.' If 'it' survives the other players explode just like in the movie. And many more including speed running, co-op adventures and the ultimate confrontation with Zugnaex itself. The Source Code Some of it was written by me. Most of it was written by you. You can use all of it to make something amazing yourself! Use the included source code to build your own battles. zugzug.zip - This is the source code for zugnaex (the client) and zugsrv (the server). See the README file for instructions on how to build. (License: GPLv2) zugbat.zip - This is the source code for an example battle, 'Kneed Time.' Try to finish a random UV E1 map in par. See the README file for instructions on how to setup and run the battle. (License: MIT) zugnite.zip - This is the source code for a companion launcher for Zugnaex that enables Steam achievements and authentication. (License: MIT-0) See source files for setup, build, and licensing details. Important! Please read Zugnaex is an unofficial DOOM® client. This game comes with no playable content. To play or battle, DOOM® and DOOM II® must be licensed and installed on your PC. Licensing details and, for online play, age requirement, terms of use, and privacy policy are included with the game. Photosensitive Warning: This game and its downloadable content have flashing lights and visual patterns that could trigger seizures, discomfort or nausea in players. Please take appropriate precautions. Region Restrictions: To provide the online service, we host servers in North America and Europe. Players outside these regions may not be able to connect or may have slower network speeds. In addition, our application has very limited localization support. The English language is the only officially supported language for the game.
row.short_description: Zugnaex is a very powerful demon. If you say its name correctly, every single little tiny syllable, you will summon the demon & bring forth the apocalypse. But Zugnaex has never faced a foe like you. Battle online with your friends & overcome different challenges to ultimately face the demon itself.

row.name: Vasilisa and Baba Yaga: Prologue
row.detailed_description: I am a magic helper doll. I was given to Vasilisa by her mother before she died. If you feed me and say the right words, I come to life and help my mistress. After the death of his wife, Vasilisa's father grieved and grieved, but ended up remarrying. The stepmother does not like Vasilisa, every day she makes her do a lot of housework. Vasilisa feeds me in the evenings, and I help her. I do the work and at night I watch out for evil in the house. And there's actually a lot of evil around the stepmother's house! An action adventure game in which you, as a magic doll, will fight evil spirits at night. You will be met by malicious opponents - a bannik, a ovinnik and a kikimora. Find a way to defeat them in a fair fight and teach them a lesson so that they will remember it for a long time! • Explore the yard, the wheat field and the river bank • Collect a collection of strange objects • Learn more about the evil spirits that live in the area • And teach these evil spirits a lesson!
row.short_description: Level up the magical assistant doll Vasilisa the Beautiful from the famous fairy tale, who fights evil spirits at night, so that later the path to Baba Yaga will be easier!

row.name: Banana & Tomato
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Banana & Tomato World! Banana & Tomato is a clicker game where you collect unique Banamato items to build a special collection. Drop System: Get a Banamato item every 3 hours automatically. Special effects and sounds will alert you when you receive an item so you never miss your beautiful moments! Mini Games: Play a minigame once an hour to get even more items and a great chance to win unique items you can use to increase your clicks. We are working hard to implement more fun minigames ASAP! Drop Chances: Increase your chances of getting rare items by clicking more. Click, level up and win! Inventory: Use your collected items as skins for your Banamato. Open the inventory and equip the desired skin. Consume special items won in the minigame to get even more clicks, thus, more chances to win better items! Achievements: Collect various challenging achievements in the game. P.S. New skins, features, and minigames are in development. Stay tuned! Feedback: We value your opinion! Share your thoughts and suggestions in the reviews or email us. We respond to every opinion we receive! With love, Banana & Tomato Team! Good luck! <3
row.short_description: Banana & Tomato is a fun clicker game! Click Banamatos, get and collect unique items, play minigames and get even more, click and level up for better rewards, change Banamato skins, earn rare achievements, and much more! Read the full description to learn about all the exciting features!

row.name: Rayadium
row.detailed_description: Delve deeper into a dangerous and mysterious cave and the remnants of miners from the future within it. As time-travelers make use of an otherwise useless radioactive crystal in Raya's town, there is a sudden explosion deep in the mines and Raya knows she must save the miners within. Bounce off of surfaces with Raya's trusty Rapier- who knows what other purposes it may serve? Explore each of the 6 layers of the cave, each with their own visuals, gimmicks, and gameplay elements! Delve deeper with Grim Paths- alternate, harder levels with contrasting visuals and unique gameplay to their counterparts. Collect Kodinium for an additional and completely optional challenge. Collecting 4 in a layer unlocks its Grim Path!
row.short_description: Rayadium is a 2D Platformer about overcoming weaknesses in which the protagonist, Raya, must save time-traveling miners from a cave after a radioactive explosion occurred from the innermost core of a mysterious new crystal.

row.name: The Midnight Bus
row.detailed_description: A SHORT HORROR GAME The Midnight Bus After a day of exhausting work, it's finally time to go home, but all the roads in the city are closed because of the snow, your only hope is to take the last bus of the day that passes at midnight; a vehicle in questionable conditions. The driver has taken a route not very passable because of the situation, tiredness overcomes you, and when you wake up you find yourself alone in the bus in the middle of nowhere... or not? A series of disturbing discoveries will make you realize that being trapped in a snowstorm is not the worst thing that will happen to you that day! Time 15 - 20 minutes of gameplay. Key Features Atmospheric environment: The confined space, snow and external sounds are all part of the immersive experience. Psychological horror: The game presents situations in which you do not know if they are real or in your head. If you pay attention you will discover some interesting details. The game has a unique ending, which in turn will be part of a series of stories around Volmor City. Would you be willing to visit this godforsaken place more than once?
row.short_description: A short narrative horror experience, in which you find yourself in the middle of nowhere in a snowstorm without knowing what has happened to the driver or the other passengers in the vehicle, you just know that there is something out there lurking.
row.notes: The game contains blood and bad language.

row.name: War of the Gods: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Gods Wars : infinity Epic is a pixel action role-playing game with rogue-like elements. Through a series of choices, players acquire epic artifacts, enhance epic equipment, upgrade epic skills, choose their epic pets, and ultimately confront formidable evil gods! This is a casual pixel fantasy-style game, where the flames of war engulf the continent and gods of various races descend to the earth. In order to compete for resources and divine power, survive as much as possible. Collect coins and soul crystals from each battle to strengthen yourself and your companions, and welcome the ultimate victory together! Collect more artifacts to enhance your abilities. Choose a set of equipment that suits you, handy skills, and specialize in one aspect (critical strike, elemental, physical, summoning, speed, area, projectile). Challenge epic bosses to obtain fragments of their divinity. Choose suitable pet companions; the more of the same race, the more bonuses provided. Tips: At the respawn point, choose your profession, artifact, and deity. Complete the NPC task in the first level as soon as possible and unlock the merchants in the Divine Kingdom. Before starting the level, talk to the blacksmith and craft a handy weapon. Take a stroll around the city to acquire some initial items and pets. Supports mouse, keyboard, and controller.
row.short_description: Come and defeat the evil gods! Create your personal outfit, overcome the siege of numerous monsters and leaders, and usher in a new victory! Gods Wars is a pixel ARPG Rogue like Game. You can obtain epic artifacts, upgrade epic skills, choose your epic pet, face the powerful evil gods!

row.name: 重生之我是小虾米
row.detailed_description: 【Flying snow shoots the white deer, wishing to fulfill a dream in the martial arts world.】 With the clanging of weapons and the sword in hand, we roam the world, striving to uphold justice in the ever-changing martial arts world. With cold garments and iron swords, we march thousands of miles; who in the world does not know of us? Scholars and beauties, love and hatred, behind the flashing swords lies a hidden life of passion and affection. The ages-old saying 'Emotions only leave regrets' holds true, as one pities those who turn grey before growing old. Astounding events, stirring emotions, startling dreams, and heart-wrenching moments—only after all these shocking experiences do we understand that this journey through storms is called 'roaming the martial arts world.' 【Game Features】 Open-world and plot settings with freedom to roam the martial arts world. Relaxed gameplay mode with idle-style growth enjoyment. High character engagement, with full NPC recruitment and sparring. Diverse companion combinations with highly flexible development and growth. Many exciting features to be unlocked in future updates.
row.short_description: With armor-clad horses and swords in hand, we roam the world, fighting for justice in a martial arts realm full of change and turmoil. Clad in cold garments and wielding iron swords, we march thousands of miles; who in the world does not know of us?

row.name: Dynasty Legends 2

Thrilling battle experience allows you wipe out thousands of enemies all by yourself, become the overlord of the Three Kingdoms. Stunning graphics, bring you back to chaotic ancient battlefields. Join the battle with your friends now and build up your empire! ▶Break through the Limit◀ Designed with Next-Gen technology, it will give you the ultimate experience on your phone! Ultra-high quality 3D models and special effects bring you a stunning visual experience! ▶Great Battlefield◀ Rebuild a broad ancient battlefield which accommodate hundreds of soldiers on the same screen. You can slaughter thousands of enemies in a single stage. One vs thousands! You're unstoppable! ▶Real-Time PVP◀ Various PVP modes, 1v1, 3v3, 60v60, each of them will make you thrilled!
