You can stand beside those legendary heroes and create your own legend!
row.short_description: Stunning Next-Gen ARPG is coming! One vs thousands, battlefield is waiting! Be the God of War, you're unstoppable!

row.name: Alphabet
row.detailed_description: Item Rarities and Drop Rates: The game features a diverse range of items, each with its own rarity and corresponding drop rate: Common (50%) Uncommon (24%) Rare (12%) Epic (7%) Exotic (4%) Mythical (2%) Legendary (1%) These probabilities determine how frequently you’ll obtain each rarity type. Common items are abundant, while legendary items are extremely rare and highly sought after. Steam Marketplace Integration: The game integrates with the Steam Marketplace, allowing players to acquire items from the market. This enriches the game's ecosystem, providing access to a wide array of items beyond those available in the in-game drop system. Crafting and Item Drops: Players can craft new items by combining five items of the same rarity. The crafted item will have a higher rarity, offering players a way to upgrade their inventory. Time-Based Item Drops: Every 30 minutes of gameplay, players receive a new item drop. This system ensures a steady influx of items, encouraging continued play and engagement. Showcase Feature: Players can use the items they collect to create words in their Steam profile showcase. This feature allows for a personalized touch, as players can arrange items to spell out their favorite words, messages, or names. The showcase adds a social and creative element to the game, making each item more valuable and meaningful.
row.short_description: Alphabet is an exciting clicker that will immerse you in the world of letters and words. In this game you can get letters of different rarity for the time spent in the game. Collect letters, discover new words and use them to create unique items.

row.name: 아스타나 이야기 ~누가 다키마쿠라 만들었어!~
row.detailed_description: About This Game Plot One peaceful day, Queen Quinshua heard that her illegal dakimakura was being made and decided to take action to stop it 'Astana Story -Who Made Dakimakura!-' is a fan game of Korean vertuber 'Queen Shua' created through RPG MAKER MV (hereinafter RMMV). This is a game where the main goal is to stop the evil(?) plot of her followers, the Chevaliers, and restore peace. It consists of a total of 5 stages. The player must control Queenshua with the keyboard and use her special move, Neck Slice, to subdue the fleeing Chevaliers. The Chevaliers will not attack. How can you attack when the target you need to protect is running towards you? I have no choice but to run away. At the end, there is a boss battle against the leader of the evil(??) plot. He'll never go down in one go, so you'll have to attack him multiple times. Between stages, you can wander around the castle, talk to the Chevaliers, and watch humorous events. There are events such as getting help from colleagues to solve problems to advance to the next stage. Find hidden rooms and items and collect collectible elements If you collect them all, there's nothing special, but it has the effect of making you feel proud. Manipulation We recommend using the arrow keys.
row.short_description: One peaceful day, Queen Quinshua heard that her illegal dakimakura was being made and decided to take action to stop it

row.name: The Pauser
row.detailed_description: 'The Pauser' is a narrative adventure game, independently developed by a university student who took a break from studies to create this game. Mr. Egg has finally awakened... after a nightmare. However, as he moves forward, he realizes something strange— the world seems... paused. In this game, players take on the role of a father on a journey to find his child. You'll need to use paused blocks to progress, but beware—numerous ads will pop up along the way. If you choose to watch them, the game's difficulty will drop significantly. Sounds great, right? ......right? This game satirizes the growing trend of 'watch ads to get rewards' in games and the increasing ads on social media and video platforms. The developer, frustrated by constant ad interruptions while watching videos, created this game to purposely disrupt the player's experience, giving you a taste of that frustration and expressing dissatisfaction with the current digital landscape. Welcome to try this game and enjoy it. This game is entirely free! The author made this game with 'love'. If you'd like to support my continued game development, you're welcome to make a small donation via my Instagrant 'ya_make game_ ya' where has a link to 'buy me a coffee'. The minimum amount on that platform is about $5. If you'd prefer to donate a smaller amount, please wait for the release of the DLC and purchase it. Please note: The DLC will not contain any additional game content. It is simply a way to support the author. Please carefully consider and evaluate your ability before purchasing. Thank you! How To Control： A/D ：left/right Space：jump Enter： Dialogue If any wrong happends,please use 'load game' button.
row.short_description: 'The Pauser' is a narrative adventure game, developed by a student who drop out to make games. Player can stack blocks or 'pause' them mid-air to help the character pass levels.You can choose to watch 'ads' to 'speedrun' the game. But, is that really what you want? It all depends on you!

row.name: Signs Of Life
row.detailed_description: Signs of Life is a non-linear, surreal story driven adventure game. You are thrown into a bizarre scenario: a small woman with a mask is asking for your help to investigate a disembodied head she found in the backyard's hedge maze. Who is friend, who is foe, and how did we end up here? Play to find out. Features Non-linear story driven adventure game. Unique hand drawn 2D Art-Style and 2D animation with customizable character. Explore and click around to solve puzzles, play mini-games, and find objects including: Journal entries Books Objects to complete quests Slide puzzle Rhythm game Interactive objects to discover along your journey, such as singing flowers and a moon that talks back. Original Soundtrack by Caleb Jordahl.
row.short_description: A meditative, non-combative point-and-click mystery set in a surreal, stop-motion inspired world. Explore dreamlike environments, uncover hidden objects, and piece together quiet clues to unravel fragments of forgotten meaning. Designed for players seeking a thoughtful, atmospheric experience.
row.notes: This game contains surreal and symbolic content that may not be suitable for all audiences. It includes stylized nudity (no genitalia), suggestive humor, unsettling body imagery (such as disembodied figures and self-surgery involving limbs), depictions of a character consuming a baby, references to drug-like experiences, and a storybook sequence with sexually themed and crude language. Please note: the game does not depict or glamorize sexual assault, suicide, or drug use, but it may touch on emotionally intense topics such as grief, isolation, and bodily transformation through symbolic or narrative means.

row.name: Sim Solver
row.detailed_description: Deploy into Sim Solver and play as a debugging software with a bit of a twist! A handful of nasty viruses have corrupted a series of varied simulations which at one point allowed people to explore and live out their wildest fantasies in a number of settings and styles. row.name: Animals
row.detailed_description: About the Game Welcome to Animals , a dynamic clicker game where your clicks matter! Collect unique animals and grow your collection as you explore different habitats. Why Play Animals? • Interactive and Engaging : Your efforts directly impact your rewards. The more you play, the more you earn! • Community Driven : Our game evolves with input from our community. Join us and have your say in the game’s development. • Strategic Clicking : With varied habitats and adaptive drop rates, each play session offers new strategies and challenges. Gameplay : • Active Clicking: The more you click, the better your chances of receiving rare and legendary items. • Animal Habitats: Explore four distinct verticals - Aerial, Arboreal, Terrestrial, and Aquatic. Each habitat offers unique animals and influences your click strategy. • Adaptive Drop Rates: Your drop chances are influenced by the avatar and habitat you’re exploring. Each vertical has its own drop rates for rare and legendary items. And of course, you'll recieve an animal from your active avatar's habitat. • Your Active Avatar: You can select any of your animal avatars from the inventory to click on, each group has their boosts and attributes. But be careful when selling them, as if you only have 1, you won't be able to click on it. You will still be receiving drops, but wasting the ability to increase your chances by session + today + history clicks. Features : • Animal Collection : Discover and collect a variety of animals, each with its own unique traits. • Boosts and Enhancements : Rare and legendary items provide significant boosts to your clicks per second (CPS), increasing your chances of finding more valuable items. • Regular Drops : Receive a common avatar drop almost every 3 hours (2.5h to be accurate, where chances from 80% to 100% depending on the rarity of your active animal avatar), and a rare or legendary item drop every 3 hours, with chances affected by your clicking activity. Take into account you'll receive animal drops from your active avatar habitat. • Community Integration : Submit your animal designs via Discord and see them come to life in the game! Join our vibrant community and contribute to the game’s evolution. Community Driven: • Collaborative Creation : We are in constant contact with our community, and our vision is to have players design new inventory items and animals. Your creations could be the next big hit in the game! • Building a Metaverse : Our goal is to create a larger metaverse. Animals is just the beginning. Future games, like a Tycoon game, will allow you to use your collected avatars, maintaining continuity and adding depth to your gaming experience. Join us in Animals and see how your clicks can lead to an extraordinary collection of animals! Join our Discord!
row.short_description: Animals is an engaging clicker game where every click counts. Explore unique habitats like Aerial, Arboreal, Terrestrial, and Aquatic, and collect diverse animals. Earn regular and rare drops influenced by your click activity. Join our community to help shape the game and build a vast metaverse.

row.name: SCP: CARDTAINMENT BREACH
row.detailed_description: SCP: CARDTAINMENT BREACH is a singleplayer free-to-play strategy deck building game based on the SCP Foundation universe, an open source horror/fantasy writing project starring hundreds of anomalous objects and creatures. THE STORY In this game, you play as a human prisoner designated D-9341 who has found themselves inside of SCP-079s containment chamber due to a containment breach in which dozens of entities have escaped and caused havoc. You then find out that 079 was the one who instigated the breach, and similarly to you, has the same goal as you: freedom. 079 is willing to form an uneasy alliance, as you would make its job much easier. However, it does not fully trust in your capabilities, and due to the nature of the facility, cannot trust you unless you are useful to it. 079 needs to know if you are capable and intelligent enough to be useful, and luckily has a program built into itself that the foundation used to play with it to test its capabilities. If you fail the game, 079 states it will have to dispose of you through lethal means. This game however, to prevent 079 from learning even more data about the outside world, was based entirely off of the creatures and objects stored in the facility. This allowed 079 to piece together how the creatures worked and how to best exploit their weaknesses and strengths, and was able to formulate a plan for a containment breach. THE GAMEPLAY In this game, you put together a deck of 8 cards, including: 5 entity cards (SCPs like 173, 096, 106, 049, etc.) 2 item cards (131, 009, 500, etc.) 1 passive card (001, 207, 018, etc.) The game has a turn based structure in which both you and 079 will place down one entity card and one item card per turn. Afterwards, the cards enter the 'combat' stage, in which every card on the board, from top-left to bottom-right, will use their abilities. Some cards have special abilities, other cards can be stacked to build up their stats, known has horde cards. Certain passive cards have abilities based on the daytime, which is only visible if a daytime based card is on the board. Every 3 days, the day/night cycle will change. You and the opponent both have 10 HP, and to attack your opponent, your entity cards must enter the combat stage without having a card on the opposing side, thus leaving them open. Max HP can be configured before starting the game. Once you've proven yourself to 079, you can attempt again to see if you can beat it with a different or better strategy. This time, 079 does not threaten you with fatal consequences if you lose. You can play as many times as you want, as even if you lose and are 'disposed of' you may re-enter the game and try again.
row.short_description: SCP: CARDTAINMENT BREACH is a single-player turn based deck building card game based on the universe of the SCP foundation. You play as D-9341 who has been trapped in a room by 079 but has promised that on finishing of the game will unlock the gates and allow you to escape

row.name: Muramasa Burden
row.detailed_description: The world is invaded by the Yokai spirits. The resistance is destroyed and the hope is lost, but the whispers are calling you to accept the burden. Embrace the curse of mysterious katana with all of its power in order to reach the heart of invasion and defeat the God of Yokai. Everything requires a sacrifice… The game narrative is inspired by Japanese mythology and built in the genre of dark fantasy. You will fight armed with the cursed sword on two unique looking locations with multiple arenas and bosses in the end of each location. Unique part of this Hack and Slash game is its health system. Instead of typical health points you have a timer, which represents the curse. You need to defeat enemies in battle in order to receive time. The curse also gives you superhuman abilities like instant dash and you can launch a deadly projectile with your sword. Another unique mechanic is a demonic rage. Less time you have left - stronger rage becomes. It has two stages which trigger automatically and each stage increases your attack and movement speed, damage and It also enchances your abilities. If you want - you can manually activate special stage of rage. This stage will unleash the beast within Samurai, giving even more bonuses, but the timer will run significantly faster. Use these gifts of the curse to defeat Yokai and banish them from our world! After you beat the game - your record will be saved in the global leaderboard and you will be able to compete with other players for the fastest completion of the game! The game is made by the student team of University of Applied Sciences Darmstadt, Germany. There are 5 members in internal team,2 sound production students and independent music composer.
row.short_description: Wield a cursed katana to defend the world of living against Yokai spirits from other realm.

row.name: Command & Conquer™ Tiberium Alliances
row.detailed_description: The beloved online browser-based C&C title has arrived on Steam! Invite your friends to join the battle! Enter the legendary Command & Conquer universe, where the epic conflict between the formidable Global Defense Initiative (GDI) and the mysterious Brotherhood of Nod (NOD) continues. Choose between two iconic factions—GDI and NOD—each with unique buildings, offensive units, and defensive units. Forge powerful alliances, strategize with friends, and dominate the battlefield in a game that rewards tactical skill and cooperation. Enjoy months of gameplay as you expand your base, enhance your units, and rise through the ranks in this dynamic, resource-driven war. row.name: Until Oblivion
row.detailed_description: Harold they're destroying the universe Until Oblivion is a slightly horrific narrative game that follows 17 year old nobody Emma Wilson as she tries to rekindle a dying relationship in a dying world. Join her in an increasingly nightmarish Halloween party and find out if anything (or anyone) is worth anything at all. Featuring an atmospheric hand-crafted world, striking gothic imagery, and teenage takes on faith, work, and interpersonal relationships, Until Oblivion is a unique psychological experience whose horror is only usurped by its heart. And there are lesbians. Features: 2.5D stylized artwork Interactive dialogue with branching paths Themes of loneliness, love, and loss Time-loop yuri Gradually building horror Dark secrets and hidden lore He's watching you Flashing lights, bright colors, mild gore, implied self harm, mild jumpscares, disturbing imagery, depictions of hallucinations/insanity, swearing, possibly grating noises. I would like to honor the following people who helped during the development process, and whose contributions made this game a reality: Oli Remmy Lily Vivian Thank you so much for reading and checking out my game's page. This game is a pure passion project of mine and will always be 100% free, but you can help out by wishlisting if you're interested!

row.name: Gladiate!
row.detailed_description: Friends. Romans. Countryfolk. CYBORGS! The fall of Rome never came to pass. Chariot races and gladiator fights abound, and the coliseum has become the default building on the streets of the world. Blood sport is the sole reason for the living, to beat up your fellow Romans to a pulp with enhanced limbs and senses. Can you make it to the final boss and emerge victorious? Gameplay Gladiate is a spectacle fighter card game, where its not about how fast you win, its about how cool you look doing it. Choose your deck and compete against mighty enemies for the adoration of the crowd, and maybe even a thumbs up from emperor Cybigula himself! Key Features 6 Unique playable decks with high score saved for each. 27 Unique cards to delight and destroy with 19 combos to dazzle the crowd 4 card classes 7 battles to fight through Custom music tracks to get stuck in your head. Day night cycle 1 Bossy Boi About Gladiate This is the first project from Teicsoft. A bunch of friends who decided to set themselves the task of making a game from scratch, in a month, with little to no experience. A whole lot was learned, skills we didn't know we had were found, and we hit our deadline to be able to present gladiate to you!
row.short_description: Play with 6 unique decks and fight your way through a gauntlet of foes. Not only do you need to fight to survive, but also pull off combos to maximize your spectacle points and please the crowd. Can you make it to the final boss and emerge victorious?

row.name: Lost quest
row.detailed_description: Escape the Labyrinth: The Premise: You are the Prey, an unwilling participant trapped within a massive, ancient labyrinth. Its singular purpose hunts you. This is an Action/Adventure FPS focused on shooting ennemies, suspense, and survival. I. The Goal: Escape the Labyrinth The primary objective is straightforward, but the means are complex: Find the single, elusive exit and escape The Labyrinth. II. Character Progression: Adaptation and Augmentation A. Mastery and Insight (Non-Numeric Progression) Effect: Unlocks new Tactical Insights on the HUD (e.g., 'The Stone-Walkers are deaf to non-metallic sounds,' 'This floor tile always collapses after two steps'). This allows for non-combat bypasses. Weapon Familiarity: Simply using your 'best weapon' over time doesn't increase its damage. Instead, it improves the Character's Handling of it. III. Game Mechanics: Resource Scarcity, Tension, and The Labyrinth's Sentience The core gameplay loop is built around the terror of running out of resources while being stalked by an environment that actively opposes you. A. The 'Every Bullet Counts' System Resource Scarcity: Ammunition is incredibly scarce. A standard engagement might cost 5-10 bullets, but you might only find 2-3 in the entire next room.
row.short_description: Bring your best weapon, this is a massive, ancient structure designed for one purpose: trapping the unwary. This isn't just a maze; it's a living entity, and you are its prey in this action/adventure game !

row.name: Szikra
row.detailed_description: Szikra (Spark in Hungarian) is a relaxing, 2.5D side-scrolling short game set in a unique steampunk/fantasy environment. You have to find your way through vast fields, magical forests, and giant gears in a steaming factory to reach the twisted circus where your friend is locked up. There is no combat, no dying, and no way to fail. However, you will still need a few well-timed jumps, and you must find switches and push boxes around to get to your destination. Visual style The world and visual style of the game were inspired by the beautiful paintings of Anita Tóth (Worlds Within). In many places, you can find the original paintings in the game. Free to play Szikra was created in about 10 months by a sole developer as a fun project and is free to play. If you enjoyed playing the game, please consider supporting me by buying the Soundtrack DLC.
row.short_description: A relaxing, 2.5D side-scrolling short game set in a unique steampunk/fantasy environment. Find your way through vast fields, magical forests, and giant gears in a steaming factory to reach the twisted circus where your friend is locked up. Jump, find switches, push boxes around to get there.

row.name: PockeDate! - Pocket Dating Simulator
row.detailed_description: PockeDate! – Your Pocket-Sized Dating Simulator! Every launch brings a new date with unique dialogues! Spend endless hours with your adorable, love-struck virtual girlfriend. Meet Akari – your virtual sweetheart, head over heels for you. But be careful not to let her down! Through engaging interactions and unique scenarios, you'll learn how to communicate better, handle awkward moments, and make your date feel special. Get ready to boost your dating skills and confidence while having a blast with Akari! Features: Free! Familiar date spots with unique twists each time. Adorable girl who forgives all your awkwardness! Cozy, heartwarming atmosphere. Secret dates to discover! Charming pixel art graphics. Original soundtrack. Get ready for the cutest, most heartwarming dates of your life with PockeDate! PockeDate! - Pocket Dating Simulator is a visual novel where players read text, make choices, and influence the story's outcome. The game has an auto-save and auto-load function. The game does not guarantee the appearance of a real girlfriend after gaining experience in this game. Dear Participant, Your experience in PockeDate may include unsettling or frightening moments. While Akari is here to comfort you, her current state may occasionally become unstable due to unresolved system issues. We advises caution. Unexpected events are part of this experiment. Thank you for your participation.
row.short_description: Your Pocket-Sized Dating Simulator! Every launch brings a new date with unique dialogues! Spend endless hours with your adorable, love-struck virtual girlfriend.

row.name: Gorble
row.detailed_description: Gorble is a short marble-based dungeon crawl. You are a marble and you explore a dungeon and fight enemies. Estimated play time 10-20 minutes. row.detailed_description: This horror game is impossible for cowards to beat 'Don't Drop The Cake' is a horror game where you must carry a wobbly cake while navigating a space infested with terrifying creatures. No matter how hard you try to hide your fear, it's obvious Even if you say, 'Fear is not in my vocabulary,' deep down, you might be scared. In this game, you must use your mouse to balance the cake and prevent it from falling. If your hands start to shake or you panic, the cake will fall, and your fear will be exposed for everyone to see. Face Unique and Terrifying Creatures In this game, you'll encounter uniquely designed, terrifying creatures unlike anything you've seen before. Use your wits and courage to avoid getting caught by them. Regarding Video Streaming Feel free to stream. This game is a prologue version. This challenge isn’t for cowards. Only the brave and composed will make it through. Are you up for it?

row.name: My Dear Delirium
row.detailed_description: Elliot is a troubled boy with a troubled mind, desperately clinging to the world around him. What would happen if his reality were called into question? row.name: Catastrophic Cat Command
row.detailed_description: Command thousands of cats on their journey to find a new home! Catastrophic Cat Command is an arcade-style game where you manage multiple mini-games at once! It’s the perfect game for a quick 5-minute break from work! There are currently a total of 12 mini-games that take only a few seconds to complete. You’ll start with only one game active, but every 60 seconds, a new game spawns that you have to manage simultaneously. It gets stressful pretty fast, so bring a sweatband. The game starts in Tutorial Mode, where you can try out all available mini-games in a less stressful environment. Once you’re familiar with all the games, you can start the main mode by pressing Enter. Here, you’ll try to save as many cats as you can until you inevitably fail.

row.name: Dungeon Divers Prologue
row.detailed_description: Prologue Features 2/3 main campaigns 0/10 challenge campaigns 24/48 items can be unlocked 8/12 secret room types included All progress carries over to the main game! Dungeon Divers is a dungeon-themed roguelike puzzle game about clearing derelict dungeons. As the newest employee of Dungeon Divers Inc., you must advance through multiple levels, use your wits, and tools you acquire along the way to get to the core to defuse it and bring home the cash. Test Your Wits With nearly a dozen different types of rooms to disarm each with their own conditions, quirks, and logic to solve what starts off as a simple task will become increasingly complex and difficult to decipher. Choose carefully as you only have a finite number of tries before your mission is deemed a failure. An Arsenal At Your Disposal As you progress through the dungeon you're clearing, objects of power may be uncovered to assist in your journey. Some simply help you survive mistakes, other may grant you the ability to uncover vital clues for your efforts, and some grant you extra riches. Choose wisely as you can only carry so many artifacts at once. Every Dungeon Is Different No two dungeons share the same layout. Procedural generation means that every delve is different providing countless hours of entertainment as you clear level after level.

row.name: obi3011-prologue
row.detailed_description: This store page features the free prologue content of 'Obi 3011', which will take approximately 4 hours to complete. If you're interested, please add our full game 'Obi 3011' to your wishlist. Thank you! The English and Japanese versions may contain minor bugs and translation issues. If you encounter any problems, please do not hesitate to reach out to me! You can provide feedback in our community or through reviews, and I will make the necessary corrections promptly. Thank you! Korean and Western ban'ya languages are being added!  -Game Introduction- In the game, you play as an unnamed robot who is reclusive, loves staying at home, and is addicted to alcohol. Once again, after excessive drinking, you collapse on the street and are picked up by an unknown canine furry and taken back to your own home. But through a series of coincidences, he suddenly loses his memory! During this process, you meet other furry companions and embark on an adventure to search for his memory! However, in this tumultuous era, adventure is fraught with danger. As you help him regain his memories, your bond grows stronger, and at the same time, some hidden secrets gradually surface, making everything seem different... Faced with these harsh realities, can you make the right choices to ensure he remains the same person, and your relationship remains unchanged? -Game Features- ■ The game's storyline revolves around a sweet and humorous adventure-filled daily life. If you have a particular fondness for beastmen, younger partners, shota, non-human, robots, romance, comedy, adventure, cyberpunk, pixel art, psychological horror, and more, then this game is a must-try! ■ Exceptional gameplay presentation, featuring exquisite pixelated CGs, UI, and backgrounds, with many visual effects animated! ■ An abundance of character illustrations! Nearly two dozen distinct illustrations for the canine beastman and other characters, with over a hundred separate facial expressions, all animated! ■ Five different endings (though not an overwhelming number)! ■ A lengthy gameplay experience, with the demo lasting around 5 hours and the full game expected to take around 15 hours to complete, featuring approximately 300,000 words of text. ■ The protagonist, as a robot, lacks a traditional, fixed gender. ■ Care for an adorable, clingy canine beastman and embark on an adventure while nurturing a sweet romance! -Worldview- This is a cyberpunk world dominated by fierce beastmen, filled with technology, chaos, and violence. Once a highly advanced technological civilization, humans genetically engineered beastmen—new species with immense strength and unique appearances. However, a century ago, an unforeseen global upheaval struck, and no one knows what exactly happened. This disaster devastated the world, leading to the extinction of most species, including humans. Amidst the ruins, the surviving beastmen gradually rose to power. The once-prosperous technological civilization has collapsed, and most high-tech devices and knowledge have been lost. Over the past hundred years, beastmen have studied and researched the lost technology, mastering most basic scientific principles and technologies, but many human-made high-tech devices are damaged or non-functional. In this context, almost all beastmen resent humans, even though they've been extinct for a century. -Character Settings- Protagonist An android created by humans before the great catastrophe of the last century, almost indistinguishable from humans except for their lack of gender and the ability to access the internet and play games within their minds. Though capable of living for over a hundred years, they spend most of their time in hibernation until discovered and studied by beastmen ten years ago. Equipped with an omnipotent AI, their emotional intelligence seems lacking, perhaps to make them appear more human. They have no name, often referred to as 3011 due to being the last model of their kind, a title they dislike. Obi A canine beastman who has lost his memory, and no one knows his identity. Unlike other beastmen, his appearance is more human-like. what's their story? ---------------------------------------------------------------- !Important Note! The game contains depictions of gender identity, and psychological horror, which may not be suitable for everyone. Additionally, the game includes bright, flickering visuals that may be distressing or trigger seizures for individuals with photosensitivity. Please proceed with caution.
row.short_description: This is a cyberpunk-themed pixelated psychological horror, romance, and adventure game. Amidst a chance encounter in the rain and a forced gathering, an unexpected journey unfolds—a humorous romance and adventure story between you, a robot, and your furry companions.

Receive tips and leads from online sources to uncover valuable resources, for which you pay a fair price. Employ a Skilled Workforce: Hire employees to assist with sorting and processing materials. Delegate tasks strategically to optimize workflow and increase productivity. Dynamic Market Economy: Adapt to a fluctuating market where prices for materials change based on supply and demand. Stay competitive by adjusting your strategies and seizing profitable opportunities. Become the Recycling Tycoon: From a small-scale operation to a leading recycling powerhouse, every decision shapes your success in Recycle Center Simulator: Prologue. Contribute to environmental sustainability while growing a thriving business that turns waste into valuable resources. Are you ready to transform trash into treasure and lead the way in eco-friendly entrepreneurship? Start your journey in Recycle Center Simulator: Prologue today!

row.name: Pixel Restorer
row.detailed_description: As the last pixel restorer in the city, your job is to restore faded photographs that have been sealed away for a long time to their original glory. **Gameplay**: 1. After entering the game, the image will automatically be divided into regions. You need to fill each region completely with rectangles of varying sizes based on the numbers provided. 2. Each rectangle must contain one number, and the number must equal the total number of cells in that rectangle. Once all regions are correctly filled, the level is complete. 3. Hold down the mouse button and drag over the cells to draw a rectangle. To erase a rectangle, hold down the mouse button and drag over it. 4. The three buttons on the left side of the screen allow you to refresh the region, get a hint, and view the full image. **Game Features**: 1. Retro pixel style 2. Carefully designed pixel artwork 3. Levels that are easy but still challenging 4. Simple and intuitive controls 5. A large number of levels 6. Relaxing background music

row.name: Cards of Heart
row.detailed_description: This is the story of a girl who faced her Shadows… who, in the face of darkness, found her light. Amalia is a librarian’s assistant living in the small fantasy town of Respite who’s haunted by Shadows- dark beings born from her negative inner thoughts. But when a wisp named Ljos appears and gives her the ability to create cards of light from her everyday life, Amalia must use this power to face her Shadows and learn how to move forward while acknowledging the pain of her past. Developed in consultation with clinical psychologists and therapists, Amalia's abilities in the game are inspired by real-life therapeutic techniques. Amalia’s journey highlights both the uncomfortable reality of living with mental health challenges like depression and anxiety and the power of finding ways to manage them. Explore the town of Respite. Complete errands for townsfolk ranging from baking macarons to story time in the library! As you face more Shadows, you’ll unlock more of the town, giving you more areas to explore. Collect cards from Amalia's everyday experiences and build your deck. With each quest Amalia completes, she’ll create a card with stunning hand-drawn art and its own unique effects. What happens if you collect them all? Face Amalia’s Shadows in card battles. Learn the patterns of each Shadow, then counter them using techniques and strategies drawn from therapeutic practices. Will you combine cards to create chains of thought and reflect Shadow’s cards back at them? Or will you use Techniques to add extra cards to your hand and remove devastating debuffs from Amalia? How you approach each one is up to you! Upgrade your cards after every loss. Take a step back with Amalia and practice self care to make your cards even stronger! Uncover Amalia’s memories . Experience a story of love and loss as Amalia processes her past with her light spirit companion, Ljos. Where did the Shadows come from, and what memories are they hiding? Pet the dog. Yes, you do get a card for that. Cards of Heart was developed as a Master’s thesis project at the University of Southern California. Directed by Marielle Brady, the game was made over the course of a year by a team of 30+ students passionate about normalizing stories about mental health challenges and ways to manage them. Content note: Cards of Heart deals with themes of anxiety, depression, loss, and mental health challenges. Please consider whether these topics are right for you. If you need to seek help, there are a number of resources available online.
row.short_description: Join Amalia on her journey to confront her inner Shadows! Complete errands for town residents, build your deck, face Shadows in gripping card battles, and uncover Amalia’s memories in this cozy, narrative-driven, deck-building RPG.

Led along by the snarky ship AI, you'll pick up tools and upgrades along the way. Just be careful- In space, no one can hear you clean. DOOMBA is the product of three person team MJR- Malachi Franson (Level Design, Programming, Tech Art), Joshua Watson (3D Generalist), and Rees Jackson (Environment Art and Materials) for our Senior Thesis 2024 for the Game Art program at Ringling College of Art and Design.

row.name: Entity Onboard
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the B.B.S.S., a top of the line research space station that is studying a planet before its inevitable collapse into the near by black hole. During one of their trips to the planet, they come across an unknown entity which they bring onboard as a research specimen. In their keycard secured lab, everything is going fine until the entity breaks free, leaving the station without a crew. As you awake from cryogenic sleep, you find yourself alone. With no friends/crew mates around, just a tape recorder and flashlight to assist, you must avoid the unknown entity and reach the escape pod before you drift into the black hole. The station is in emergency power mode so, you must power each level to access the elevators. Can you escape with the help of your friends’ tapes or will you be consumed by this entity? Dive into this space station and use a variety of mechanics at your disposal to keep yourself alive. Balance your sanity and oxygen while hiding within the light. Try not to make too much noise and bring attention to yourself. This game hosts two game modes, a free-play as well as story mode that allows you to progress. There are also a number of collectables hidden throughout the levels for you to find! Can you find them all?
row.short_description: In this sci-fi survival horror game, you'll use tools such as a flashlight and tape recorder to survive while a mysterious entity chases you. Hide in the light and don't let it touch you. Power up each floor to escape!

row.name: Face The Abyss
row.detailed_description: Description 'Face the Abyss' is 1 vs 3 PvP game. One player takes on the role of the monster, or 'Stalker', who hunts down the survivors with its powerful psychic abilities. The other three players are the survivors, or 'Crew', who must find a way to escape. Indoor Chase The Stalker chases the Crew through a narrow and complex facility, relying on sound and terrain features. The Crew must overcome and utilize the limitations of restricted vision in this complex indoor environment to achieve their goal. Escape scenarios Escaping the facility won't be simple. The Crew must complete one of the 'escape scenarios' to make their way out. Observe the current situation carefully and figure out the most appropriate way to escape. Cooperate with other Crew members to achieve the goal quickly. Escape the facility before being overwhelmed by the Stalker's abilities. Stalker and Abilites The Stalker has various abilities at its disposal. Decrease the Crew's sanity with powerful psychic abilities. A Crew member with low sanity is much easier to hunt down. Erode the facility and destroy doors to leave the Crew with nowhere to run. Crew and Items The Crew can find plenty of items throughout the facility. Use these itmes wisely to delay the Stalker's pursuit and stay alive. Some items are essential for completing escape scenarios.
row.short_description: The experiment has failed. The facility that was supposed to control the monster has stopped working, and now your only hope is to escape the facility before the monster hunts you down.
row.notes: This game contains content that may not be appropriate for all ages or may be inappropriate for use in the workplace: frequent violence or general adult content

row.name: Gumballs & Dungeons
row.detailed_description: Dive into this charming and unique roguelike dungeon crawler. Start off on a great adventure, and lead a growing cast of unique Gumballs to defeat the Evil Dominator of the Erathia Continent! Explore procedurally generated dungeons full of different mechanics, devastating bosses, and quests to complete. Discover and team up with hundreds of Gumballs, each with their own unique abilities and design, as well as uncovering numerous easter eggs and surprises. Gumballs & Dungeons is Free-To-Play FOREVER on Steam, with no additional purchases. Come and remember what the pure passion for gaming is all about! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *Compared to the original version, the Steam version is playable offline, and makes dungeon expeditions the core gameplay loop. This means areas and things like the Sky and Space domains have been removed and adjusted appropriately. As it is also a separate version, the profiles cannot be imported or exported between either version. Features Click to reveal your path through the shadows of the dungeon. They could reveal a fierce enemy, an extraordinary event, a cave of mysteries, or...!     Explore over twenty different dungeons, each with their own themes and surprise mechanics!     A Labyrinthian hoard of easter eggs for you to stumble across and enjoy! Make sure to explore every path (both visible and hidden ones)!     Hundreds of unique Gumballs to collect and upgrade, from four different factions and all with unique abilities and skillsets! Link gumballs together to borrow their powers during expeditions!     How deep can you go with our unique Endless Mode? How many powerful bosses can you overcome before you eventually falter?     A space-time rift has opened up to the world one thousand years later. This dungeon is full of nostalgic sights that are now twisted in certain manners...
row.short_description: Embark on a free, exciting roguelike adventure with Gumballs & Dungeons! Collect and find hundreds of Gumballs, all with their own unique abilities, and create a synergistic team to tackle procedurally generated dungeons, discovering secrets and a trove of easter eggs as you explore!
row.notes: There are elements of legal drugs such as cigarettes and alcohol in our game, mild swearing and cursing in the lines, as well as corpses appearing at the end of battles. Other than that there was no other mature content.

row.name: In Your World (I Own)
row.detailed_description: IMPORTANT!! We are having some issues about scaling. If you are a Mac user please change your resolution to 1280x800. If you are a Windows user please change your resolution to 1920x1080. Three musician friends are recording in their studio when everything changes. Utu, the evil god living in an old castle, attacks and throws the world into chaos. Now, the universe and time are in danger. In Your World (I Own) is a 2D RPG game where you join this epic adventure. Utu’s evil plans trap Yaldız in Inanna's universe. Your goal is to explore these dangerous worlds, interact with NPCs, complete quests, and collect five powerful spellements through fun mini-games. When you collect all the spellements, you can reach Gece and restore order to the universes. Your friends' fate is in your hands! Features: Deep story and rich world, Interact with NPCs and complete quests, Fun mini-games and puzzles, Classic 2D RPG gameplay and exploration, Beautiful music and graphics, Join the adventure in In Your World (I Own), collect the talismans, and save the world! Press the space bar to skip dialogues and use the arrow keys to move. Have fun! (ps: if you’d like to give an in depth feedback please don’t be shy and reach us at instagram: @https.tahta @suedakaraahmet or mail us: inyourworldiown@gmail.com)
row.short_description: After a productive session, Yaldız and Gece find themselves in unexpected places and situations. Can you join forces with Inanna to defeat Utu, the god tormenting this duo?

row.name: Native Isekai Defense: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Wishlist The Full Version About the Game Prologue Native Isekai Defense: Prologue is the FREE prologue version and does not reflect the final version of the game. Here you will be able to play co-op with your friends up to 4 players, more stages, characters, and features will be available in the full version. Story Native Isekai Defense takes place in a world called Lumina. Hundreds of years ago, those who called themselves the Progenitors introduced themselves on the world stage. With armies of monsters under their command, the world of Lumina was plunged into an endless great war. Centuries passed, the Progenitors and their monster armies managed to conquer and contaminate one-third of the world. However, hope was not yet lost. The genius alchemist, Ariel, succeeded in creating the Ethereal Nexus, an artifact capable of purifying the land of Lumina that had been contaminated by monsters. With this creation, the time to strike back had arrived. Thus, Project Eden was launched. The Pioneer Corps was formed to go forth and reclaim the lands that had been contaminated! Pioneer Corps Join the Pioneer Corps alongside other players and become an elite soldier of Lumina! Form parties with various characters and take on different missions! Project Eden The time has come to reclaim the lands of Lumina! Activate the Ethereal Nexus in the corrupted lands and protect it from monster attacks until the land is fully purified! Watch Out for Friendly Fire! Watch every move you make! Look around—are your allies nearby? Make sure you don’t hurt them! But if it happens, remember, this is war! Friendly fire is inevitable! There is no war without sacrifice! Become a Hero! In every mission, you will charge into enemy-occupied territory! Use your skills and weapons, and fight alongside your comrades! Protect the Ethereal Nexus with your life, or the life of your comrades! Survive and reclaim our land! And become a hero of Lumina! Waves of Monsters! An endless onslaught of monsters! And there’s a big boss too?! Still, you must survive! Even if it means stepping over the lives of your comrades! For the future! Let’s reclaim and free our land from their filthy hands!
row.short_description: As part of the Pioneer Corps, form a party with other players and take on missions to protect humanity's last remaining land and reclaim the contaminated territories from the enemies!

row.name: Distant Garden
row.detailed_description: 'Distant Garden' is an exploration and building game with inspirations ranging from 'Minecraft' and 'LSD: Dream Emulator' to movies including 'Solaris' (1972). Explore serene landscapes, avoid visions of death, and gather resources to build camps.
row.short_description: An exploration and building game inspired by games like 'Minecraft', 'LSD: Dream Emulator', and more.

row.name: 神器行者: 重生 Playtest
Skill Legends Royale
row.detailed_description: Android mobile game test Skill Legends Royale is a free multiplayer PVP strategy game. Blending rogue-like and auto chess elements, it delivers a fresh gaming experience. Players must equip their auto-battling heroes with the right treasures and skills to outlast all other contenders and secure victory. 12 Unique Archetypes *The game features 12 distinct archetypes, with more to come in future updates. Random Selection of 8 Archetypes *Each match features 8 randomly selected archetypes, ensuring a unique experience every time. Freely Combine Archetypes *Different archetypes complement each other—experiment to craft the most powerful combination. Rich Content *Over 100 skills for endless build possibilities. *60+ treasures to mix and match. *30+ unique heroes, each with distinct traits. Auto Battler-like *Eight players face off online, with everyone fending for themselves. Easy to Pick Up *Everything can be randomized, and heroes auto-battle, letting you play with ease. Thank you for playing our game—we hope it brings you joy. We first developed this gameplay in the Warcraft 3 Editor, where it was enjoyed by over 300,000 players on the KK platform. With over 10,000 reviews and a 9.5 rating, it’s the authentic original “Electronic Fighting Insects” experience. We are committed to keeping the game fresh with continuous updates and look forward to your support.
row.short_description: This is a free multiplayer PvP strategy game that incorporates rogue-like and auto chess elements, players need to equip their auto-battling heroes with the right treasures and skills to ultimately defeat all other players and become the champion.

row.name: Merge Donut
row.detailed_description: About the Game Welcome to the whimsical world of Donuts! Dive into a delightful merge adventure where your mission is simple yet endlessly entertaining: merge on Donuts! Every 3 hours and 18 hours, a surprise Donut will appear, ready to join your vibrant collection. Can you gather them all? Features: A Bounty of Donuts : Discover a diverse array of quirky Donuts, each with its own unique charm. Collectible Items : Find special items to enhance and grow your Donut collection. Merge System : Combine Donuts to unlock new and exciting variations, increasing their value and rarity. Achievement : Unlock a unique achievement as you expand your Donut empire. Endless Fun : With so much to explore and collect, the fun never stops in the world of Donuts! Get ready to collect, merge, and build your way to Donut greatness!
row.short_description: Merge Donut is a delightful clicker game where you click on Donuts! Every 3 and 18 hours, receive a surprise Donut to grow your vibrant collection. Can you gather them all?

row.name: Blackwoods
row.detailed_description: Blackwoods is a story focused FPS with short to medium-length levels, 'bullet-time', weapon throwing mechanics and no weapon reloading to encourage scavenging and the use of enemy weapons. You are 'Hawk'- an untrained, partisan soldier with little weapon training so controlling the Cold-war era weapons is difficult and constant movement is encouraged. Blackwoods takes place in an alternative history diverging shortly after the onset of the cold war. The resistance in the Baltic countries is not suppressed as readily early on which emboldens them and enables them to last far longer than they did in reality. Decades later, the resistance is very close to being a private army with scavenged uniforms and weapons but lacking the training- however, the enemy will not simply sit idle and allow you to grow more powerful. You will be joined in this fight by other members of the Blackwoods unit as well as some unknown characters who have simply been caught up in this battle. The nature of this unit means nobody's true intentions can ever be known so who can you really trust when everything is on the line? Use an array of popular period-appropriate weapons as well as some more rare and experimental weapons from throughout the cold war. Over 40 different weapons can be collected and some may even be used akimbo to really give you some firepower!
row.short_description: Alternate history Cold war FPS. Join the Blackwoods unit and unravel a conspiracy which threatens to end your resistance once and for all.
row.notes: Frequent violence and potentially offensive historical symbols.

row.name: Doner Master Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Döner Master Simulator! Prologue: Döner Master Simulator In the heart of the city, known as the capital of döner, you are taking your first steps towards becoming a döner master. You've seized the chance to take over the legendary döner shop, and this is not just a job; it's an adventure that will change your life. Your task is to prepare delicious döner and maximize customer satisfaction. In this fantastic döner shop, you need to win the customers' favor and grow your business. On your first day, you'll get to know the shop, learn how to use the equipment, and discover how to prepare various ingredients. But it's not just about slicing ingredients and cooking döner. You'll need to customize orders according to the different preferences of your customers. Using all your skills to respond to each customer's needs, satisfy them, and serve the best döner will be crucial. Success depends on how you manage your business. Managing your shop correctly, using the equipment effectively, and preparing perfect döner will make you the best döner master in the city. Are you ready? Start this adventure and become the capital of döner!
row.short_description: 'Run your own döner restaurant in Döner Master Simulator! Prepare delicious döner, satisfy your customers, and grow your business. Become a master döner chef and own the most popular spot in town!'

row.name: Spell of Infinity
row.detailed_description: - 'Spell of Infinity' is a 3D MOBA game set in a world of swords and magic. You can team up with other players and fight in 4:4 battles or compete in boss mob raids. Also, most of the content is open so you can enjoy the game without any separate purchases, so there is no burden! Join the online battlefield right now! - Strategically select 16 heroes to subdue your enemies! (Tank type STR, damage dealer CON, supporter and special magician WIS, ADP who is good at fast growth and non-magical skills) ※ New features, pets, skins, DLC, and heroes will be added regularly! Tens of thousands of years after the creation of the world, the gods fell into eternal sleep, and human greed led them to forbidden magic. The Kingdom of Cory made some kind of deal with 'Darkside' to invade the neighboring Principality of Kudarin and the entire continent beyond, and the 'Eternal Crystal', the source of life and magic power, is gradually losing its power. To determine the future of the world, which is like a light in the wind, the time of the decisive battle between new heroes - those who want to protect and those who want to take over - is imminent. - Free to Play: Get multiple free hero acquisition coupons when you sign up and achieve major achievements - Crystal System: Summon magic crystals anywhere on the map, easily trade with merchants, and manage your inventory. When upgrading the crystal, cast buffs/debuffs and active skills as a supporter of your allies. - Raid Boss Mode: Become a dragon slayer and gain additional Rank Points. - The 'Talisman' item blocks the opponent's CC or debuff skills several times. Also, if you throw the 'Void Orb' at the opponent, the buffs will be removed. Use it at the right time. - The basic pets are powerful, but there are also more special pets available. - Accumulate victory points to increase your rank and raise your country's flag high on the leaderboard. - Eliminate special mobs to earn advanced items or team rewards.
row.short_description: Play for Free !! Enter the world of swords and magic now. Team up with your friends in the fantasy world of your dreams, strategically select your heroes, and conquer your enemies.

row.name: War Of Warship
row.detailed_description: Command history's most iconic war vessels as you build your own massive naval fleet. Level up important tech modules and prepare to dominate the oceans! With four classes of ship, a myriad of upgrades and strategically designed environments, the action never ends. Every match is a unique experience. Hours of strategy, tactical gameplay and pulse-pounding combat await all who take the helm in War of Warships! = Features = Construction of naval base! All over the world can build a naval base, you also need to defend against enemy attacks. Naval construction! Build a powerful naval fleet, more than 20 kinds of types of warships. Form huge Alliances! Join players from around the world, make friends and become allies. There is strength in numbers, so you can work together and take on others in exciting campaign. World War! As you get stronger, you can wage war on other countries and occupied them. Research cutting edge technology! Research new technologies, new equipment and can build warships. Leading technology has a great impact on the entire country.
row.short_description: Command history's most iconic war vessels as you build your own massive naval fleet. Level up important tech modules and prepare to dominate the oceans!
developers: DEEP SIGHT INTERACTIVE Tech Co., Ltd.
publishers: DEEP SIGHT INTERACTIVE Tech Co., Ltd.

row.name: Cactiverse
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Cactiverse where cactus-growing meets dragon-flying in a bizarrely epic mashup! Start with a tiny cactus and water it every four hours. Add more cacti, and the watering schedule speeds up, getting you drops faster! Who knew cacti could be this exciting? But wait, there’s more! Transform into a dragon, blast targets with waterballs, and soar through hoops in a race against time. Show off your skills, rack up high scores, and dominate the leaderboards to win amazing drops! Whether you're a plant enthusiast, a flying ace, or just in it for the giggles, Cactiverse is here to keep you entertained! Key Features: 🌵 Turbo Planting: More cacti = faster drops! Keep that watering can handy! 🌊 Waterball Frenzy: Fly as a dragon and blast everything in sight! 🎯 Hoop Dash: Navigate through hoops and set record-breaking times! 🏆 Leaderboards and Rewards: Climb the ranks, collect awesome drops, and prove your skills! Get ready for a game like no other—grow, fly, and become the ultimate champion in Cactiverse !
row.short_description: The world of Cactiverse, where gardening meets dragon-fueled fun! Grow your cacti, unleash waterballs, and join a vibrant community on Discord. With weekly tournaments and hilarious gameplay, Cactiverse is your next obsession. Fun, challenging, and social—what more could you ask for?

row.name: Stock Stack
row.detailed_description: About This Simulator 'Do you wanna be a millionaire? Everyone has a dream of becoming a millionaire. But it is very hard work. It would be fantastic for me to make my own money and become a millionaire! 'Stock Stack' is a simple game that simulates stock investment and it can be used to educate or compete with your friend Maybe whoever know about investment market more can be a winner because this game reflects the working principles of the real stock market. (not at all!) How to Play First, when you start, you will set your start money and price, rate of price change,. etc of 6 listed stocks\ then your investment is started! You can raise by investing your favorite stock, earn money by working hard, and save your money safely in bank! (with a little interest) That's all, simple. right? Controls All controls are just mouse, keyboard, and... your brain! you need to analyze stock market's flow with it's graph, news, etc,.
row.short_description: 'Stock Stack' is a simple game that simulates stock investment and it can be used to educate or compete with your friend Maybe whoever know about investment market more can be a winner because this game reflects the working principles of the real stock market. (not at all!)

row.name: Car Dealer Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
row.detailed_description: Roadmap About the Game Car Dealer Simulator Early Days is a free prologue to the full Car Dealer Simulator game. Little Sam, the quirky owner of the business, will introduce you to its secrets. He’s not great at keeping things in order, so your task is to buy low, fix up, and sell high. In the full game, if you handle the initial tasks well, you’ll have the chance to take over the business, and then… Everything will be in your hands! Build a business that fulfills your customers’ automotive fantasies. From budget-friendly cars to extravagant rides, seize opportunities, hire the best, provide excellent service, and maximize profits. Grow your company day by day. The key to achieving high profits lies in negotiating when buying old cars. Look for great deals, and during price haggling, stay firm and professional. Not all purchased cars are in working condition, so you’ll need to use a tow truck to transport them. Every car requires diagnostics and preparation before being sold. At Little Sam’s request, you’ll perform your first mechanical and bodywork repairs. In the prologue, the available tools are quite limited. Presenting a car to the customer requires a few tricks. Washing, good photos, and an engaging advertisement will be your allies. Little Sam will guide you through tasks such as washing, taking photos, and creating a sales listing. Remember, customers buy with their eyes, so use the shine of the paint, a full tank, and quality photos to your advantage. Your profits will allow you to continually grow your company. In the prologue, you’ll have the chance to upgrade the car wash, while in the full game, you’ll unlock additional tools, repair zones, and the customer service office.
row.short_description: Free introduction to the full Car Dealer Simulator game takes you on a journey from being Little Sam’s assistant to owning the business. Discover deals, buy low, repair cars, and sell them for a profit.

row.name: Legacy: Tears of Vanfell - Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: Tears of Vanfell - Chapter 1 is an action-packed dungeon crawler with roguelike and hack-'n-slash elements. Choose between a wide cast of characters and climb the Mountain as you swap weapons and grow stronger as a team of up to four player in online Co-op. Explore and climb the procedurally-generated Mountain to find and defeat Bosses, and continue on your journey. During your adventure, you'll pick up powerful new abilities, weapons and equipment, all of which you'll need to use if you plan on surviving. Explore the Mountain with a team of up to four players! Or, if you would rather take on the Mountain by yourself, don't worry -- you may also bring another member of your camp to help you out. Prepare yourself for your next expedition at your campsite. At first, it will be just you and your thoughts... but as you explore, you'll find others willing to help you out -- from other explorers with unique skills, to specialists who can help behind the scenes. During your adventures, you'll meet many characters and grow to understand them and their motivations. But you may also find yourself caught up in the aftermath of a century-old war...
row.short_description: Your life begins anew in front of an imposing mountain... Climb and explore it with a wide cast of characters in this dungeon crawler RPG with up to four player Co-op.

row.name: Grimstone Valley
row.detailed_description: Grimstone Valley is a third-person supernatural action game set in the wild west. Utilize an eldritch arm comprised of powerful tendrils to reposition enemies and control your environment, taking advantage of deadly and alien objects to defeat your foes in fast-paced, tactical combat. Save your home. A doomsday cult attempted to sacrifice you to an unknowable power. They failed. You survived, but the ordeal cost you your arm. In its place now grows a powerful mass of tendrils that move as though they’re alive. Now, the cult’s machinations have twisted the whole of the valley into a nightmarish hellscape overrun with monsters. With your newfound power and a tenuous connection to the force on which the cult calls, you may be the only person capable of stopping them. Master your tendrils. Your alien arm gives you complete control over the world around you. With keen eyes and quick thinking, you can use your surroundings to deal devastating blows to the valley’s alien invaders. Smash them, impale them, burn them, even blow them to kingdom come. Enemies are vulnerable as well; control their movement and launch them across the battlefield to keep yourself out of harm’s way. Eldritch growths and mundane defenses alike can be turned against your foes with smart positioning and practiced aim. Work with the people of the valley. Grimstone Valley may be nearing destruction, but its people are still holding on. Survivors hide out at The Last Spike, a saloon on the outskirts of town that’s been turned into a hub for the local rail workers’ union. The Spike is home to a host of survivors that you can speak to, learn from, and lean on for support. You may be the valley’s last line of defense, but this fight isn’t yours alone.
row.short_description: Grimstone Valley is a third-person supernatural action game set in the wild west. Utilize a lasso-like eldritch arm to control your enemies and your environment, taking advantage of deadly and alien objects to defeat your foes in fast-paced, tactical combat.
row.notes: Body horror, violence/blood, occultism

row.name: BirdLingo: A birdsong learning game
row.detailed_description: Welcome to BirdLingo, a game designed for honing your bird song recognition skills. Immerse yourself in a cute and relaxing atmosphere as you learn the songs of the 44 most common birds in Europe. Explore various habitats such as grasslands, gardens, farmlands, parks and seaside. The more you play, the more birds you unlock! The Bird Library is your companion, helping you track your journey, learn from your mistakes and discover fascinating facts about each bird you’ve encountered. Real-World Applicability Birdlingo simulates the complexities of real-life birdwatching. In the final levels, you’ll face the challenge of identifying multiple bird songs simultaneously across different habitats, mirroring real-world scenarios. Progressive Learning Curve The game starts with helpful assistance that gradually scales back. This scaffolding approach ensures a smooth, progressive increase in difficulty, allowing you to build confidence as you advance. Mastery Through Repetition Birdlingo emphasizes learning through repetition. With multiple games for each habitat and varied recordings of the same song, it reinforces your memory and recognition skills through repeated practice. Thoughtful Design It’s more than a simple quiz. Each challenge is crafted to pair birds with similar calls, striking the perfect balance of difficulty. Our help buttons act as clever guides, providing hints that lead you to the answer through your own discovery, without giving it away. Fun and Addictive Gameplay Birdlingo’s charming visuals make the game both fun and relaxing while the engaging gameplay ensures that you learn without even realizing it. Personalized Learning Experience Your learning journey is in your hands. Whether you prefer an in-depth dive or a lighter touch, the game allows you to tailor your experience. All habitats and levels are endlessly replayable, enabling you to set your own pace. Our bird library is available for those seeking more knowledge, but it’s always optional. When you’re ready for the ultimate challenge, the final stage lets you choose the difficulty you want to tackle. Free and accessible to all.
row.short_description: Welcome to BirdLingo, a game designed for honing your bird song recognition skills. Immerse yourself in a cute and relaxing atmosphere as you learn the songs of the 44 most common birds in Europe.

row.name: CROAK CAFE : FROM POND TO PLATE
row.detailed_description: Create a diverse array of dishes using a multitude of ingredients. Serve to some fun-loving frogs! Upgrade your kitchen to endure the heat! Face a variety of bosses as you rise to the top!
row.short_description: CROAK CAFE: FROM POND TO PLATE is a thrilling roguelike game where you craft dishes under time pressure to serve demanding frogs. Upgrade your skills and face challenging bosses in this fast-paced culinary adventure. Can you become the ultimate chef?

row.name: 若津谷村の祟り
row.detailed_description: ■ストーリー 元気いっぱいな脚本家、寺島司。 クールな犯罪心理学者、速水悠誠。 そんな二人が向かったのは自然豊かな村『若津谷村（わかつやむら）』。 そこで起こった悲惨な事件とは？ 推理×因習村、昔懐かしの本格ミステリー！ ■ゲームの概要 探索型ノベルゲームです。クリックで探索して、メモを集めていき、事件の謎を解き明かしましょう。 エンターとクリックで操作できます。 また、このゲームはスキップができませんのでご了承ください。 ■プレイ時間 1時間程度 ■実況・二次創作について 実況やプレイ動画については報告任意とさせていただきます。 実況してくださった際には、ぷらいべったーで実況のファンアートやレポなどを描く可能性があるので、禁止している場合はなるべくご一報くださると幸いです。 本ゲームを実況、レビューする際に気をつけて頂きたいこと ・犯人やトリックを言いふらす、分かりやすくサムネにする（ふせったーやぷらいべったー、ポイピクなどでワンクッション置くのは大丈夫です） ・犯人やトリック、世界観の粗を探して誹謗中傷する（犯人やこのキャラクターが倫理的に許せないなどは大丈夫です） 作者Twitterにマシュマロを設置しております。 バグの報告はもちろん、感想などもお待ちしております。
row.short_description: 因習村推理ADV
row.notes: 殺人、死体、薬物、アルコールに関する描写が含まれています。

row.name: Big City Dreaming
row.detailed_description: Big City Dreaming is story based point and click adventure open world visual novel. The game is free to play and nowhere near fully completed but still has plenty of content for you to explore. This is a one man team game and the visuals were created with the use of A.I. image generative tools, that's why it's free to play. You play as Harry, an aspiring musician who is looking to find his place in the world. There are plenty of characters to interact with and places to discover as you uncover the secrets of the Big City. This game was made with the Renpy engine.
row.short_description: An open world visual novel filled with lots of intrigue and stories.
row.notes: Mystery.

row.name: Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue
row.detailed_description: About Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue is a first-person survival horror game where you infiltrate the SENARA disguised as a follower to uncover the truth behind a dangerous cult. But once your cover is blown, you're imprisoned—and now, your only goal is to escape. Navigate the claustrophobic corridors of a massive, 6,000-ton ship meticulously recreated from a real vessel. As the truth slowly unravels, you'll come face to face with a grounded, suffocating sense of fear. In this eerie world ruled by faith and fanaticism, you must avoid the eyes of ever-watchful sentinels, collect clues, recover a vital investigation journal, and find your way out. This game is both a standalone experience and a prelude to SENARA: The Sacrament , shedding light on how one key character became entangled in the events to come. Key Features Hyper-immersive realism grounded in reality Experience unparalleled tension and immersion inside a lifelike environment meticulously modeled after a real large-scale vessel. Clue collection & puzzle-based exploration Gather scattered documents, equipment, and items hidden throughout the ship. Solve puzzles to open up your escape route. Hallucinations & auditory illusions in silence Surrounded by hallucinations and whispers in the unnerving silence of the ship, you must maintain your sanity. If your mind breaks—so does reality. The ones who stand in your way Someone—or something—is always watching. Move carefully to avoid patrolling sentinels and uncover the path to truth and escape. Coming Next This game serves as a prologue to the main title SENARA: The Sacrament, shedding light on the origins of the incident and one of its key characters. In the full game, players will follow the protagonist’s attempt to escape a mysterious sinking incident aboard the twin ship of the SENARA, featured in the title SAVE . As you investigate the ship's sinking, you’ll uncover chilling ties between a fanatical cult and the entities lurking in the abyss. Face the full truth—and overwhelming terror—in the upcoming SENARA: The Sacrament .
row.short_description: You must attempt a life-or-death escape from the SENARA — a 6,000-ton vessel meticulously recreated from a real-world ship. This first-person survival horror prologue tells the story of a different survivor, set before the events of 'SENARA: The Sacrament'.

The prologue lets you try a portion of the main game with only a limited number of turrets, tools, and heroes. Step into the arena with IDUN: Prologue, a thrilling slice of our full-length defense RTS where real-time strategy meets rogue-lite chaos. Get a sneak peek at the intense arena mode, where you’ll face overwhelming enemy swarms with a diverse arsenal of turrets, tools, and heroes—just a taste of the full IDUN game that awaits. Each run throws you into procedurally generated arenas filled with unpredictable challenges, unique mission objectives, and an ever-evolving environment. Adapt quickly as massive hordes flood the screen, and leverage destructible terrain to your advantage. With branching paths, powerful upgrades, and varied mission modifiers, every playthrough delivers a fresh and dynamic experience. Real-time Tactical Flexibility Break free from traditional tower defense gameplay—deploy and reposition your units freely, taking full command of the battlefield. Dynamic Battlefield Experience ever-changing missions as the battle against relentless enemy swarms reshapes the terrain. Destruction and enemy remains create new challenges and opportunities, demanding constant tactical adaptation. Play Your Way: Full Control Anywhere Enjoy the freedom to play IDUN however you like! The game offers seamless support for Mouse & Keyboard, Gamepad, Touch, and is now fully optimized for Steam Deck. Take advantage of extensive customization options for both visuals and controls, ensuring the perfect gameplay experience tailored to your preferences.

row.name: Zombie Siege City
row.detailed_description: The world has plunged into terror as gruesome hordes of zombies overrun it. As the hero in this on-rails shooter, you'll navigate the zombie frontier amidst floating brains and intense action. Defending against zombie attacks and protecting survivors is crucial, adding depth to the captivating storyline unique to zombie shooters and apocalypse survival games. Tracking various enemies in the chaotic horde defense can be challenging, but once you unleash your inner demon, nothing can stop you from becoming the ultimate survivor! Trust us on that! Immerse yourself in 'Zombie Siege City,' an FPS zombie shooter set in a terrifying near future where a deadly epidemic has turned the world into a zombie-infested battleground. Fight off a variety of zombies—from zombie prisoners and zombie dogs to epic boss monsters—using over 10 different weapons! Enjoy vibrant cartoon graphics and enhance your 3D pixel gun for greater damage, accuracy, reload speed, or ammo capacity. No zombie, no matter how relentless, can survive your determination to ensure humanity's survival. FPS zombie games have never been this thrilling! Don't miss out if you enjoy action-packed shooting games! Key Features: -Stunning 3D pixel cartoon graphics -Realistic zombie reactions to hits, each type of zombie disintegrates uniquely -User-friendly controls for a more engaging zombie-killing experience -Over 20 types of zombies, including shooting zombies, zombie dogs, and more -Formidable boss monsters -A diverse arsenal featuring 10+ weapons, from revolvers to devastating weapons like rocket launchers -Precision targeting with headshots for instant kills -Skill-based FPS gameplay rewards health management, high headshot percentages, and offers bonus rewards -Rail shooter mechanics The post-apocalyptic world teeming with zombies poses many dangers, but you're prepared for every challenge it throws at you! Grab your weapon, enjoy the thrill of zombie shooting, and don't stop firing until every last zombie is... well and truly dead. Earn rewards for your efforts, unlock new weapons, upgrade existing ones, and exterminate as many walking dead as possible. In 'Zombie Siege City,' your survival skills are put to the ultimate test. Will you be the hero who saves humanity, or will you become another zombie's dinner?

row.name: Envguard

row.name: Floodcore
row.detailed_description: We are developping Floodcore into a full game! Join our discord server for updates and chat with the devs! Floodcore is a puzzle adventure game in which you explore an ancient civilization in a flooded world, and discover a mysterious power to overcome the temple's challenges. This game is a vertical slice made by 5 French students within 8 months as a graduation project. You can expect 15 to 30 minutes of gameplay depending on your affinity with puzzle games and your sense of spatial awareness in a 3D environment. Your power allows you to swap positions with specific objects in the world, or swap them together. Delve further into the temple and solve puzzles that require you to become a part of them. Each area expands on the swap mechanic and makes you use it in different ways. Some will challenge you and require you to anticipate several moves ahead, while others will need you to figure out every possibility, and there are often several different solutions for them! You will discover multiple ruins laid by an ancient civilisation, each with its own visuals and purpose. From the temple's surface to its underground, all the way to a luxuriant garden, you will experience each area differently with their puzzles and atmosphere. At any point in time, you can take a step back and enjoy the calm atmosphere with the sound of waves, birds, wind and waterfalls.
row.short_description: Floodcore is a puzzle adventure game in which you explore an ancient civilization in a flooded world, and discover a mysterious power to overcome the temple's challenges.

row.name: Mark Sharp & The Bar Thieves

Game mechanics You are a bartender trying to make money for your favourite band's gig. To your surprise, the band members are regular customers at the bar. Fulfil their orders as quickly as possible. The longer you take the more angry they get so make sure to check the anger meter! Pick up drinks and snacks at the bar and bring the ordered refreshments to the band members. The boys might ask you to play a certain song using the jukebox. If you want a break from your job, you can have fun using the karaoke machine. Apart from orders, each day one of the members has a quest for you. Be a good person and help them! Will you make it to your dream gig?
