row.name: The Qubit Factory
row.detailed_description: // New Employee Onboarding: Quantum Computing // Below are classical bits , which all regular computers operate on. Boooooring!                    Much more exciting are  quantum bits  (or qubits for short), which are not limited to simple {0,1} states.                     Qubits are so hot right now! They are the building blocks of newfangled  quantum computers . As newly-minted employees of The Qubit Factory you will have the privilege of processing qubits in our state-of-the-art production lines. By harnessing the power of quantum entanglement and superpositions you will help up deliver exciting new computational products to our valued customers!  // ---------------------------------------------- // The Qubit Factory is an open-ended puzzle game about building logic circuits to solve computational tasks, inspired by classic titles from developer Zachtronics. Based on authentic representations of quantum bits and components,  The Qubit Factory  features puzzles based on key concepts and algorithms from the field of quantum computing. Open-Ended Puzzles - Factory employees are encouraged to design their own unique solutions to given tasks. Bonuses will be awarded to those meeting strict efficiency criteria. Convoluted and/or poorly-optimized solutions will be frowned upon. Faithful Physics - Designed and programmed by a real (semi-successful) research scientist in the field of quantum computing: key concepts and algorithms from quantum computing are conveyed accurately, allowing players to build genuine knowledge about quantum computing! Accessible - Core concepts are built slowly, with players encouraged to build foundational understanding in classical computing before progressing to quantum analogues. No prior computer/physics knowledge is assumed!
row.short_description: The Qubit Factory is an open-ended puzzle game incorporating real-life concepts from the cutting-edge field of quantum computing. Design and build logic circuits that manipulate bits and qubits (quantum bits) to solve devious computational challenges!

row.name: 链接塔防 Link Tower Playtest

row.detailed_description: There is a 'tree' here, which forever stands in this place, incapable of doing anything on its own, yet you can shake it. When you do, the tree will drop various fruits, which you can pick up and place in your inventory（ When the numbers on the time sign all turn green and display '0', please use the left mouse button to click and hold the 'tree trunk'. Then, vigorously and rapidly shake the mouse with large movements until the fruit falls off. ）; these are the fruits of your efforts in shaking the tree. Once the tree has dropped its fruits, it enters the next phase. You must wait quietly, as it will take several days before you can harvest your next yield. If time passes and you do not collect your fruits, they will remain on the tree forever. After the tree has provided you with fruits several times, it will disappear, leaving behind a stump that evokes nostalgia. But do not worry, it will reappear.
row.short_description: This is an idle casual game where you can shake the tree pole again when the number on the time board turns green and shows '0' to drop fruits from the tree. When you can shake the pole again, you'll find that several days have passed.

row.name: Arkadia
row.detailed_description: Explore Arkadia. Confront evil beings, uncover their schemes, and fight for justice. Strategize, strengthen your characters, and seize victory. Strategic Gameplay Arkadia is a turn-based strategy simulation game. Control player characters, each with unique personalities, and find the most efficient strategies to win battles within limited action points. Gather resources, gain experience, and upgrade equipment and skills to enhance your characters and expand your strategic options. Diverse Storylines Become the fallen general Cardenio and embark on a journey of revenge. Throughout your journey, you will face many choices. The choices you make will lead to significant changes in your journey. You can form alliances with companions or fight as a noble wolf... There is no right answer. The path you take will define your journey. Customizable Character Growth Create your own strategy through equipment configuration and skill enhancement. Characters can lead battles in new directions based on the equipment they wear and the skills they enhance.
row.short_description: Explore Arkadia. Confront the evil beings, uncover their schemes, and fight for justice. Strategize and strengthen your characters to achieve victory.
row.notes: This game contains content that may not be suitable for all ages or may be inappropriate for use in the workplace: frequent violence or gore, general mature content.

row.name: 苍空的彼端
row.detailed_description: Synopsis In a village known as Cloud Whale Town, a writer named Sen Hai took a train to Cloud Whale Town to recuperate, and met the incredible girl Ling in the town, who claimed that Sen Hai had a book in his hand that could predict the future, and asked Sen Hai to take him home according to the book's guidance. Description of the game 'The Other Side of the Sky' is the first work of the Pygma Society, and the game genre is text adventure, which incorporates neta stalks to add interest, and this story is a single-line plot with a text volume of about 60,000 words. The background image is made from commercially available photo footage. The official number of the game is b, station PYGMA society, qq group 993644086 welcome to play. Development Member Producer & Screenplay: Chenhuo Art: Meow Meow (cover), Shusuke (vertical painting), No. 2 machine (CG maid), Yunyu (CG sleeping), Tatsuhuo (CG beach), Black Tea Rabbit (Q version CG) Music & Director's Direction: Unit 2 Performance: Lonely Falls in Love with the Night Program &UI: Lonely fell in love with the night Voiced by: Yun Sheng s Cooperation: aurora, DeaKoontz, Mian, Ko'an, Lexington, Turman pig Public Material Sources & Acknowledgments UI material: BOOTH fantasy curve Music: DOVA-SYNDROME Sound & Background Image: PIXABAY, Pexels
row.short_description: 'The Other Side of the Sky' is a short text adventure game with an alternate fantasy setting in a single-line ending narrative mode.

row.name: Potato Vs Potato
row.detailed_description: Dive into the delightful world of Potato vs Potato, an engaging and addictive game where every click on a potato can lead to exciting discoveries and endless fun! This isn’t just about clicking—it's about uncovering hidden treasures and building your ultimate team of unique potato heroes. Gameplay Overview: In Potato vs Potato each click on a potato not only adds more potatoes to your collection but also gives you a chance to dig out rare and unique potato heroes after three hours. These heroes come in various forms and unique appearances that make them stand out. Uncover Unique Potato Heroes: Every three hours, you will unearth a Potato Hero. These heroes range from normal to legendary. Collect Them All - Coming Soon : Your goal is to collect all the best potato heroes. Some heroes might boost your clicking power, while others might offer defensive or offensive capabilities for future battles. Upgrade and Enhance - Coming Soon : As you gather more potatoes, use them to upgrade your army, making it stronger and more effective. Enhance their abilities to prepare them for the ultimate challenge. Exciting PvP Area - Coming Soon : Once you've collected your potato heroes, get ready to test your skills in the upcoming PvP area. This feature will allow you to pit your potato team against other terrifying potato teams in thrilling battles. Use the unique abilities and equipment of your potato heroes to devise strategies and outsmart your opponents. Start clicking today, uncover your unique potato heroes, and prepare for the exciting PvP challenges on the horizon. Join our community and be a part of the ultimate potato-growing adventure. Together, let's dig, discover, and dominate!
row.short_description: Potato Vs Potato is a fun and addictive game where you click on potatoes to grow your potato empire! Join us and participate in exciting events, and collaborate with fellow potato enthusiasts. Together, we’ll cultivate the ultimate potato paradise and grow into something truly awesome!

row.name: Alien Weapon Test Grounds
row.detailed_description: Test Alien Weapons and Survive Across Various Arenas! Enter an exclusive test site spanning multiple extradimensional maps, each presenting unique challenges and environments. Equip a wide array of cutting-edge alien weapons and put them through their paces against relentless waves of rogue robots. Test, compare, and master the capabilities of each weapon as you navigate the dynamic landscapes of the test site. Feel the raw power of your arsenal and experience intense, fast-paced combat across every map! Mission Can you survive? The test starts easy, but the difficulty ramps up quickly. Every new wave brings faster, deadlier enemies. Use brief pauses between waves to scavenge for items and gear up for the next onslaught. How long can you last? Score Every enemy you destroy and wave you complete increases your score. You can earn bonus points for headshots, eliminating phantoms, and knocking robots off the map. Master these techniques to maximize your score and dominate the battlefield! But be cautious—using revives will reduce your score. Dynamic Maps Battle in ever-changing environments as the map shifts with each wave. Experience dark, eerie locations and brighter, scenic arenas. Find a map you love? Lock it in with the Portal and continue the fight in your favorite setting! Key Features : Alien Weaponry : Feel the impact of advanced alien weapon as you unleash devastation on your foes. Endless Waves of Enemies : The challenge intensifies with every wave. Dynamic Map Rotation : Enjoy a variety of environments, from dark, atmospheric locations to scenic landscapes. Score System : Every shot counts! Conserve your health to maximize your score. Do you have what it takes to master the ultimate arsenal and conquer the relentless onslaught? Good luck, and may your skills guide you to success!
row.short_description: Alien weapons with unique physics await in this fast-paced FPS. Battle waves of enemies across diverse landscapes, lighting, and weather. Beware the unstable space-time continuum.

row.name: Sort of Justice - Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: You are a man with no particular goals or ambitions. Living through each day like the previous one. Perhaps the only thing that keeps you motivated each day is your co-worker, whom you consider your best friend. However, your life takes a dark turn when she frames you for a crime you didn't commit. After seven years in prison, you are released with the ambition to seek revenge on your backstabber. You enter the world of crime and violence, encountering many different personalities, both friends and foes. Along the way, you slowly learn that not everything is as it seems. Choices... matter Sort of Justice is a semi-kinetic adult visual novel. While there are no choices that can affect the plot, there are choices that can affect relationships between you and the characters. This means some choices might enable/disable dialogues, renders and animations in the future. Action Packed This game is strongly defined by its action elements. Expect constant gunfights, intense foot and car chases, thrilling hand-to-hand combat, and potentially more weapon play in the future. The goal is to effectively utilize the 'visual' aspect of visual novels and create a unique immersive experience for players. Intricate World Setting Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it's not there. Underneath the surface of our society, lies a foundation that may as well uphold the operation of the entire world. You think the world is run by the government? Well, ask yourself this. Who's running the government? Romance For those who love engaging in romantic relationships with fictional characters, this game got you covered. In this game, you will encounter many different love interests with unique personalities and backstories. Uncover their secrets and work to gain their trust. However, if you find the chemistry between you and any one of these love interests lacking, it is your choice whether you want to develop this relationship further. Immersive Experience The primary goal of this game is to immerse the player into the story as much as possible. To do this, I had to create and gather images, music and sound effects that complement each other. Here's a summary of Chapter 1's content: Render Images - 1,088 Animation - 5 Music - 19 Sound Effects - 112 Work in Progress This is the DEMO version of the game! This game is currently still in development. Future chapters will be released one by one, but not on Steam. (Check Discord) There will be no further updates until the whole season is completed Join my Discord (Link in side tab) to learn more about the development of Sort of Justice!
row.short_description: Sort of Justice is an immersive adult visual novel set in the dark side of society. As you plot your revenge against your backstabber, you will encounter many personalities, discover relationships and uncover buried secrets.
row.notes: This game contains mature content that may not be suitable for all audiences. Players should be aware that the game includes depictions of sexual acts, graphic violence, and strong language.

row.name: Idle Saga
row.detailed_description: Game Features 【New & Relaxing Experience】 Idle vertical MMORPG allows you to play the game freely with one-hand operation. Quick leveling up , smart feedback, and easy gameplay grant you total relaxed experience. Experience the pleasure anywhere you want. 【Transform as you like and get glorious customized style】 The customized system can help you to transfer as you like and rebirth when reached the peak. Gain exclusive peak badge, cool master skills and customized style. Switch between thousands of outfit and design your own fashionable style! 【High chance of dropping rate for Boss hunting】 Reaping the whole screen and dropping endless rewards. Hunting bosses in the game world is the main way of getting rare equipment and materials. Original designed gear evolution system can help you to stack gear stats and forge gears with exclusive attributes! 【Fair drop rates】 The drop rate in the game is fair for everyone. The more you challenge, the more you get! In addition, you will be also rewarded with equipment and skins by participating in events and by completing the quests.
row.short_description: Welcome to the world of Idle Saga, a magnificent world of swords and magic! Enjoy diverse gameplay, splendid equipment, and transformations into gods and demons that allow you to dominate all realms. With cool elves and powerful mercenaries by your side to battle ferocious bosses!

row.name: Dine 'n Bash
row.detailed_description: In a world of daunting beasts, brave heroes, and dangerous bandits, someone has to serve up the grub! Become the new owner of The Belligerent Dweller, the most popular tavern stop in the medieval town of Thurgon. Dash around the tavern to pick up and deliver eager customers their orders as fast as possible. You've only got one set of hands, so make sure you stack your dishes efficiently! But be warned; this town isn't known for its hospitality. Your patrons are quick to temper, and quick to violence! Angry orcs will hurl axes, sly rogues will toss daggers, and impatient wizards will channel fiery arcane magics. Its your job to dodge the projectiles they send your way to deliver tasty meals swiftly, racking up a high score! Just like any other restaurant, The Belligerent Dweller has its regulars! Meet Sir Reginald the Knight, Qlunk the Orc, and other fun characters that will be sure to write you a lengthy review each time you serve them. Your job may not be as glorious as others in this fantastical world, but it's harder than it looks! Master the pathways you take through the restaurant, optimize the order in which you pick up and deliver dishes, and hone your axe-dodging skills to become the greatest waiter this magical world has ever seen! Traditional restaurant grab-and-go style gameplay Angry customers that throw projectiles at the waiter Streak multipliers that reward flawless performance Recurring characters that leave customer reviews This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: In a world of daunting beasts, brave heroes, and dangerous bandits, someone has to serve up the grub! Become the new owner of The Belligerent Dweller, the most popular tavern in the town of Thurgon. Dash around delivering orders, stacking items, and dodging projectiles that fly your way!

row.name: Madness Arena
row.detailed_description: Note: Madness Arena is currently still a game under going many changes and development, and many features are still in development, including boss fights, equipment shops, new maps, and various quality-of-life improvements. We invite all players to join and support us in this journey by purchasing the game, playing it, and sharing constructive feedbacks. Welcome to the stealth launch of Madness Arena, an exhilarating peer-to-peer PVPVE experience for up to 16 players (starting with 8 players). The game features a unique blend of anime-inspired art set against semi-realistic environments, enhanced with dynamic manga-style effects. Our primary focus is on delivering a fun and chaotic experience. In the coming months and years, we plan to continuously expand the game with new characters (10+ characters every quarter planned), exciting features, and much more. We invite you to be part of this adventure as we strive to create one of the most mind blowing game ever, built with passion by gamers for gamers. Let's rock the world together! The Backstory Amidst daily stress, a manga artist finds solace in his dreamland, where his characters spring to life from ink and paper. In this vibrant realm, his creations reflect his inner struggles and aspirations. Their epic battles become a canvas for confronting his fears and frustrations, transforming his dreams into a sanctuary of creativity and catharsis. Illustrative, Anime-Styled Characters and VFX Unique, anime-inspired player characters and special effects that visually captivate and engage players. Realistic and Anime-Blended Environments Familiar, real-world environments combined with anime aesthetics, creating an immersive and visually stunning play area. Boss Raids and Events Special raids and in-game events that enhance skills and increase damage, providing new challenges and excitement during battles. Expanded Player Capacity (Up to 16 Players): Increased player slots to support up to 16 participants, allowing for more intense and competitive gameplay experiences. Character Customization Diverse outfit options for characters, enabling extensive customization and providing monetization opportunities through in-game purchases. Robust and Secure Gameplay: Advanced security measures to ensure fair play and prevent cheating, maintaining a balanced and enjoyable gaming environment. PlayFab Multiplayer System Feature: Integration of PlayFab for competitive ranking, matchmaking, and multiplayer system enhancements, ensuring a smooth and competitive online experience. In-House Motion Capture Beautifully crafted motion captures for creating unique movesets and animations, distinguishing our game from competitors who rely on off-the-shelf solutions.
row.short_description: Enter the ultimate battleground, where chaos reigns and survival is everything. Every decision could be your last—will you rise to the challenge or descend into madness? Master powerful abilities, crush your enemies, and prove your worth in Madness Arena.

row.name: Work Inc.
row.detailed_description: I don't wanna see you slacking again! Don't make me take this further... Work Inc.: The shoddy (and somewhat illegally run) company that you've wasted years of your life at to earn a sliver of a paycheck. Why were you here again? What did Work Inc. offer you? Why not quit? The Boss had you sharpen his Big Ol' Pencil again, giving you a jab in the back before he 'asked.' You're so over it... About The Game Work Inc. is a goofy wave shooter where you play as a disgruntled employee, fighting their way through the whole of Work Inc., which is also the company you work (worked?). Armed with four silly weapons, test your mettle against increasingly crowded waves of three different enemy types! Whatever you do... Don't get fired! As the fight goes on, you can spend your hard-looted cash (that you definitely did  not  steal from your co-workers' payslips) to unlock one of many hand-crafted areas in the maze-like Office, or to buy one of three weapons at random from the Printer! Be warned, though, as all your ranged weapons have limited ammunition!  If you run out of stationary and/or dirt to fling at your foes, or you're close to defeat, the Union recently got some vending machines installed in the office: find them and spend your money on either more health, or purchase ammunition one magazine at a time! As the game progresses, enemies will spawn more frequently and in greater numbers, with three different classes being unlocked as the game goes on. Enemies don't get stronger, and nor do your weapons, but they can quickly become overwhelming if you don't deal with them! The Enemies Worka The Worka (said like Worker) is the basic enemy you fight. Easily beaten in a few pencil hits or a body-slam, you can take these down in mere seconds. They'll move towards you at a reasonable speed before trying to hit you with their keyboards! You can take quite a few hits, but don't let the gang up on you, because you'll soon be feeling keyed up! Shoota The Shoota is the second enemy, this one armed with a stapler similar to the one you can get. The weapons aren't  just for you, y'know. They'll keep their distance, trying to pick you off from slightly further, but they won't move while they've got a lock on you, their aim isn't the best. They're fragile, too! You can easily take them down with a couple well-placed shots. Big Guy The Big Guy is... Well, he's a pretty big guy. You'll know him and his silly yellow top when you see him. Similar to Worka, Big Guy will come after you, albeit a little slower than Worka. Don't be fooled, though, a few hits from Big Guy and you'll be out on the streets! These guys have a Ballinium-plated keyboard that does HUGE damage, and those big bellies can absorb more hits. The Weapons In Work Inc., there are four weapons, all hand-crafted and animated! Big Ol' Pencil The Big Ol' Pencil is exactly that: its a Big. Yellow. Pencil. The BOP is a melee weapon with decent range and damage that combos well with the Dash. It can take down the Worka in three hits! Staple-o-Matic This is the most well-rounded ranged weapon of the three in Work Inc. - Semi-automatic, 16 staples in a mag, and good damage at most ranges, this one is a valuable addition to your arsenal. It's pretty accurate too. Sharpenator The Sharpenator is a rapid-fire electric sharpener with booming SFX and funky particles too! Let 30 high-speed pencils loose and watch it shred your opponents! Its slightly weaker than the Staple-o-Matic, though it makes up for it with high fire rate. SuperSuck The SuperSuck is a faulty vacuum cleaner that fires big globs of muck and dirt at your opponents, exploding in a big brown stinky boom and dealing damage to nearby enemies. With a long charge-time and cooldown, and only five shots per magazine, this vacuum compensates by taking down all enemies in one shot! Other Bits Work Inc. was developed by a team of four university students over a period of eight weeks (initially, at least), who have now graduated from DMU's BSc Games Production with flying colours. Dylan: Gameplay Programmer, Character Designer, 'Sound Guy' Lunar-Skie: Character Programmer, Animator, 'Heavy Weapons Girl' Dimitrios: Prop Artist, UI Artist, 'Texture Wizard' Kacper: Game Designer, Level Designer, 'Guy who Shrinks the Map' Special Thanks to Salim Hasshu! This entire project could not have been possible without the fantastic opportunity Additional Assets Used: Github: starikcetin/ Eflatun.SceneReference - Provides us with easy-to-use scene referencing. Thanks, gamer! simonoliver/ InputSystemActionPrompts - Helps us change our input prompts based on the player's current input device! Music by XtremeFreddy on Pixabay
row.short_description: Brace yourselves for Corporate Calamity in Work Inc, a First Person Arena Shooter with a conglomerate twist! Arm yourself with staplers and sharpeners to bash and shoot your way through the hordes of employees like your life (and your job) depend on it.
row.reviews: “I got fired from Work Inc and they never paid me my serverance!” Ex-employee #2884 “I got hired at Work Inc and they paid me a welcome bonus!” Employee #2884b

row.name: GUNPYRE
row.detailed_description: An AKIMBO TWIN STICK SHOOTER Use a pair of Vampyric Guns -the Gunpyres indeed- to slay hordes of dangerous creatures created by the infamous Crypt Alchemist: each monster is packed with Blood with unique colors and abilities that you can absorb with your Gunpyres. One Gunpyre for each hand, no one is safe A never-ending horde of enemies to slay and then some more Challenge The Crypt Alchemist and his Elite Experiments to escape the Dungeon DIFFERENT BLOODS = DIFFERENT PROJECTILES Upon brutally executing an enemy with a finisher you can receive one of four different Blood Types. Every Type generates a unique Bullet that will behave differently when shot based on its Color and its unlocked upgrades. Use them wisely according to the situation in order to survive. Human, Freeze, Thunder and Iron Bloods are your weapons of choice Lots of upgrades - Blood Type specific - that change shooting features at your favor Unlock the rare Perfect Barrels, an Ultimate Upgrade for each Blood Type EVERY BULLET COUNTS Your Gunpyres can only shoot Blood Projectiles: hopefully it will be the Enemy’s Blood. Miss too many shots and you will have to sacrifice your own Blood to reload the Gunpyres, by stabbing yourself. 6 Bullets per Gunpyre, choose hastily your next victim to absorb their Blood to Enemies are weak to their own Blood Type: Shoot the right color to the right enemy to maximize the damage ROGUE-LIKE PROGRESSION Explore the insidious layout of the Crypt Dungeon: its structure will change in every new attempt, so be careful not to spoil your occasion. You have 10 Rune Keys, plan your route and gain powerful upgrades along the way (or keep the keys and let the Crypt Alchemist absorb them for an extra challenge!) Access to the Dungeon Rooms is limited by the Rune Keys you possess Explore the Dungeon for secret challenges and unexpected character benefits Obtain Gold from Enemies to obtain unique upgrades from the Shop ◉ Gunpyre started as an academic project by AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi aimed at adding a production experience to the teaching carried out in the various courses, from the creation of the game concept to commercial publishing. The objective of this initiative is to give students the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from other courses in the development of a video game project in which everyone can put the skills acquired during the lessons to the test and at the same time perfect their soft skills. ◉
row.short_description: Hold your Gunpyres akimbo in this fast-paced twin-stick shooter, set in the Crypt Alchemist’s semi-procedural dungeon. Remember, Vampyres are your guns and blood types are your bullets, so be assured to brutally steal them from your enemies in order to collect upgrades and take down your target.
row.notes: The game features depictions of blood and fantasy violence.

row.name: Bat Tap
row.detailed_description: Bat Tap is a game in which you click on the bat and get points for each click. Accumulated points allow you to get a random bat in your inventory. However, the points themselves cannot be spent on anything else. (This is more than a game..)
row.short_description: Bat Tap is a game in which you click on the bat and get points for each click. Accumulated points allow you to get a random bat in your inventory. However, the points themselves cannot be spent on anything else. You can get full information on our discord server.

row.name: Peach Clicker
row.detailed_description: You've clicked on so many bananas, but have you clicked on peaches ? 🤔 Get a random peach every 3 hours and grow your collection! 😍 Drop pool chances*: 50% Normal 32% Common 15% Rare 2% Ultra Rare 1% Legendary * Subject to change ◻️ Features: - Peaches 🍑 - More peaches 😊 - Variety of peaches 🔥 - Controller support 🎮 - Leveling system for special skins 😲 - Mini Peaches to help you gather Big Peaches! 🤯 - Daily tree watering to get you MORE Peaches! 🌳
row.short_description: You've clicked on so many bananas, but have you clicked on peaches? 🤔 In Peach Clicker you smack a Peach to get even more Peaches! 😍 Every 3 hours, you get a new peach! 🍑 Come smack some peaches with us!

row.name: Muhaboy
row.detailed_description: After the great invasion, the muha-s mutated and are gearing up for war again! Buzzopolis is the first line of defense. We can't let the city fall to the enemy! Save Buzzopolis, and then the whole world! Brave hero, MUHABOY! Chase down muha-s and cleanse the city of mutants while dealing with limited resources, tricky enemies, and challenging battle scenarios In the game, you’ll encounter various types of muha-s. Each type has its own personality, habits, reaction speed, and level of cowardice. And they complement each other beautifully. Find the best strategy for any combination of enemies, because your muha swatters have limited durability. Use muha swatters with different effects The game offers several types of muha swatters, each with its own unique effects. They aren’t tied to specific types of muha-s, giving every player a chance to get creative. Find your favorite muha swatter, combine them, or develop a strategy that lets you make the most of your resources in any combat situation. Earn coins and redistribute your resources Your muha swatters have limited durability. But you can buy and sell durability, exchanging actual hits for coins. There’s no penalty for buying and selling, so even if you purchase durability or a muha swatter, you can sell them later without losing a single coin. This opens up extra opportunities for experimentation. Craft your own strategy, be quick, do whatever it takes—just save Buzzopolis!
row.short_description: Step into the shoes of Muhaboy! Dash and smash muha-s in this hardcore beat 'em up, saving humanity from the looming Second Muha War! Battle it out with limited resources and adapt to the ever-changing chaos. Buzzopolis is waiting for its hero—time to show those muha-s who’s boss!

row.name: Landon's Puzzle ParTAY
row.detailed_description: The C.I. Puppet Friends™ star in their first ever full video game: Landon's Puzzle ParTAY™! 'Hey everyone, It's me Landon! I'm inviting you to my first ever Puzzle ParTAY! ( not  a 'party') I just know you'll have lots of tons of fun, so come on down! (chips and dip not  included)' -Landon Landon's Puzzle ParTAY is a fast-paced, arcade-style, time-attack, puzzle game! This game features various puzzle types with a C.I. Puppet Friends twist! - Put together classic puzzles with Landon! - Help Josie cross different terrains! - Guide Chef Paisano through the grocery store to find all of the ingredients! - Help (paper doll) Landon find the right pose! - Find hidden secrets!  All while being cheered on by your favorite Puppet Friends! In this game, you'll race against the clock to complete all sorts of different puzzles!  Including: Jigsaw puzzles Mazes Slide puzzles Problem solving Crosswords Patterns Platforming challenges as bonus rounds And more to come! Each puzzle gets more difficult as you complete them. After your first puzzle, each round will have you race through with a completely different pattern. Each puzzle you solve adds 1 point  to your score! How many puzzles can you solve before running out of time? Compete with others in an online leaderboard to see how many puzzles you can solve!  - Unlock special badges with each rank, as you race for the high score! - Create your own profile, with your favorite character as an avatar! (remember, chips and dip are not included, stop asking, Elvin)
row.short_description: Landon's Puzzle ParTAY™ is a game where you complete puzzles as fast as you can without running out of time! Enjoy all of the fun and wacky minigames with a C.I. Puppet Friends™ flair! Create your own profile and compete for the high score!

row.name: Space Valkyries
row.detailed_description: Year 2979, the cosmic entity 'IT' threatens to destroy Earth. Take command of the Valkyria Zenith Serenity and use all your skills to face this threat alongside your beautiful operators. Save the world! The objective of the game is quite simple: protect Earth from the cosmic entity known as 'It'. This game is compatible with touchscreen, and it is recommended to play with a keyboard and mouse. Different ways to play On board the Valkyria, you'll find multiple operators, each with a different playing style. Upgrade your ship The Valquiria Zenith Serenity features an onboard shop that allows you to upgrade the statistics of all your operators. Test your luck The casino module includes a small roulette wheel that allows you to exchange tickets obtained for large amounts of money. (This is not a microtransaction) Accelerate the growth of your relationship with the operators You can buy various pastries for your operators and discover a little more about them.
row.short_description: Year 2979, the cosmic entity 'IT' threatens to destroy Earth. Take command of the Valkyria Zenith Serenity and use all your skills to face this threat alongside your beautiful operators.

row.name: Fear of the Light
row.detailed_description: Fear of the Light is a stealth-based survival horror game where light is scarier than darkness and where surveying monsters keep you on edge. You’re the lone survivor on a spaceship infested by moths and other dangerous creatures. Explore the ship, override quarantine lockdowns, and find a way to escape. Use your radar and other tools to avoid enemies, keep out of the light, sneak around dangers, and find your way forward. But be careful, monsters are lurking around, searching for you, and are aware of your every mistake! Key features 20-45 min of playtime Horror twist where light is more dangerous than darkness Intelligent monsters Handheld radar, heat visor, and EMP Diegetic UI tools and terminals Background The first version of this game was made in seven weeks with a core team of ten members for a course at Futuregames Stockholm and Karlstad. The team continued working on the game afterward, eventually leading to a nomination for Best Design at the Swedish Game Awards and the Steam release. The game is made in Unreal Engine 5 and almost all the assets aside were created from scratch by the team.
row.short_description: A survival horror game where light is scarier than darkness. Use your radar and other tools to stay out of the light, sneak around dangers, explore the quarantined ship, and find a way to escape. But be careful, monsters are hunting you and are aware of your every mistake!
row.notes: This game contains mature themes such as death, violence, and demise, as well as a dark and scary atmosphere. Death and violence are not depicted, only implied through the environment and text logs. There may be blood splatter in the environment.

row.name: Tarisland
row.detailed_description: Tarisland, a new MMORPG, brings back the fun of challenging dungeons and experiencing immersive adventures in a classic fantasy art style. Choose from 9 classes and 18 specializations to create your build. Team up globally to conquer epic bosses! Explore the Vast World Dive into the vast realm of Tarisland, uncover hidden mysteries, and embark on your unique adventure. Class & Talent System Tarisland offers 9 unique classes, each with 2 specializations for you to choose from. Create Your Own Build Each class features a flexible and extensive talent tree, easily customizable for different playstyles. Challenge Various Dungeons & Raids Breathe new life into the classic raid and dungeon system, team up to take down epic bosses! Enjoy the Game on Steam & Mobile Available on both Steam and mobile with data-sharing enabled. Challenge dungeons and raids anytime, anywhere. Trade in the Auction House Earn gold coins by trading in the Auction House! Collecting, mining, crafting, and engaging in other professions are other ways to earn rewards!

row.name: Boned

Expect to see this DLC in the Spring of 2025 for more ways to Bone! About the Game Boned is a silly, fast-paced multiplayer party game, inspired by arcade beloved Killer Queen and other multi-player frenzies! Take the role of a canine astronaut and launch into space. Drill through planets, slingshot around gravitational fields, and bring your team to victory. Collect toys by drilling into the planet cores, then fire it off to eliminate enemies, or take it back to home base to score for your team. Make sure to keep an eye out for “The Bone”, too! row.name: Lu[Idle]
row.detailed_description: Disclaimer: Lu[Idle] does not have a large amount of content and there is a lot of waiting, hence the 'idle' part of the name. I put Lu[Idle] on steam as a way to showcase my creation. There are planned updates but no plan on when they will be worked on, and If you have any criticism or feedback, you are welcome to share it with me on my discord server. In Lu[Idle] you play as a game developer making a Lua game but instead of coding you are clicking. Make your game huge by clicking and getting Bytes which is the amount of storage your game takes up and as we all know more Gigabytes = better game. Type commands into the console to make code that brings your games storage up automatically, upgrade your mouse to gain more bytes per click and drink some coffee for a boost and purchase a server to make your game even bigger. Get immersed and become a Lua game developer today in Lu[Idle]. This game is very early access and is lacking a lot of features that I intend to add and the price will most likely increase as updates come. Key Features Upgradable Code Snippets to Increase your Bytes per Second Console to Input various Commands found in the Commands Folder Tab Upgrades Tab to Increase your Games Size even more Release your game and gain sales to make your future games better (prestige)

row.name: 萍城异闻录
row.detailed_description: PingCity, officially tested on PC PingCity, officially tested on PC, join the player group and give us feedback At present, the official player group has been opened, and first-hand information will be updated synchronously in the group. Internal testing and other welfare activities will be held, and there is also a chance to participate in the competition and win physical rewards such as JD cards. Welcome to join the discussion together, young heroes! QQ1：1015905671     QQ2：342072404      Discord：awTwCJB About the Game Pingcheng Chronicles: Tales of the Unusual Anime-style graphics meet fast-paced, high-octane combat—redefining the ARPG competitive experience! Unleash smooth combo chains at your fingertips, with seamless links between normal attacks and skills. Harness fire, water, thunder, and other elemental fusion mechanics to dish out devastating full-screen damage—maximizing that unbeatable combat thrill! No evacuation needed—keep hunting other players and plundering massive resources for doubled competitive excitement! Per-Match Support Synergies : Collect gold to unlock support lineups. Trigger exclusive bonds between characters to stack powerful buffs—your strategic combinations determine the battle’s outcome! Freeform Soul Card System : Gather three types of soul cards (Damage, Support, Utility) in-game. With hundreds of combinations, craft your unique combat build for a fresh experience every match! Free Economy: Stress-Free Farming & Monetization Built-in open marketplace: Freely price and trade dungeon drops, plundered loot, and more—easily monetize your grind! No binding restrictions: Rare items go live and circulate instantly. Even casual players can achieve resource freedom through strategy and grit! Game Features 【Support for War】 In the game, you can recruit auxiliary characters at any time to form a match with your main battle character and trigger super powerful combination skills. 【 Bonds 】 Heroes have a binding effect on each other, forming a suitable lineup and triggering the binding effect, making battles more profound and nurturing. 【Soul Cards】 Master soul cards to trigger fusion damage—they are the key to victory whether you fight, defend, advance or retreat! Controls: Right-click to bring up the wheel menu, left-click to activate. Experience the thrilling rush of intense combat! 【Search · Battle · Upload】 Search chests, jars and other containers to seize high-value supplies! Take all your supplies to the designated upload point, hold your ground until the upload is complete, and your loot will be instantly stored in your warehouse! 【Hide and Seek】 The hide and seek system has been added, allowing you to take on various forms within the scene to evade the pursuit of other players, plot against them, or provide a safe environment for yourself to search for battle heroes. 【Elemental Reaction】 The game has 8 types of elemental damage, and all 7 elements except physics can react with each other. Different elemental reactions have different negative effects on the target, which also affects your lineup selection. 【The Great Demon King】 In the game, you can defeat the dragon beasts in the scene to obtain a dragon soul. The dragon soul will transform you into a great demon king, increasing your damage but also causing you to suffer higher damage. At this point, you will become the most prominent one on the field. 【Evasion, blocking, floating pursuit, lightness skill】 Combat involves diverse ways of behavior, use them flexibly, and become a master of combat. 【Rich PVE content】 A large amount of PVE content has been completed and will be presented to everyone in the future.

row.name: Move Out Manor
row.detailed_description: 'Move Out Manor' is an intense block-pushing game set in a cursed mansion. Rid the manor of the owner's occult items and close the portal to the underworld. Aleister recently started doing gig jobs around town. After all the tasks he'd managed to accomplish, helping someone move out seemed like a piece of cake. However, Aleister would soon discover that while gig work is rough...gig work in the netherworld is a nightmare! Push and Pack Pack up the cursed items in the house into moving boxes by pushing them onto paranormal packing devices. Ship out the cursed boxes by pushing them onto the conveyor belt that the moving company conveniently set up throughout the house beforehand. Cursed items and boxes glow with a mysterious green flame. Watch Out Ghosts and ghouls are in every room to stop you. Make sure to avoid them or you may be trapped... forever . Story The previous occupant of the big house on the hill known as The Manor had some strange hobbies. Since he stopped paying his mortgage and his whereabouts are unknown, the bank repossessed the house. Nigel’s Moving Services was assigned the task. Since it was a big job, Nigel decided to put out some ads for a few more hands. Clad in blue coveralls, Aleister walked through the front door of The Manor. After packing a few items, he noticed something peculiar. He was able to make one comment before being sucked up: “What’s this strange swirling Vor-TEXXXX?!?” Will Aleister make it out of The Manor in time? Only if he packs up and pushes out all the cursed items. Good thing speedrunning was in the job description!
row.short_description: Gig work is rough...but gig work in the netherworld is a nightmare! 'Move Out Manor' is an intense block-pushing game set in a cursed mansion. Rid the manor of the owner's occult items and close the portal to the underworld.

row.name: Compass of Destiny: Istanbul Prologue
row.detailed_description: FULL GAME About the Game Compass of Destiny: Istanbul Prologue is a free version of Compass of Destiny: Istanbul. Experience the core gameplay and get a taste of the experience that awaits in the full game. PROLOGUE FEATURES: Free access to the prologue and galley episodes. Short gameplay introducing the game and universe before Istanbul. It is the 17th century and the Ottoman Empire is at the height of its power, forming a transcontinental realm stretching across Europe, Asia, and Africa. However, it is locked in a deadly struggle with Venice, for resources and power, centered around the richest of its provinces, create. You are an impoverished patrician from Venice, exiled in Istanbul. The accidental discovery of a mysterious compass sets you on a course for vengeance against the Ottoman commander responsible for the death of your family and your disgrace. Vendetta Across Worlds The Compass is your only chance at finding justice. By day, explore the meticulously recreated Istanbul at its richest and most beautiful, running into characters ripped straight from the pages of history. Meet Ahmed Dede, astronomer, poet, and historian, who played an unlikely role in your hero's past, and a vital ally of Sultan Mehmed IV, whose rule saw the Empire reach its greatest territorial extent. By night, descend into Fitrat, the realm of dreams where everything is possible. Draw and redraw the course of your destiny, peer into the lives of others, from petty merchants to mighty kings. But beware, the compass can only take you so far. Beyond that, you'll need strength of arms, wits, and a keen eye for secrets. Overcome, Grow, Conquer Every time you descend into Fitrat, you have the opportunity to grow stronger and push closer to the truth. Fight enemies trying to keep you from changing fate, using a light RPG system featuring skills, weapons, and armor to build your disgraced patrician the way you like. But this realm is more than just violence: You'll need to explore in depth, tackle challenging puzzles and show off your agility in platforming sections, if you want to learn the complete truth. The Compass will be your irreplaceable aid. A Blend of Reality and Fantasy Compass of Destiny was created using meticulous research, to give you an authentic glimpse into the Ottoman Empire at its peak, challenged for supremacy by the Serene Republic of Venice. The brutal Cretan War defined the balance of power in the Mediterraneans for centuries to come, making it the perfect moment in history to combine with exploring fantasy concepts and the personal struggles of people caught in the middle of a titanic struggle between superpowers.
row.short_description: In Compass of Destiny: Istanbul Prologue, action and adventure are at the core of the story of a prince trying to prevent the Ottomans from capturing a castle in Venice.

row.name: Grandpa: Bread Adventure

But grandpa also has a couple of aces up his sleeve: • Thanks to the special pills that he takes, obstacles in grandpa's path disappear and then reappear. • Having collected enough coins, grandpa will be able to buy himself an energy drink and super boots, which will increase his endurance, and even improve his physical characteristics! • Vending machines are located here and there on the streets, where you can buy useful things. • Advertising posters with memes to boost morale • Grandpa appreciates street benches and can have a good rest on them Yes, in our runner you can stop in the middle of the run to catch your breath, sit on a bench and even ride a few stops on the bus. Help Grandpa uncover the secrets of his past and come face to face with his greatest fear!

row.name: Hide Time
row.detailed_description: Hide Time is a story-driven horror game filled with huge variety of puzzles where you play as an new employee of Passion Oasis. Explore that huge complex, do your tasks and uncover mysteries of your past. Welcome to Passion Oasis, a place where you can express yourself and have lots and lots of fun. Do everything to make sure the location is in perfect state and most importantly have fun! You play as John Evans - a brand new employee at Passion Oasis. Stay in touch with your manager - Mark Smith via walkie-talkie as he guides you towards your next objective. Uncover the past of the DJ Cat's brand as well as your own. This place can offer you tasty food and drinks in places such as Cozy Corner Coffee and Sweet Lounge. Meet the all time favorite mascot - DJ Cat and enjoy your time in locations such as Party Rooms. row.name: Agents of SPLEEF
row.detailed_description: Join the ranks of the best SPLEEF agents on flat earth, where bombs are your weapons, and your friend is your nemesis. In this chaotic third-person multiplayer mayhem, you'll take on the role of a fearless agent, armed with nothing but your trusty bomb launcher and an insatiable appetite for mayhem. Forget about traditional shooting combat; here you'll be knocking out your foes directly or creating treacherous holes to send them (or, ahem, you) plummeting into the abyss. But beware! Your opponents are equally armed and equally devious. One wrong move, and you might find yourself plunging into the depths, cursing the day you ever enlisted. It's a delicate dance of destruction, where strategy and reflexes reign supreme. Prepare for intense multiplayer matches where friendships will be tested, alliances betrayed, and the only rule is to spleef or be spleefed. Join the ranks of the SPLEEF elite, and prove your worth in the ultimate battle of bombs and brutality! The rules are simple: Shoot a bomb directly at your opponents for an instant kill, or blow a hole in the floor and knock them in with the bomb's impact. The player that dies the least number of times wins the round. There are four players per round (including bots). For single-player mode : Host a private server so no one can join your game. For multi-player mode : Host a public server so your friends can find your game. Please keep in mind that your friends may experience a slight lag.

row.name: 天月麻雀 (Amatsuki Mahjong)
row.detailed_description: Amatsuki Mahjong Features Amatsuki Mahjong is a free online Mahjong game featuring Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japanese (Riichi), and Sichuan Mahjong, brought to life with a vibrant anime style and popular voice actors from Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Japan. 4-Style Mahjong in One with Real-Time Players Enjoy real-time, cross-platform multiplayer matches featuring four distinct Mahjong styles: Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japanese (Riichi), and Sichuan, allowing you to play anytime, anywhere. In addition to challenging ranked matches, the game features casual rooms, friend matches, and more modes, providing mahjong enthusiasts with a rich variety of gameplay options. Popular Voice Actors from Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Japan Every character comes with localized voiceovers in Mandarin, Cantonese, and Japanese, letting you fully immerse yourself in every single match! Featuring an all-star voice cast including Yūki Kana(優木かな), Ogura Yui(小倉唯), Hikasa Yoko(日笠陽子), Uchida Maaya(内田真礼), Kito Akari(鬼頭明里), Tsumugi Risa(紡木吏佐), Amasaki Kohei(天﨑滉平), Maeda Seiji(前田誠二), and more... they are all ready to meet you! Each character comes with an eye-catching winning animation, stunning animated live portraits, and quirky-themed stickers. With voiceovers in Japanese, Cantonese, and Mandarin by popular voice actors, immersing players in this vibrant mahjong world. Build relationships with your favourite characters to unlock exclusive costumes and more special voice lines! Customize Your Mahjong Experience Mix and match various accessories and winning effects to personalize your matches, making each win feel like a spectacular achievement. Amatsuki Mahjong also introduces themed match scenes, truly bringing the experience to life on the mahjong table for an unprecedented immersive experience! Easy Learning with Comprehensive Tutorials New to any of the four styles of mahjong? No worries! The game features a user-friendly tutorial assistant that guides you through the rules, winning combinations, and scoring in four-style mahjong. With this support, you’ll go from novice to mahjong master in no time. Plus, automated shuffling, drawing and cutting systems ensure smooth gameplay, enhancing your gaming experience. Participate in Official Tournaments to Connect and Improve Join our regular online and offline mahjong tournaments, where players can hone their skills and connect through competition. Participation is free, with plenty of exclusive rewards available, giving you the chance to compete for the top honor of 'Celestial Moonlight'. Stay tuned on the latest events by following the Amatsuki Mahjong community: ※ This game is intended for players aged 18 and above. ※ The game does not offer real-money gambling. All in-game currency, items, and characters are virtual assets and cannot be exchanged for cash or any form of tangible rewards.
row.short_description: Amatsuki Mahjong is a ACG style mahjong game that offers real-time multiplayer online matches. It features four styles of mahjong: Japanese, Sichuan, Taiwanese, and Hong Kong Mahjong. Enjoy a variety of play styles tailored to your preferences.

row.name: Black Myth: Wukong Benchmark Tool
row.detailed_description: Confront Destiny About the Software This tool is separate from the 'Black Myth: Wukong' game itself and is non-playable. The 'Black Myth: Wukong Benchmark Tool' is a PC benchmark application specifically developed for 'Black Myth: Wukong'. It evaluates your hardware performance and system compatibility through the real-time rendering of an in-game sequence. You can customize benchmark settings to preview game visuals and performance under different graphics options. ※ Due to the complexity and variability of gaming scenarios, the benchmark results may not fully represent the actual gaming experience and final performance.
row.short_description: The 'Black Myth: Wukong Benchmark Tool' is a PC benchmark application specifically developed for 'Black Myth: Wukong'. It evaluates your hardware performance and system compatibility through the real-time rendering of an in-game sequence.

row.name: One Shot Arena
row.detailed_description: One Shot Arena is a fast-paced multiplayer arena where precision and agility are the keys to victory. Every hero can be taken down with a single hit, making each move critical. However, the game isn't just about avoiding danger; it's about mastering a wide range of abilities to dodge, deceive, and outsmart your opponents. Engage in intense battles where every move counts, and only the most skilled players will emerge as winners. Key Features • Diverse Abilities Each hero has unique abilities and their own learning curve. Master your favorite heroes to gain an advantage on the battlefield. Learn the strenghts and weaknesses of each hero to leverage your chances. • Multiplayer Fights Battle against friends and foes in dynamic arenas. Available in 1v1, 2v2 and Free For All formats. You can play each mode in ranked or unranked. • Skill-Based Gameplay Collect victories and improve your rating to climb the leaderboards. • Instant Eliminations Every hit counts. Reflexes and strategic thinking are crucial to defeat your enemies and win rounds. Dive into One Shot Arena and experience the thrill of high-speed combat where every move matters. Can you outlast and outplay your rivals? The arena awaits your legend to be written.
row.short_description: One Shot Arena is a multiplayer game of precision and perfect timing, where quick reflexes and sharp strategy make all the difference. Are you ready to outsmart and outplay your rivals?

row.name: Island Clicker
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Island Clicker – where every click opens the door to an unexplored world! 🌴 Explore the Island: Chop down your first tree, crack open your first stone, and step by step, delve deeper into the mysteries of this enigmatic island. The further you venture, the more resources you find, and with each upgraded tool, you become even stronger! 🐒 Tame Loyal Companions: Don’t face this adventure alone! Find and tame a monkey to work tirelessly by your side, a wolf ready to tear through your enemies, or a cat that brings you the kind of luck you’ve only dreamed of. 🏠 What Do the Shadows Hide?: The island is filled with secrets – from a strange broken totem by the lake to a mysterious bunker hidden among the trees. What are these places, and how can you access them? What secrets do they hold? Perhaps the answers lie behind doors that are still locked. Can you unravel all the mysteries that this land holds? ⚔️ Test Your Strength: Eventually, your journey will lead you to the island's darkest secret... What horror awaits in the Acidic World? Only those prepared for the final challenge will face the true inhabitants of this grim realm head-on. Island Clicker isn’t just a game – it’s a real adventure, packed with mysteries and astonishing discoveries. Are you ready for the journey? Start clicking and discover what this mysterious island hides.
row.short_description: Island Clicker: Embark on a thrilling adventure! Collect resources, upgrade tools, and tame loyal companions. Uncover hidden secrets, explore mysterious bunkers, and battle fierce enemies. Every click reveals new challenges. Are you ready to discover what this island hides?

row.name: Velvet 89
row.detailed_description: What do people making a stand against the unjust regime dream of? What do they fear? To find out, you’ll need a sharp eye. The color of clothes, hairstyle or the surroundings will be your clues in our historical hidden-object game. Velvet 89 takes you on a trip across the revolting country – from cautious ecology-themed protests to huge crowds. Investigate the moments before police brutally attacked a peaceful demonstration and unveil the stories of those who decided to speak up. Velvet 89 was developed with experts from the renowned Czech project Stories of Injustice. Every piece of the story in the game is based on actual testimonies. It shows how the revolution gained momentum, from the border regions onto the squares of Prague and further. History comes alive in a visual style reminiscent of paper cut-outs, used videotapes or faded photo albums. The game combines handcrafted atmosphere with real historical footage. takes place in five cities and at six protests that made the Velvet Revolution happen features a hidden-object gameplay with more than 40 stories uses stylized visuals that combine handcrafted graphics and actual historical footage was made with experts and is based on real testimonies The game was developed in cooperation with educational programme One World in Schools to commemorate the 35th anniversary of the Velvet Revolution. It was created as a part of the Stories of Injustice project, which aims to introduce our country’s modern history to young people.
row.short_description: How did the communist regime in Czechoslovakia fall? This hidden-object game tells the story of ordinary people taking part in the peaceful demonstrations that changed the course of history. Big crowds hide those, who want to tell you why they took to the streets.
row.notes: The game references and depicts violent acts by the communist regime of Czechoslovakia via archival footage.

row.name: SpellBit
row.detailed_description: SpellBit is a fast-paced mini battle royale game designed for 12 players per match. It draws major inspiration from games like Fortnite and Spellbreak, offering a smaller scale experience with even more excitement! Unleash devastating spells and manipulate the very fabric of reality to outwit and overpower your opponents. Engage in fast-paced , strategic combat, combining precise spellcasting with cunning tactics to emerge victorious. Engage in intense fights against other mages! Master your flying skills! Customize your mage, choosing from a diverse range of spell schools and unlocking unique characters . Find epic loot to help you win battles!
row.short_description: Prepare to immerse yourself in a dynamic and spellbinding world of magical mayhem. As a powerful mage, you'll engage in intense battles against other skilled sorcerers, wielding an arsenal of enchantments and elemental forces.

row.name: Lost Gorga
row.detailed_description: Lost Gorga is a captivating puzzle adventure where players collect translation tokens to understand hints that help you progress. Immerse yourself in a world of exploration and brain-teasing challenges as you uncover the mysteries of Lost Gorga. Content 3 character types that speak their own style of gibberish to the player 3 translation tokens that each interpret a different type of gibberish 10 scenes across 3 areas each with a unique navigation puzzle Credits Fantasy 16x16 Pixel Art Asset Pack by Appel on Itch Main Theme - Music By: Kevin MacLeod Song Name: Itty Bitty 8 Bit Dark Forest Theme - Music By: Eric Skiff Song Name: Undercloaked Credits Theme - Music By: Kubbi Song Name: Digestive Biscuit '8-Bit Sound Effects Library' by LittleRobotSoundFactory
row.short_description: Lost Gorga is a captivating puzzle adventure where players collect translation tokens to understand hints that help you progress. Immerse yourself in a world of exploration and brain-teasing challenges as you uncover the mysteries of Lost Gorga.

row.name: Sivi's Factory
row.detailed_description: Sivi's Factory is a dark first-person horror game where you play as Felix, desperately searching for his brother in a massive scientific factory. From the very first steps, you're surrounded by a mysterious atmosphere, with dangers lurking around every corner. The factory is a labyrinth of various workshops, hidden passages, and unknown rooms, where every new discovery brings new threats. You'll need to solve puzzles, explore dark rooms, and fight off a terrifying enemy that chases you throughout the factory. One of the unique mechanics in the game is a watch with a cartridge that can be printed using a 3D printer to unlock various functions to progress through levels. Printers will also help create key items, such as access cards, which will open new locations and allow you to delve deeper into the depths of the factory. You'll encounter four unique locations, each filled with its own secrets and traps. Dive deeper into the complex, solve engaging puzzles, and uncover the truth about what happened at the factory, where your brother is... and what secrets hide in the shadows. Get ready for a tense atmosphere, challenging puzzles, and dangerous battles in Sivi's Factory.
row.short_description: Sivi's Factory is a single player first-person horror game in which you play as Felix. You are looking for your brother on the scientific factory. Solve puzzles on the locations, explore new rooms, fight your enemy and go deeper into factory.

row.name: Harder
row.detailed_description: Your GOD has forsaken you, raining the fury of the heaven realm upon your very feet. Turning fellow friends to foes, for domination in the demon realm. Play as one of the 7 deadly sins in this fast paced Action Roguelike to kill god. Precision Based Combat Partake in violently fast paced combat that tests your ability to parry and dodge enemy attacks. Break your enemies' defenses with relentless attacks to further crush their souls. Fight in unique modes that allow you to unlock Side characters with slightly different move-sets, or a boss only mode. Each mode allows you to play against the clock to see how well you've done. Challenging Bosses Take on angels, demons, spirits, and nightmares as everyone against you fights for your flesh and bones. Each enemy testing you on your path. Be wary of devastating enemy combos, and their potential mix-ups. Hit Even Harder Use modifiers bestowed upon you by the sin of Greed to crush your foes even more efficiently. Different modifiers allow you to specialize in different areas, letting you craft completely different playstyles.
row.short_description: Harder is an action rogue-like game with combat heavily inspired by the hack and slash genre. Progress through a series of enemies and bosses to reach your one true goal. Dodge, dash, parry, and slash your way through angels and demons alike in this quest to kill GOD.
row.notes: This game includes some skimpy outfits and mature body physics.

Fantasy cultivation takes you into the world of cultivation, where treasures and divine powers, spiritual roots and techniques, Dao heart and Dao fruit are used to interpret infinite power Boundary division Ordinary fetus, innate, cultivating qi, building foundation, golden pill, elemental baby, elemental god, combination, enlightenment, true immortal, earth immortal, heavenly immortal, Da Luo golden immortal, mixed elemental golden immortal, infinite golden immortal, Dao Zu sage, many realms, all in the realm of fantasy cultivation Gameplay Step 1: Registration and login in the selected area (unable to register in a fully populated area), verification with a picture verification code and email, and login with a picture verification code; Step 2: Enter the track number, create a character, and descend to enter the game interface; Part Three: Obtain Dao Xing (in the endless practice, obtain Dao Xing every second), break through the realm (mortal, innate, cultivate qi, build foundation, golden pill, elemental infant, elemental spirit, merge, comprehend Dao, true immortal, earth immortal, heavenly immortal, Da Luo Golden Immortal, mixed element Golden Immortal, infinite Golden Immortal, Taoist ancestor saint); Step 4: Demon Trial Challenge, obtain Spirit Stones, and receive additional rewards in certain levels; Step 5: Treasure Hunt in the Treasure Pavilion to obtain treasures, divine powers, spiritual roots, martial arts, Dao Heart, Dao Fruit, Dao Xing Card... Items can be viewed in the Na Jie; Baoge points can be exchanged for items, and the exclamation mark on the right side of the green points can be clicked to open the exchange interface; Step 6: The immortal realm spirit stone veins can be collected to obtain spirit stones; Step 7: Cultivation - Cultivation Configuration, which can equip magic weapons, divine powers, spiritual roots, techniques, Dao hearts, Dao fruits, Dao cards. row.name: Totomi trainer
row.detailed_description: Totomi trainer is a trainer simulator in which You will become a trainer of runners. But there is one small detail - you will train monsters. But don't worry, they are cute and don't bite at all! I guess... Build up a whole collection of different runners, getting monsters from chests or swapping them with other players to beat everyone on the race track!
row.short_description: Totomi trainer is a trainer simulator in which You will become a trainer of runners. But there is one small detail, you will train monsters :) But don't worry, they are cute and don't bite at all ! i guess...

row.name: The Doors
row.detailed_description: The Doors are a gambling clicker for memorization and luck. Suitable for all ages. Click on the doors and collect the crystals before the time runs out. To see what is hiding behind the doors – roll the dice, they will open the randomly dropped number of doors. Remember what's behind them, and open others at your own risk. Behind the doors can be: crystals, various enemies, or advantages in the form of additional dice rolls, time, health and treasure. Nice graphics and sounds create a relaxing atmosphere. Complete all 20 levels! With each level, the number of doors increases, there are more enemies, there are closed doors to which you need to look for keys! At the same time, the game remains both challenging and relaxing at the same time! For every 10,000 points, a mini bonus game is given. Score as many points as possible so that everyone knows that you are the best in the game!!!
row.short_description: This is a gambling and exciting clicker for memorization and luck. Click on the doors and collect all the crystals before the time runs out. Roll the dice. It will open the randomly dropped number of doors. Remember what's behind them, open others at your own risk.

row.name: Cursed Ones
row.detailed_description: Cursed Ones is a 1-2 player co-op horror stealth survival game. Play as the Crane siblings as you continue your late parents' legacy to purge the world of sinister spirits. Track down the items used to summon the spirit by any means necessary. Make sure you both don't die in the process. Protect each other : Play with a friend as you HIDE , RUN , or CONFRONT the spirit that is hunting you down. Singleplayer Mode : Ditch your sibling and take on the supernatural yourself. Scavenge the map : Find items around the map that will help you survive. Find out what happened : There are clues around the world that hint at how tragedy struck those who were there before you. Equipment : As ghost hunters, you always carry the right equipment for the job. Each map will have unique equipment for that particular map. The Crane Curse : Cursed blood runs through the Crane family line, and each sibling has a special curse. Find out what it is. Getting Caught : If you're caught there are no second chances. Make sure to protect each other. The Goal : Track down and destroy the items that were used to bring the spirit into our world & MAKE IT OUT ALIVE
row.short_description: Cursed Ones is a co-op horror stealth survival game. Play as the Crane siblings as you hunt down the worst kinds of spirits and continue your late parents' legacy. Make sure you both don't die in the process.
row.notes: This game contains mature content and is intended for adult audiences. It includes the following themes and elements: Supernatural horror involving demons and other dark entities. Graphic depictions of blood and violence, including scenes of death and murder. Religious symbolism and references, including crosses and other artifacts may be disturbing to some players. Please be aware that these themes may not be suitable for all audiences. Viewer discretion is advised.

row.name: Master RNG
row.detailed_description: A simple 2d game where you roll for different items! These items you get will become rarer and rarer as you collect them. FEATURES/b] You can either manually press the roll button or press the auto roll button to keep rolling for items. Remember, you have to have a equipped item to use the auto roll button correctly. There is also a shop in the game where you can get more luck. This can help you get more and better items along the way. COMING SOON Achievements and other stuff... HAVE FUN!
row.short_description: A simple 2d game where you roll for different items! These items you get will become rarer and rarer as you collect them.

row.name: Orbit Puzzle
row.detailed_description: 'Orbit Puzzle' is a puzzle game that lets you unravel the mysteries of ancient astronomy! Analyze the complex orbit of a given celestial body and accurately determine the rotational speed and radius of both the deferent and epicycle. Understand the geometric principles of epicycles and complete the path of the celestial body. Each level presents more challenging orbits, testing your logical thinking and problem-solving skills. Embark on an exciting journey to uncover the secrets of the universe from the perspective of an ancient astronomer!
row.short_description: An astronomical puzzle game about discovering the rotational speeds and radii of epicycles.

row.name: Pixeplorer
row.detailed_description: Explore an infinite amount of pixelated worlds in this adventure sandbox game, and find villages, enemy camps, and quests along your journey! In Pixeplorer, you spawn into a procedurally generated world with only a sword and a set of basic armor. Your task? Explore. Trek through grasslands, savannas, deserts and more to collect resources, which then you can use to upgrade your items and fight enemies with. Will you get lost in the game's boundless biomes collecting trees and fighting enemy hordes? Or, will you find a village and change the tides of battle, allowing you to sweep through fiercer enemy outposts? The choice is all yours in Pixeplorer. GAME FEATURES: Infinite procedurally generating worlds, ranging from 512 x 512 tiles up to 2048 x 2048 tiles each Enemy outposts and cave systems for intense combat, with 7 unique different enemy types total Villages filled with NPCs and options to upgrade items Trackable quest system to use resources and get powerful loot ... And much more!
row.short_description: Explore an infinite amount of pixelated worlds in this adventure sandbox game, and find villages, enemy camps, and quests along your journey!

row.name: Finn Dorset's Institute For Livestock Replication
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Finn Dorset's Institute For Livestock Replication You play as Finn Dorset, a humble clone farmer starting out on a grassy dwarf planet. Begin with a single moon sheep, a small paddock and a cloning machine. Expand your enterprise clone-by-clone until you have the greatest wool production business in the sector! Purchase upgrades and automate your clone production with your hard earned Moon Money! Deploy futuristic gadgets to produce large amounts of livestock and develop various transport methods to sell your wool! Defend your farm from hungry hawks and other hazardous hostiles! Features - Animated cartoon graphics - Totally free game (no paid bonuses, loot boxes or coins. You will never be asked for money) - Hundreds of upgrades and progression levels - Fully illustrated hand drawn artwork - Space goose! - Dynamic evolving visuals - Hours of game-play - In-game and Steam achievements What even is this? Another crackpot hand-drawn cartoon game from the developer of Snowflake's Chance and Metal Voyager. FDIFLR is an incremental game in the spirit of titles such as Universal Paperclips and Cookie Clicker. The genre is often characterized by minimalist visuals so the idea was to have the units and upgrades illustrated as much as possible. It is an idle/clicker game so there are short to medium periods of waiting to progress. Is there sound? Due to the game being designed to be played while multitasking or in the background there is no game audio, players are encouraged to listen to a podcast or watch approved educational programming on a second monitor. Who has made this? Game and artwork was made by Carl Morgan (CarlMorganArt). Special thanks to Dante Morris for naming the title. So this is free? Yep. Who is Finn Dorset? Stop digging.
row.short_description: An animated incremental game about cloning livestock. Make as many moon sheep as you can. Research technology, upgrade your operation and become a clone farm billionaire!

row.name: Little Knight
row.detailed_description: Little Knight is a 2.5D party game that supports 2-4 players. Leverage your oversized weapon of choice to swing and fling yourself across various arenas and bring the fight to your friends and family. Master the goofy physics and show off your skills in frantic matches to try and come out on top. Collect and protect your horde of gold to win in the collection game mode or dominate your opponents in death match mode. Play with up to four friends in local multiplayer Fling yourself around as you master the goofy physics movement Choose from four unique weapons
row.short_description: Become a Little Knight and use your oversized weapon to fling, slash and dash around 2D arenas set in a medieval blacksmith. Master the goofy physics to beat your family and friends and claim the crown.

row.name: Geometry Shooter
row.detailed_description: Dive into the charming, hand-drawn world of this free arcade game where every shot counts! Your goal is to fire from a moving cannon into a field of shapes—circles, squares, triangles, and more. Once hit, the shapes expand, but it takes multiple hits to break them and score points. Timing and precision are key as you aim to break multiple shapes with a single shot, triggering crazy combos for maximum points. The game’s cute art style and puzzling, yet exciting, gameplay make it perfect for quick sessions or longer playthroughs. Get ready to challenge your friends!
row.short_description: Unleash your aim in this free, hand-drawn arcade game! Fire from a moving cannon, break various shapes, and rack up crazy combos in a puzzling and exciting gameplay experience. Can you master the art of the perfect shot?

row.name: Metroloop
row.detailed_description: Reach the furthest stations in the postapocalyptic top down shooter and platformer looter. Loot tunnels in side scrolling mode and survive from waves of monsters on the stations in a top down twin stick shooter mode.  How far will you go? Destroy boxes to find crucial loot in tunnels, between stations. Boxes contain upgrades, weapons, ammo and coins and you have only 40 seconds to find whatever you need during platformer tunnel phase. Light shuts down every 5 seconds, during which you will have to move forward. Upgrading your axe skill will make smashing boxes faster. Keys found in monsters bodies will open boxes faster. Shoot your way through stations in a top down twin-stick shooter phase of the game. Quantity and thoughness of enemies go slowly up with every next station, along your upgrades and weapons. 20 different types of enemies will be waiting for you at the stations. You can hold and use two weapons at the same time, manage your ammo responsibly. Additionally you will have special abilities at your disposal, such as landmines, shield, glue trap and teleporter, that will help you leave every station alive. Upgrade temporarily and permanently. Open boxes with green arrows to find upgrades of your skills and weapons. Each upgrade improves your stats by small amount but you can keep upgrading endlessly.  Buy permanent weapon upgrades for collected coins. Unlock achievements for permanent upgrades of your character's skills. Survive as many stations as possible. Fighting enemies will not always be the best solution, sometimes you can avoid them or run away from them. Every tunnel has a healing chamber at the end of it. The more time you will save, the more life points you will restore before all lights shut down.
row.short_description: Loot post-apocalyptic metro tunnels in side-scrolling mode and survive waves of monsters at stations in top-down twin-stick shooter mode. Upgrade your skills and weapons endlessly. How far will you get?
