row.name: King Of The Pirates
row.detailed_description: About This Game Embark on an epic journey in sea war, a thrilling naval combat game where strategy, skill, and bravery determine your fate on the high seas. Command your own ship, upgrade it, and become the most feared pirate captain of all time. Key Features: Ship Customization: Upgrade your ship with powerful cannons, elite cannonballs, and a highly skilled crew. Equip special materials and unique items to give you an edge over your enemies. Naval Battles: Engage in intense naval battles against other players in real-time. Use your strategic prowess to outmaneuver your foes and send them to the depths. Fleet System: Build or join a fleet to conquer islands and dominate the seas. Coordinate with your fleet members to execute massive attacks and defend your territory. Daily Quests & Events: Complete daily quests to earn experience points and speed up your progression. Participate in regular events to showcase your skills and earn exclusive rewards. Leaderboard: Prove your dominance by climbing the ranks. The strongest and most skilled players will see their ship names featured prominently on the game’s leaderboard. Open World Exploration: Explore a vast open world filled with hidden treasures, dangerous foes, and mysterious islands. Each journey offers new challenges and opportunities. Multiplayer: Join forces with friends or challenge other players in exciting multiplayer modes. Strengthen your alliances and show the world your might. Stunning Graphics & Sound: Experience the beauty and danger of the seas with stunning graphics and immersive sound effects that bring the world of Sea War to life. Set sail, captain, and carve your legend in the treacherous waters of Sea War. Whether you seek glory, treasure, or simply the thrill of battle, the seas await your command.
row.short_description: Can you rule this mighty sea?

row.name: Cycle of Steel
row.detailed_description: Cycle of Steel is a fast paced roguelike adventure, where you make it through a randomly generated dungeon, utilizing various weapons to shoot down enemies along the way. Explore a destopic scenery, ravaged by heartless robots, all drawn in satisfying pixel art. It's free, give it a shot. Control a hacked robot against the AI’s army, The Knights of the Holy Code. Search for the one controlling them all, and bring them, or it, down to ruin. Pick up your weapon and fire, with a top down perspective shooter, and roguelike elements to keep the game interesting. Keep respawning and purchashing upgrades to get further every time. Figure out your playstyle with differing weapons, taking it slow and steady with a laser rifle, or hot and fast with piercing shotgun rounds! And more details to find, like environmental effects, in this indie game created by a team with a passion. You can't give up, if your robot is destroyed, you must make more to break the cycle of steel.
row.short_description: Cycle of Steel is a pixel-art roguelike where tyrannical robot knights run amok. Arm and upgrade your robot to fight through a perilous factory. End the knight’s reign of terror!

row.name: Alchemy
row.detailed_description: Alchemy is a 3D Puzzle platformer taking place at Chemical Laboratories, a company that discovered a powerfull substance capable of giving superhuman characteristics. Chemical labs will be hosting an event for investors were a gateway to another reality will be opened, what could go wrong? Find your way out trough chambers and try to understand what is going on at this bizarre shuffle of what chemical labs used to be. Alchemy introduces a new way of solving puzzles centered on movement. Includes: • 20 Main chambers + extra levels. • 7-10 hours of gameplay. • A storyline. • Unique mechanics.
row.short_description: Discover what lies beyond our reality with Alchemy. A portal-like experience that will challenge you to think with potions while trying to solve the mysteries of this strange new place.

row.name: 地府行记
row.detailed_description: Upon waking up, you find that your wife has mysteriously disappeared, and thus embark on a journey to find her. As the last descendant of a Taoist family, you use tracking spells to teleport to the last known location of your wife, only to unexpectedly find yourself in the 'Underworld,' a realm familiar to many from traditional Chinese ghost and deity stories. Along the way, you will battle wandering ghosts, search for traces of your wife in the ghost city, converse with local deities to learn about the customs and culture, continuously learn new combat skills, collect items to strengthen yourself to defeat more powerful enemies. Meet mythical figures, ask the King of Hell for the Book of Life and Death, have Zhong Kui arbitrate right and wrong, and ultimately find your wife and uncover the truth behind the entire incident. Depending on the choices you make, the game may lead to different endings. Main gameplay elements: Exploration: Players take on the role of a Taoist, searching for his missing wife in the underworld, traversing seven distinct regions of the afterlife. Combat: Use a peachwood sword for close combat, or use thunder, frost, and flame talismans for ranged attacks to battle monsters. Parkour: Players can use multi-jump, dash, and decoy talismans, among other parkour skills, to move quickly and explore the map. Collection: Collect a variety of items on the map to trade with NPCs or to enhance character abilities. Puzzle-solving: Gather information through conversations with NPCs or by collecting story items to understand the details of the plot, gradually uncovering the truth behind the entire event.
row.short_description: In this game, you'll take on the role of a Taoist priest who traverses through the mysterious world of the afterlife in order to find his missing wife. They explore seven distinct realms, combat with various monsters, collect items, unlock new spells, unveil the truth behind the entire event.

row.name: Infiltrate & Extract
row.detailed_description: Mission brief: You are deployed to a heavily guarded compound to infiltrate and extract a highly valuable relic. Remaining undetected is of utmost priority. If anyone spots you, the mission is over. Use your surroundings carefully to avoid detection and reach the vault. The ultimate test of strategy and patience awaits you. Harder challenges will become available for the elite who accomplish their extraction. Do you accept your mission? Infiltrate and Extract will test your problem solving and decision-making skills. This game has no mercy against those who don’t plan ahead, and heavy punishments for not being patient. Only the best of agents returns home, and the very best can beat the hardest challenges the game has to offer. Are you up for the challenge? 10 unique locations. Unlockable “First Person” Mode. Unlockable “Sudden Death” Mode. Est. Mission length: ~ 1 hour. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A top-down 3D stealth game where remaining undetected is of utmost priority. Take down security guards and stay in the shadows to reach the vault and extract a highly valuable relic.

row.name: Compactory
row.detailed_description: Compactory is a game that mixes order and chaos. Did you enjoy Overcooked, Unrailed, and Plate Up!? If you did, this game is meant for you! In Compactory, team up with your friends in a small space to produce as many resources as you can! Be careful not to get in each others' way! Choose from a variety of blocks to find the most profitable strategy! Try Local Multiplayer with up to 4 friends! (Note: At least one controller is required to play Local Multiplayer with more than 2 people)
row.short_description: Team up with your friends in a small space to produce as many resources as you can!

row.name: Mini Mania
row.detailed_description: Mini Mania is a new single player game from Pixel Playground Studio. Set in your Grandad's mysterious Laboratories, Mini Mania has been Nominated as one of the most innovative new games from UWE's Graduates and will offer up to an hours of unique gameplay. The game is designed to change the way players approach, manipulate, and surmise the possibilities in a given environment; similar to how Portal™'s Portal Gun innovated new ways to leverage an you're environment in any given situation. Players must solve physical puzzles and challenges by using a shrink ray to manipulate the size of objects, and themselves, through space.
row.short_description: You are young man, whose grandfather has shrunk down to use a ‘lab rat’ in his size changing experiments. With the crazy genius grandpa constantly watching, you must complete all of the puzzles in front of him if he is to ever to return to full size – and normal life!

row.name: Bite-Sized Scares
row.detailed_description: Bite-Sized Scares Is a completely free, small collection of short and sweet, bite sized indie horror games created and curated by Aaron Wise & D. Zenith. The games are playable through a fun and interactive launcher, with each game featuring their own unique setting, narrative, and gameplay mechanics. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- FEATURED IN THIS COLLECTION: Statuam Your friends dared you to enter the mysterious maze, dubbed 'Domum Statuae'. Stories of a demonic statue that stalks its prey throughout the maze are all that runs though your mind, but you aren't one to chicken out. Get in, get out. How hard can it be? The Bewdley Incident A short game of 'Guess Who' where a Skinwalker has taken over the small town where you live. Assess the situation, look for the signs, and execute the Skinwalker before it's too late! Randomly selects a new Skinwalker with each playthrough with 4 endings to find. A Date to Remember Sometimes it's best to let sleeping corpses lie. You take the role of a young, single woman, attempting to find love in these trying times. The person you've taken an interest in, invites you to dinner at his beloved grandmother's house. Though as with all dates, people don't show their true colors right away. The Nest Something lives down inside the darkest part of the mines. With the creature on the prowl, you must avoid detection, find resources to build a makeshift bridge & escape. Be careful, though. It's not the only thing down there. Booi's Spooky Vacation Booi, the ghost, decided to explore the sea during it's vacation, but an unfortunate event happens and the path towards new waters is blocked by a big ghost ship. Now Booi will need the help of the local folks to discover the dark secrets behind the ghost ship in order to get inside it and release all the tripulation being held by an evil entity! Booi's Spooky Vacation is a point and click game. It's Outside Can you survive the night?  Step into the eerie sounds of rain & silence, where something sinister lurks just beyond the windows. Inspired by Five Nights at Freddy's , this tense, atmospheric horror game challenges you to keep a terrifying entity at bay, armed with nothing but your wits, your ears, and a powerful photo flash. Garage A short and sweet psychological horror game which takes place in the mind of a troubled husband. He goes about his business as usual, however; things don't end particularly well for him. Do you have what it takes to assist our hero and release him from his torment? PROCESS_HIDE A rogue virus has been corrupting and taking over the network. You take the role of an antivirus stealth-unit. You must make your way to the core of the network to release more antivirus units to combat the virus. Sneak your way through 3 distinct levels and avoid detection at all costs! Kakashi Based on the Japanese folklore, 'Kakashi'; torments a local farmer. With missing people on the rise, and strange dreams that haunt you as the week progresses. Can you solve the mystery behind the missing persons and survive these strange occurances?
row.short_description: Kick back, relax, and grab some snacks as you enjoy a variety of short, indie horror games in the 'Bite-Sized Scares' collection. There's a little something for everyone in this fun and spooky package!
row.notes: Some games contain chase scenes that contain sustained threats, which some players may find stressful.

row.name: Wyvern Creations Crossbow Hunter
row.detailed_description: Update 12/11/2024 Latest game update now allows for you to use a game controller instead of a just your keyboards. About the Game We've created a simple way for you to checkout and test some of the best real-world crossbow on the market today. Walk thru our store and take a look what the top manufacturers have available. We have created accurate 3-D models of some of the best-selling crossbows on the market. Once you make your choice, test it out on our practice range before heading into the woods to hunt. Hunt bear, deer or foxes from up in a treestand or stalk them on the ground.
row.short_description: Take a walk thru our store and checkout some of the highest quality real-world crossbows on the market. Take them for a test in our practice range and find your favorite before heading out into the woods. Hunt bear, deer and fox from the ground or up in a treestand.

row.name: Delivery to Graveyard Manor
row.detailed_description: Ding Dong! There is a package at the door, and Graveyard Manor’s resident skeleton will need to collect items from the previous occupants of this old Victorian mansion in order to receive it on time without scaring the delivery courier. Each Family member has a portrait featuring three items the skeleton will need in order to summon their visage. Make sure you find the right combination in order to achieve your task. In this puzzle/adventure game items can be found on shelves, in cabinets, behind locked doors or even stolen by mice. Will you collect all of the packages in time before the main event?
row.short_description: Gather the disguises and collect all the deliveries!

row.name: Virtuále: Heist Simulations
row.detailed_description: THE STORY There's a big house at the top of Townstate, and you want what's inside. The value of these goods is beyond what you could possibly imagine. The only problem? Security. Electronic locks, heavy vault doors with magnetic seals, and guards galore fill this mansion. Luckily, you have a team: Alpha Vlad, a bodybuilder and weapons expert; Scarlett, femme fatale and soccer mom extraordinaire; John Doe, the mysterious and stealthy agent of chaos; and finally, Zoomer, a speedy genius with a knack for high-profile theft. These four make up your crew, and with their skills and your careful strategy, you all may be able to finally make it big—and make enough to pay those pesky Townstate HOA dues. THE GAMEPLAY The gameplay of Virtuále: Heist Simulations is very straightforward. On a large grid representing your mark's house, you use your four operatives, turn by turn, to deal with guards and obstacles to escape with as much value as possible. But be careful: you only have so much time to reach the quota, and if the guards get too suspicious, they'll call the cops. Break in and break out with the most valuable loot, and see how high you can make the number go! You have abilities such as Hack, which allows you to bypass more difficult locks (such as the vault), or abilities like Swoon, which allows you to use an operative to distract guards for a bit while you make off with your steals! A WORD ABOUT THE GAME'S SCOPE This game was made by just four people over the course of ten weeks. As such, the game was designed to be as tight and replayable as we could possibly make it. While there is just one playable house, there are a huge number of ways to succeed in the world of Virtuále: Heist Simulations, so try out as many as you possibly can!
row.short_description: A turn-based heist game where you get to mastermind your own high-profile job. This game’s rich atmosphere and sense of style underpin the simple but fun strategy gameplay. Sneak, hack, and smash your way to riches in Virtuále: Heist Simulations!

row.name: Forest Dump: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Dive into a world of surprises, where every card flip could be your ticket to victory or trouble. The prologue showcases a part of the mysterious forest that changes with every game. Can you master the art of strategic card flipping and uncover the first plot mysteries? Get a taste of a larger adventure that combines tactical thinking, luck, and exploration in this captivating roguelike experience. Features of the Prologue: Strategic Combat: Experience the core gameplay where every decision matters. Learn to choose your cards wisely and plan your attacks carefully. Roguelike Elements: Discover how collecting scrolls can make you stronger. Vibrant World: Explore part of the atmospheric forest with beautiful graphics. Cards: Try out a limited set of cards, giving you a taste of the variety in the full game. First Story Beats: Meet key characters and uncover the beginning of the mysterious plot that unfolds in the full version. Replayability: Each playthrough of the prologue offers a unique experience thanks to the changing forest. Try out gameplay elements that fans of Slay the Spire, Inscryption , and similar card-based roguelikes will find both familiar and fresh.
row.short_description: Forest Dump: Prologue is a free version of the upcoming roguelike card-flipping adventure game. Explore a mysterious woodland as a fox, meet strange creatures, and uncover the first secrets of your corrupted home in this beautiful journey.

row.detailed_description: Join our community Struggling to find someone to share your experience with? Want to play with a lot of players? Or looking for a partner to get stronger with? row.short_description: Form your own team among 200+ different animals and then fight with other players! Play a game in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere, and enjoy the game without any operations. They strengthen the animals in battle after battle until they finally win the championship.

row.name: The Wungo Dungo Surprise
row.detailed_description: The Wungo Dungo Surprise is a physics based local 1v1 fighting game. There’s no combos or moveset, or roster. There’s no lore or story. The goal is just to win every encounter and see how many times you can win. There’s a single player mode against a bot, and a local 1v1 mode, first to 3. There are no extra characters or stages. Health isn’t automatically regained at the end of each round so it’s a case of seeing how many rounds you can go for in a row. For the gameplay, there’s a punch, a kick, 4 dodges, 3 weapons, and 11 powers. The core of the gameplay is reacting to the punch direction of the enemy, and the other moves are sprinkles of variation/decision making on top of that. At the end of each round you get the choice of one of 11 powers, and to regain health/dodges/kicks. The game itself is fully physics based, i.e. every limb of the character is fully controlled by physics and obeys newtons laws, allowing for some interesting interactions, such as being able to ragdoll at any time. As part of the physics system, momentum is conserved, and as such while in the air you’re purely at the whims of momentum and gravity, which means stuff like throwing objects or front flips must be well timed, which can lead to some fun moments and difficulty.
row.short_description: The Wungo Dungo Surprise is a physics based local 1v1 fighting game, with no combos or roster, just 1 simple enemy to beat repeatedly. The main moves are punching, kicking and dodging, and some extra tools, a few weapons and powers.

row.name: Countin' Stars
row.detailed_description: Countin' Stars is a procedurally generated puzzle game that’s as original as it is unique. Carefully observe the night sky and count how many stars you see, but stay focused—other celestial objects will complicate your task. You’ll be presented with three possible answers, but only one will be correct. However, be warned—sometimes none of them will be right. In those moments, you’ll need to use black holes to destroy stars or create new stars to make the count match the available options. If you choose incorrectly or run out of time, it’s game over. Key Features Procedurally generated gameplay, ensuring no two sessions are ever the same. Relax with our cozy music and graphics style. Destroy or create stars to align with the possible outcomes. Enjoy the challenge of counting stars under pressure and improve your high score.
row.short_description: Countin' Stars is a procedurally generated puzzle game that challenges you to count the stars in the sky. Destroy or create stars to match the possible answers before time runs out.

row.name: Cast Iron Flowers
row.detailed_description: This game is a VR experience of the Chinese intangible cultural heritage program - Cast Iron Flowers. You can experience the process of Cast Iron Flowers in the game! You move and manipulate objects through the use of the VR grip, experiencing each process of Cast Iron Flowers and ultimately realizing it by gripping the willow sticks (Hua Bang)! You can feel the stunning immersion effect far beyond the normal video. The optimized process is presented in the game as the following parts: - Pick up the basket with broken iron pieces and pour the iron pieces in the basket into the designated furnace. - Pick up the willow sticks (Hua Bang) used for Molten Iron Firework and go to the furnace to get liquid iron. - Go to the bottom of the trellis (Hua Peng) and hit the willow sticks (Hua Bang) to complete the flower making process and enjoy the beautiful scenery. As long as you follow the guidance in the scene to operate, you can feel the unique charm of the Chinese intangible cultural heritage program of Cast Iron Flowers, come and try!
row.short_description: a VR experience of the Chinese intangible cultural heritage program - Cast Iron Flowers

row.name: Discover Old D'Hanis
row.detailed_description: Discover. Learn. Preserve. Discover Old D'Hanis is an immersive educational experience that invites you to explore the history of the old town of D’Hanis, TX. The game is based on data from the Old D’Hanis Archaeological Mapping Project, a real archaeological project that examined the ruins, stories, and landscapes of the historic town, alongside community members, in 2018. Enter D’Hanis and you will find yourself in front of the ruin of its Catholic church, grass beneath your feet, the sound of wind and the occasional bird in a landscape empty of people. You stand at the intersection of past and present. Walking through the historic streets, you will find virtual reconstructions of white-walled cottages from the 19th century alongside 21st century ruins scanned by archaeologists. Scattered throughout the landscape are pieces of D’Hanis’ story – a 19th century photograph, archaeological field notes, a quote from an oral history, a newspaper article. Alone, these provide small snapshots of the town or the archaeological project through time. Together, they paint a fuller picture of D’Hanis and its residents, from the Alsatian and German migrants who founded the town in 1847 to the Black and Mexican families who made it their home following the Civil War and Mexican Revolution. Your role: to explore, to collect fragments, and to piece together the stories of the Old D’Hanis. Based on the history of a real Texas town, Discover Old D’Hanis features ruins, historically-informed landscape and sound design, interactive features, artistic reconstructions, and an original musical composition based on old German folk songs. It provides a glimpse into a real archaeology project and demonstrates how we come to understand the past through its fragments. Discover Old D'Hanis is more than just a game; it’s an invitation to join the efforts preserve and share the historical legacy of an historic place. Are you ready to uncover the stories and experience the old town?
row.short_description: Step into the past and unravel the rich history of Old D'Hanis. Explore this 19th-century town, from Alsatian and German settlers of 1847 to Black and Mexican families post-Civil War. Unearth archival fragments, archaeological photos, and oral histories to piece together the town's alluring stories.
